Existing systems treat these as separate problems: memories are written prospectively with static importance scores that are never revised after use. This creates two coupled failure modes: consolidation can silently destroy evidence that future queries require, while retrieval continues to favor stale memories. We propose MEMOIR (Memory Evidence via Merge-certified, Online Importance Revision), a training-free memory lifecycle that unifies judge-gated consolidation with retrospective attribution. Before compressing memory, screening gates test whether answer-relevant evidence is preserved. After each query, attribution estimates which retrieved memories supported the answer and updates their retrieval priority. A UCB-style exploration bonus additionally encourages retrieval of under-exposed memories, reducing the risk that frequently retrieved memories crowd out useful but less-seen evidence. On 1,905 deduplicated LoCoMo QA pairs, the full retrieval stack improves evidence recall@5 by 11.92 percentage points over bare cosine, with confidence-gated feedback adding 1.50 points overall without reference answers or reranker training; a deployment-unavailable oracle adds 1.84 points overall and 8.05 points on multi-hop. Judge-gated merge changes the recall of text-based evidence from 58.82% to 59.08%, reduces the active store by 1.42%, and incurs 0 observed losses in 100 independently audited merges, with a one-sided 95% upper loss-rate bound of 2.95%. Together, these results outline a practical deployment path: no additional LLM call on the online write path, with merge screening confined to periodic offline consolidation. The lifecycle reduces to one principle: attribute usefulness after use, and screen for preservation before compression.

</details>


### [177] [Probabilistic Relevance Decisions for Semantic Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08014)
*Bahadır Tatar,Cevat Şener*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 在BEIR SciFact基准上比较稠密检索(BGE-M3)与两类概率相关性决策打分(OpenAI Decisions Predicate、Jev)，Jev在Recall@5与nDCG@10上表现最佳，但差异为探索性、未校正结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密相似度可复用但缺乏查询相关决策能力，概率相关性打分可提供查询依赖的文档评分。作者希望验证相关性决策能否作为稠密检索的补充。

Method: 在SciFact官方300条测试查询上，使用相同的正例增强100文档池及全语料稠密检索，在候选深度50与100下重排；对比BGE-M3、Jev、OpenAI三种打分；采用配对bootstrap分析深度效应，并考察成本、零分与并列问题。

Result: 深度50全语料nDCG@10：BGE-M3 0.6413、OpenAI 0.7545、Jev 0.7805；Jev的Recall@5与nDCG@10最高。深度50→100提升已知正例召回，但最终效果变化小且不确定，四个配对bootstrap区间均含零。唯一条件API成本约翻倍，缓存可降低成本。

Conclusion: 在本协议内，相关性决策可作为稠密检索的补充，但未证明普遍优越性、概率校准性或深度间等价性。

Abstract: Dense similarity supplies reusable corpus representations, while probabilistic relevance decisions offer query-dependent document scoring. We compare dense-only BGE-M3 with TypeSafe Jev Noul and OpenAI Decisions Predicate scores on the official BEIR SciFact test benchmark. The study evaluates 300 official test queries using identical positive-enriched 100-document pools and full-corpus dense retrieval followed by reranking at candidate depths of 50 and 100. Unlike the controlled pools, neither dense prefix receives positive injection. Jev has the highest observed Recall@5 and nDCG@10 under the evaluated conditions. At depth 50, full-corpus nDCG@10 is 0.6413 for BGE-M3, 0.7545 with OpenAI and 0.7805 with Jev. Extending depth from 50 to 100 increases known-positive candidate recall but produces small, uncertain final-effectiveness changes. All four paired-bootstrap depth intervals include zero. Unique-condition API scoring cost approximately doubles, while compatible cached decisions reduce incremental expenditure. OpenAI returns many exact-zero scores, and secondary exact-tie randomization reveals ranking sensitivity without replacing deterministic primary results. Top-100 latency mixes cached and new execution. Historical hybrid latency is a saved-component sum under different execution environments and timer boundaries. These exploratory, unadjusted analyses support relevance decisions as a complement to dense retrieval within this protocol, without establishing general superiority, probability calibration or equivalence between depths.

</details>


### [178] [Domain-specific information retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08228)
*Suzan Verberne,Florina Piroi,Allan Hanbury*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文是关于领域特定信息检索（Domain-specific IR）的综述性论述，概述了领域特定任务、数据集与应用，讨论了长文档、长查询、长会话以及偏见与公平性等挑战，并介绍了相关模型与方法，指出其方法进展可迁移至其他领域乃至开放域网页搜索，最后提出未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信息检索远不止即席网页搜索，大量信息寻求活动发生在特定领域（如律师查找先例、学者调研文献），而领域特定IR与简单网页搜索存在显著差异，需要专门的梳理与分析。

Method: 采用章节化综述方式：第2章梳理常见领域特定任务、数据集与应用；第3章讨论长文档、长查询、长会话及特定用户需求等挑战，并涉及模型偏见与公平性问题；第4章描述针对这些挑战构建的模型与方法，涵盖查询处理、用户模型与用户交互等用户层面因素。

Result: 论证了领域特定IR中的诸多方法学进展具有可迁移性，不仅适用于其他领域，甚至可应用于开放域网页搜索。

Conclusion: 总结主要要点，并为近期未来提出研究方向，强调领域特定IR在信息寻求活动中的重要地位及其方法的外溢价值。

Abstract: Information Retrieval (IR) is much more than ad hoc web search: a large portion of the information seeking activities takes place in specific domains, often addressing work-related tasks. Examples are lawyers finding relevant prior cases for a legal case and academic researchers studying the background material for a paper. In Chapter 2 we outline the most common domain-specific tasks, datasets and applications. Domain-specific IR has a number of challenges that make set it apart from simple web search tasks: they often deal with long documents, long queries and long sessions with specific user needs. We discuss these in Chapter 3. We also address issues related to bias and fairness of models. In Chapter 4, we describe the models and methods developed for domain-specific tasks and data, addressing the specific challenges, including user aspects related to domain-specific IR tasks, dealing with queries, user models, and user interactions. We show that many of the methodological advances in domain-specific IR are transferable to other domains and even to open-domain web search. We conclude with the main takeaways and propose research directions for the near future.

</details>


### [179] [GINGER: Spicing Up Graph-Based Vector Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08306)
*Daniel Salwasser,Lars Gottesbüren,Laxman Dhulipala,Jakub Łącki,Guy Blelloch,Rajesh Jayaram,Tobias Rubel,Kshiteej Sheth,Amir Zandieh,Vahab Mirrokni*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Ginger 是 Google 开源的高性能 C++ 图近似最近邻搜索库，通过 Nested TurboQuant 两级量化、基于 PiPNN 的图构建、图重排序 + AdaptiveGap 无损压缩等技术，在吞吐和索引速度上超越现有库，同时保持最优内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模高维嵌入数据集上，现有图 ANNS 库在查询吞吐、索引时间和内存占用之间难以兼顾，需要同时提升速度与内存效率。

Method: 基于 PiPNN 邻近图构建与 TurboQuant 向量量化；提出 Nested TurboQuant（NTQ）两级量化器，用单一编码同时支持低精度图导航与高精度重排；结合图重排序与基于 StreamVByte 的新型无损编解码器 AdaptiveGap，将邻近图压缩至多 2.5 倍。

Result: NTQ 以 2.6 倍更少内存达到近浮点精度；图压缩不损吞吐；95% 召回下查询吞吐平均为各数据集最快竞品的 1.8 倍，比任一单库至少快 2.3 倍，高维嵌入上对紧凑型库提升达 2.9 倍。

Conclusion: Ginger 在查询吞吐和索引时间上领先，内存占用与最省空间竞品相当，是面向大规模高维嵌入的开源 SOTA 图 ANNS 库。

Abstract: We present \textsc{Ginger}, a state-of-the-art open-source C++ library for graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS). We developed \textsc{Ginger} at Google to push the speed and memory efficiency of graph search on large and high-dimensional embedding datasets. \textsc{Ginger} surpasses existing ANNS libraries with regards to query throughput and indexing time while matching the memory footprint of the most space-efficient competitors.
  \textsc{Ginger} builds upon recent advances in proximity graph construction (PiPNN) and vector quantization (TurboQuant). We introduce Nested TurboQuant (NTQ), a two-level quantizer which supports low precision graph navigation and high precision reranking in a single code. This representation achieves near floating point precision with $2.6\times$ less memory. We also compress the size of our proximity graphs by up to $2.5\times$ without impacting query throughput. We combine graph reordering with a new lossless compression codec called AdaptiveGap, which builds upon StreamVByte. At $95\%$ recall, \textsc{Ginger} speeds up query throughput by an average of $1.8\times$ over each dataset's fastest competitor and by at least $2.3\times$ over any single library. This lead grows to $2.9\times$ over compact libraries on high-dimensional embeddings.

</details>

### [180] [Polynomial-Time Computation of Extensive-Form Proper Equilibria in Two-Player Zero-Sum Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07089)
*Sam Ganzfried*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 给出确定性多项式时间算法，可在有限二人零和完美回忆扩展式博弈（有理数据）中精确计算扩展式真均衡（proper equilibrium）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真均衡通常只能近似求解；现有方法受数值扰动限制，难以得到精确解，且在不被到达的信息集上行为概率定义困难。

Method: 为每个信息集分配几何排列体约束可行动作概率；用缩放双随机表示嵌入多项式规模的 sequence-form 多面体，使鞍点满足局部 ε-真性不等式；再通过参数线性系统的符号稳定性、持久可行基构造及行为比值极限提取精确解。

Result: 所得概率为有理数且编码长度多项式，包含实现概率为零的信息集；算法确定性多项式时间运行。

Conclusion: 首次在二人零和完美回忆扩展式博弈中实现精确真均衡的多项式时间求解，克服了近似与零概率信息集的困难。

Abstract: We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for computing an exact extensive-form proper equilibrium in a finite two-player zero-sum extensive-form game with perfect recall and rational data. Properness is understood in the agent normal form: an action at an information set is penalized relative to a better action while all other local behavioral choices, including the player's own future actions, remain fixed. Our algorithm assigns each information set a geometric permutahedron of allowable action probabilities. A scaled doubly stochastic representation embeds these restrictions in a polynomial-size sequence-form polytope; a saddle point then satisfies the local $\varepsilon$-properness inequalities. To obtain an exact equilibrium rather than a solution at an arbitrarily small numerical perturbation, we establish sign stability of a parametric linear system, construct a persistent feasible basis, and extract the limits of behavioral ratios. The resulting probabilities are rational and have polynomial encoding length, including at information sets whose realization probabilities vanish.

</details>


### [181] [Polynomial-Time Approximate EFX for Chores via Flow and Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07468)
*Genjie Qin,Qizhi Fang,Minming Li,Wenjing Liu,Xin Chen*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分割杂务在非负加性成本下的近似EFX分配，给出多项式的常数近似算法，并拓展到EFkX及相关紧性/下界结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确EFX分配在一般情况下不一定存在，而以往的近似保证依赖于代理人数，因此需要与人数无关的常数近似保证，并刻画其紧性与下界。

Method: 提出多项式时间算法：对任意有理0<ε≤1，计算完整的(3+ε)-EFX分配；算法可扩展到EFkX，得到(2+1/k+ε)-近似。另分析BRBI算法在杂务数较少时的表现；并通过构造实例证明主算法因子渐近紧，给出四代理十杂务的11/10下界。

Result: 主算法将近似因子从依赖代理人数改进为常数(3+ε)（EFkX为2+1/k+ε）；BRBI在m≤2kn时得到精确EFkX，在m≤(3k-1)n时因子≤2-1/k，k=1且m≤2n时得到精确EFX。2+1/k对主算法渐近紧；并构造出11/10的加性成本下EFX近似下界，优于子模成本下的20/19。

Conclusion: 不可分割杂务的EFX近似可以用与代理人数无关的常数因子多项式地实现，且该保证在渐近意义下紧；短实例可由BRBI获得更强甚至精确的保证，同时加性成本下的下界得到改进。

Abstract: We study approximate EFX allocations of indivisible chores under nonnegative additive costs. Exact EFX allocations need not exist in general. We develop a polynomial-time algorithm that computes a complete $(3+\varepsilon)$-EFX allocation for any rational $0<\varepsilon\leq1$, improving the previous approximation guarantee from a factor depending on the number of agents to a constant. The algorithm extends to EF$k$X, achieving a $(2+1/k+\varepsilon)$-approximation for every integer $k\geq1$.
  For instances with relatively few chores, the polynomial-time BRBI algorithm gives stronger guarantees. It finds exact EF$k$X allocations when $m\leq2kn$ and achieves a factor of at most $2-1/k$ when $m\le(3k-1)n$. In particular, $k=1$ and $m\leq2n$ give exact EFX.
  We further show that the approximation factor \(2+1/k\) is asymptotically tight for our main algorithm. We also construct a four-agent, ten-chore instance in which every complete allocation has EFX approximation factor at least $11/10$, improving upon the $20/19$ lower bound for submodular costs even under additive costs.

</details>


### [182] [Transparency in Team Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07494)
*Paul Dütting,Yingkai Li,Inbal Talgam-Cohen,Jinzhao Wu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究委托人在信息占优情形下，如何联合设计团队合同与贝叶斯说服方案以激励代理人努力，并从"简洁性 vs 最优性"角度得到全透明披露的紧界近似及其局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 委托人通常比代理人更了解项目成功概率，因此既可用合同分享收益，也可用（贝叶斯）说服选择性披露信息来激励努力；已有工作很少研究这两种工具的最优组合。

Method: 按"简洁性 vs 最优性"视角分析信息披露与团队合同的联合问题；推导刻画全透明披露方案与最优联合方案之间差距的界（区分 submodular 与 supermodular 生产函数），并发展用于界定子模函数差距的技术，进而构造确定性的多项式时间近似算法。

Result: 当生产函数为子模时，全透明披露相对最优"信息披露+团队合同"组合有紧的 4/3 近似比；当生产函数为超模时，全透明披露可任意远离最优。所提技术还给出纯多代理合同设计的确定性多项式时间近似算法，近似比显著提升至 2.311，并由此得到联合信息与合同问题的 3.081 近似算法。

Conclusion: 简单透明的信息披露在子模生产情形下几乎无损（4/3 紧界），但在超模情形下可能严重次优，说明简洁方案的有效性强烈依赖于生产函数结构；同时为联合信息设计与合同问题提供了改进的多项式时间近似。

Abstract: In contract design, the principal is often better informed about the project's chances of succeeding than the agents. To incentivize effort, the principal has two main tools: first, to design a contract, sharing part of the project's success among the agents; second, to design a (Bayesian) persuasion scheme, selectively sharing information with the agents. In this work we are interested in the optimal combination of both these tools.
  We tackle the joint problem through the prism of simplicity vs. optimality, and establish a stark dichotomy: The simple disclosure scheme of full transparency achieves a tight $4/3$-approximation to the optimal combination of information disclosure and team contract, when the team's production function is submodular. In contrast, full transparency can be arbitrarily far from optimal when production is supermodular.
  The techniques that we develop to bound the gap for submodular functions, also yield a new deterministic polynomial-time approximation algorithm for pure multi-agent contract design, with a significantly improved approximation ratio of $2.311$, and thus a $3.081$-approximation algorithm for the joint information and contracting problem.

</details>


### [183] [Cores of $3$-distant convex games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07572)
*Keisuke Bando,Toshiyuki Hirai,Kenzo Imamura,Ryuhei Mizutani*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究"3-远凸博弈"的核：虽可能为空，但给出非空的充要条件，并设计强多项式时间组合算法求核分配，应用于带并购协同的寡头竞争与互补投入的联合生产利润分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 凸合作博弈核非空且有高效构造方法，但现实中的局部经济摩擦会破坏凸性；因此需研究仅在紧密相关联盟间违反凸性的更一般博弈类。

Method: 引入3-远凸博弈（仅相邻联盟间可违反凸性），刻画其核非空性的充要条件，并构造强多项式时间的组合算法，在存在核时输出一个核分配。

Result: 证明了3-远凸博弈核非空性的简单充要条件（尽管核一般可能为空），并给出强多项式时间的组合算法求核分配；同时在带并购协同的寡头竞争和互补投入的联合生产利润分配中展示了框架的适用性。

Conclusion: 将核的理论与算法从凸博弈推广到3-远凸博弈，兼具理论刻画、多项式算法与实际应用价值。

Abstract: Convex cooperative games have a nonempty core and admit an efficient construction of core allocations. However, economically natural local frictions may violate convexity. We study the core of $3$-distant convex games, which permit violations of convexity only between closely related coalitions. Although the core of such a game may be empty, we establish a simple necessary and sufficient condition for its nonemptiness. We also develop a strongly polynomial-time combinatorial algorithm for finding a core allocation whenever one exists. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of the framework to oligopolistic competition with merger synergies and profit allocation of joint production with complementary inputs.

</details>


### [184] [Learning and Steering in Incomplete-Information Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07589)
*Asrın Efe Yorulmaz,Tamer Başar*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究中介在不知道智能体效用、仅有终端结果反馈下学习博弈并引导自适应智能体，提出Learn-Compute-Steer算法


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代多智能体系统中，中介希望仅凭结果级反馈影响战略决策动态，且不知晓智能体效用，需要学习未知博弈并引导自适应智能体趋向中介最优结果

Method: 采用减半类(halving)算法学习正规式博弈的效用差与扩展式博弈的条件继续价值差；结合拉格朗日形式，构建在线Learn-Compute-Steer算法，交替进行学习、均衡计算与引导，趋向中介最优EFCE，并承诺非负支付

Result: 学习算法样本复杂度为Õ(ε^{-2})，匹配最坏情况下的下界（至多对数因子）；Learn-Compute-Steer算法以高概率实现directness gap与最优性gap为Õ(T^{-1/4})，时间平均支付为Õ(T^{-1/8})

Conclusion: 在部分信息反馈下可有效学习未知博弈并引导智能体，达到中介最优EFCE，理论与下界匹配

Abstract: In many modern multi-agent systems, a mediator seeks to influence strategic decision dynamics using only outcome-level feedback and without knowing agents' utilities. In this work, we study how a mediator can learn an unknown game and steer adaptive agents toward outcomes that maximize her utility using only trajectory feedback. The mediator knows the game form and her own objective, but not the agents' utilities. Moreover, she commits to nonnegative payments and provides recommendations and contexts, but receives only a single realized terminal outcome rather than full-information feedback. We develop halving-type algorithms that learn utility differences in normal-form games and conditional continuation-value differences in extensive-form games, achieving a sample complexity of $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ that matches worst-case lower bounds up to logarithmic factors. We then combine these learning procedures with a Lagrangian formulation in an online Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm that interleaves learning, equilibrium computation, and steering toward mediator-optimal extensive-form correlated equilibria (EFCE). With high probability, the Learn-Compute-Steer algorithm achieves a directness gap and an optimality gap of $\widetilde O(T^{-1/4})$, while time-average payments are of $\widetilde O(T^{-1/8})$.

</details>


### [185] [Distributed Optimization Involving Non-Lipschitzian, Linear Composite Functions: Unified Algorithm Design and Convergence Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07703)
*Liang Ran,Huaqing Li,Lifeng Zheng,Jun Li,Run Tang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该文提出一个通用的分布式非光滑优化框架，涵盖边等式约束、局部一般凸不等式约束，以及全局耦合的仿射等式与非线性不等式约束，并基于变量分解与邻近算子设计全分布式算法求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布式优化算法多针对目标函数梯度有界或仅含仿射约束的定制场景，难以处理含局部线性映射、多重非光滑函数和耦合非线性约束的实际复杂问题，作者希望构建一个更通用、能退化为已有结构的统一框架。

Method: 先推导新的局部一阶最优性条件；再基于变量分解与邻近算子构造全新的全分布式算法，每步迭代仅通过邻居信息交换、使用局部固定步长更新状态，且子问题可采用不精确求解而不损失收敛速度；通过构造算法的等价变分不等式进行分析。

Result: 在温和假设下，以最优性和相邻差度量衡量，算法达到 o(1/k) 的收敛速率；实际应用问题的数值实验验证了理论结果。

Conclusion: 该框架统一并推广了现有分布式优化结构，可处理一般凸函数与非线性约束等更实际的情形，兼具全分布式实现、固定步长与不精确子问题求解的能力，并具备理论收敛保证。

Abstract: This paper formulates a generic distributed nonsmooth optimization problem subject to edge-based equality constraints, local inequality constraints characterized by general convex functions, as well as globally coupling constraints including affine equality and nonlinear inequality. The terminal goal is to minimize the sum of local non-differentiable convex functions and proximable nonsmooth convex composite terms attached to linear operators, over networked multi-agent systems. This formulated framework not only applies in complex practical problems but also reduces to existing distributed optimization structures. To cope with technical issues caused by local linear mappings, potential multiple nonsmooth functions and coupling nonlinear constraints, we first derive a new local first-order condition, and further present a novel fully distributed optimization algorithm based on variable decompositions and proximal operators. Specifically, the proposed algorithm allows each agent to update states via local information exchange and through {locally fixed step-sizes}, and to find inexact solutions of subproblems without loss of convergence speed. In contrast to existing tailor-made algorithms for the bounded gradients of objective functions or affine constraints, our algorithm is capable of solving more practical cases involving general convex functions and nonlinear constraints. Under mild assumptions, the convergence rate $o(1/k)$ in terms of the optimality and successive-difference metrics is achieved, by constructing the equivalent variational inequalities of the proposed algorithm. Finally, numerical experiments on practical application problems illustrate the theoretical results.

</details>


### [186] [Regret Bounds for Profit Maximization in Bilateral Trade: Learning the Best Posted-Price Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08173)
*Johannes Brüstle,Simone Di Gregorio,Federico Fusco,Stefano Leonardi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该论文研究双边贸易中利润最大化中间商的学习问题，在仅观测交易是否发生的反馈下，给出对抗设定下 Õ(T^{2/3}) 的近乎最优算法，以及 MHR 分布下 Õ(√T) 的算法，并证明正则分布下最小最大遗憾为 Õ(T^{3/5})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双边贸易中买卖双方均持有私有估值，中间商需同时向双方报价，且仅能观测到交易是否成功（bandit 式部分反馈），如何在遗憾最小化框架下学习最优固定价格对，并能刻画不同分布假设（对抗、MHR、正则）下的可学习性差异。

Method: 1）对抗设定：结合局部化估计（localized estimation）与基于信息的极小极大构造，设计多项式时间算法；2）随机 MHR 设定：将局部化估计与作用于期望利润负对数的随机凸 bandit 方法结合；3）正则分布设定：通过构造下界实例证明分离结果。

Result: 对抗设定达到 Õ(T^{2/3}) 遗憾，且即使 i.i.d. 估值下也近乎紧（与单边定价率一致）；MHR 分布下达到 Õ(√T) 的近乎紧界；正则分布下最小最大遗憾为 Õ(T^{3/5})，与单边定价正则情形可达 Õ(√T) 形成鲜明对比。

Conclusion: 双边贸易的学习难度显著依赖分布假设：MHR 下可恢复 √T 级速率，而正则分布即使在双边情形也出现 T^{3/5} 的速率下界，揭示了双边反馈机制与单边定价之间的本质差异。

Abstract: Bilateral trade models the task of intermediating between two strategic agents, a seller and a buyer, willing to trade a good for which they hold private valuations. We study this problem from the perspective of a profit-maximizing broker in a regret minimization framework. At each time step, a new seller and buyer arrive and the broker proposes a trading price to each agent. The trade happens if both agents accept, and the profit of the broker is the difference between the price received from the buyer and the one paid to the seller. At the end of each interaction, the learner only observes whether the trade occurred, and its goal is to achieve sublinear regret relative to the best fixed pair of prices in hindsight.
  We start by investigating the adversarial version of the problem, where buyer and seller valuations are generated by an adversary. In this setting, we construct a polynomial-time learning algorithm with a $\tilde O(T^{\frac 23})$ regret rate, which is nearly tight even if the valuations are drawn i.i.d. from independent distributions, thus matching the rate for one-sided pricing. Our adversarial algorithm combines a localized estimation procedure with an information-based minimax construction.
  We then consider valuations drawn i.i.d. from independent distributions satisfying the monotone-hazard-rate (MHR) property and provide a learning algorithm with nearly tight $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret. The algorithm combines localized estimation with a stochastic convex bandit routine applied to the negative logarithm of expected profit. Finally, we complement this result by showing a separation between MHR and regular distributions, proving that the minimax regret rate in the latter setting is $\tilde Θ(T^{\frac 35})$. This last result contrasts with the $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret bound that can be obtained for one-sided pricing with regular distributions.

</details>


### [187] [Information Elicitation by Ordinal Agreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08366)
*Yiling Chen,Shi Feng,Grant Schoenebeck,Fang-Yi Yu*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 提出基于Kendall tau成对一致性奖励的序数同行预测机制，在Bayesian随机序一致模型下证明真实报告随机占优，可容纳异构agent、top-K与子集指派。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序数信息广泛用于同行评审与RLHF，但缺乏可验证的客观真值，使激励相容的elicitation困难。已有同行预测机制未激励agent将丰富的私有信息（如评审）如实压缩为机制要求的粗糙序数报告（如排名）。

Method: 提出一个简单的序数同行预测机制，以Kendall tau度量的成对一致性作为奖励依据；在广泛的Bayesian随机序一致（BSOC）模型类（含Mallows、Thurstone等经典模型）下进行理论分析，并扩展到异构agent、top-K报告及随机抽取同侪打分的子集指派情形。

Result: 证明真实报告是随机占优的，在index-equivariant策略下为强真实；对风险厌恶等非线性效用者也有稳健激励。合成Mallows与Thurstone数据实验及SUSHI真实偏好数据压力测试显示真实支付分布右移，且归一化敏感度在对比基线中最高。

Conclusion: 该机制在无真值验证的序数报告场景下提供了稳健的真实性激励，理论与实验均支持其有效性，适用于评审与LLM偏好对齐等实际场景。

Abstract: Ordinal information is central to tasks ranging from conference peer review to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback for large language models. In many such settings, there is no objective ground truth against which reports can be directly verified, making incentive-compatible elicitation challenging. Peer-prediction mechanisms have been designed to achieve truthful elicitation despite the lack of ground-truth verification. However, existing peer-prediction methods do not provide incentives for agents to truthfully compress rich private information (e.g. reviews) into coarser ordinal reports (e.g. rankings) requested by the mechanisms. We propose a simple ordinal peer-prediction mechanism that rewards agents based on pairwise agreement, measured by Kendall tau. Under a broad class of Bayesian Stochastically Order Consistent models---which includes classical models such as Mallows and Thurstone---we prove that truthful reporting is stochastically dominant, and strongly truthful under index-equivariant strategies. This provides robust incentives even for agents with non-linear utility functions, such as risk aversion. Our mechanism further accommodates heterogeneous agents, top-K reports, and subset assignments, where each agent is scored against one randomly drawn peer. Experiments on synthetic Mallows and Thurstone data, together with a real-data stress test on the SUSHI preference dataset, show right-shifted truthful-payment distributions and the highest normalized sensitivity among tested baselines.

</details>


### [188] [Efficient Kernelized Learning in Polyhedral Games Beyond Full-Information: From Colonel Blotto to Congestion Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.20919)
*Andreas Kontogiannis,Vasilis Pollatos,Gabriele Farina,Panayotis Mertikopoulos,Ioannis Panageas*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 在多面体博弈的部分信息设定下，提出基于核化(kernelization)范式的通用框架，实现仅依赖payoff反馈的高效CCE学习，将运行时间从次优提升到对动作集规模多项式对数级别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多面体博弈（如Colonel Blotto、拥塞博弈）动作数指数级，完整信息设定下已有核化方法高效学习CCE，但更现实的部分信息（仅payoff反馈）设定下现有方法运行时间次优且不实用，需要新的高效算法。

Method: 构建基于核化范式的通用学习框架，将指数级动作集压缩为可多项式处理的核心集合，在部分信息下设计payoff-based学习算法，并应用于Colonel Blotto、图拟阵(graphic matroid)与网络拥塞博弈。

Result: 为上述三类多面体博弈提供了计算高效的payoff-based学习算法，学习CCE的运行时间较已有工作在部分信息设定下显著改进，regret与每轮复杂度对动作集规模呈polylog级别。

Conclusion: 核化范式可成功推广到部分信息设定，为大规模多面体博弈提供了实用且高效的学习CCE的途径，拓宽了该方法适用范围。

Abstract: We examine the problem of efficiently learning coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) in polyhedral games, that is, normal-form games with an exponentially large number of actions per player and an underlying combinatorial structure. Prominent examples of such games are the classical Colonel Blotto and congestion games. To achieve computational efficiency, the learning algorithms must exhibit regret and per-iteration complexity that scale polylogarithmically in the size of the players' action sets. This challenge has recently been addressed in the full-information setting, primarily through the use of kernelization. However, in the case of the realistic, but mathematically challenging, partial-information setting, existing approaches result in suboptimal and impractical runtime complexity to learn CCE. We tackle this limitation by building a framework based on the kernelization paradigm. We apply this framework to prominent examples of polyhedral games -- namely the Colonel Blotto, graphic matroid and network congestion games -- and provide computationally efficient payoff-based learning algorithms, which significantly improve upon prior works in terms of the runtime for learning CCE in these settings.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [189] [TimeArch: A Multi-Agent Approach for Software Architecture Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06921)
*Muhammad Waseem,Mateen Abbasi,Viljami Järvinen,Petrus Lipsanen,Navneet Arora,Kalle Kulonen,Kalle Mäkelä,Tommi Mikkonen,Pekka Abrahamsson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: TimeArch：将软件架构设计显式化为受治理的多智能体生命周期，填补GenAI编码流程中需求与代码之间缺失的架构层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前GenAI编码工作流多为"提示词直出代码"，缺乏连接需求、质量属性、利益相关者、设计决策与实现的架构推理层，导致架构风格、系统分解、权衡分析等被隐含处理，削弱可追溯性、验证与治理。

Method: 提出TimeArch多智能体方法，把架构设计组织为受治理的生命周期而非一次性生成：结合智能体推理与检索增强（RAG）基础，覆盖需求定义、架构设计、验证与保障、交付与演化四个阶段，支持需求捕获、架构驱动因素识别、设计推理、验证及决策记录，形成可追溯流程。

Result: 实现可运行原型（https://sda-assistant.com/），并用多领域、异构输入的典型软件架构设计案例评估其可行性。

Conclusion: 原型验证表明方法初步可行；尚缺工业级实证，未来将开展面向新项目与既有项目的全面工业案例研究，评估TimeArch的实际采纳与应用。

Abstract: Generative AI is making software implementation faster, but not necessarily better architected. Most current GenAI coding workflows move directly from prompts to code, while the architectural reasoning that should connect requirements, quality attributes, stakeholders, design decisions, and implementation remains weakly supported. Architectural styles, system decomposition, tradeoff analysis, quality-attribute decisions, and stakeholder concerns are often left implicit or handled outside the AI-supported workflow. This creates a missing architectural layer between requirements and code, limiting traceability, validation, and governance in GenAI-enabled software development.
  This paper presents TimeArch, a multi-agent approach that makes this architectural layer explicit. TimeArch structures software architecture design as a governed lifecycle rather than a one-shot generation task. It combines agent-based reasoning with retrieval-augmented grounding to support requirement definition, architecture design, validation and assurance, and delivery and evolution. The approach supports requirement capture, architectural driver identification, design reasoning, validation, and decision documentation within a traceable process.
  We demonstrate TimeArch through a working prototype that operationalizes the proposed approach and assess its feasibility using representative software architecture design cases from multiple domains with heterogeneous inputs. As future work, we plan to conduct comprehensive industrial case studies to evaluate the adoption and use of TimeArch in both new and existing software projects.
  A TimeArch demo is available at: https://sda-assistant.com/.
  Keywords: AI-native software architecture; requirements-driven software architecture; architectural reasoning; architecture traceability; architecture validation

</details>


### [190] [Towards Comprehensive Mobile Application Testing for User-centric Feature Coverage via Simulating Real-World Users with Personas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06922)
*Ha Min Son,Huan Ren,Huan Song,Zhe Zhao,Xin Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出以用户关注的功能覆盖率替代Activity覆盖率来评估黑盒移动应用测试的LLM智能体，构建了包含3,012个用户目标功能的数据集与自动化评估管线，并提出ECS框架（探索→关键用户旅程CUJ→人格增强合成评论）以提升功能覆盖，达到64.1%覆盖率，较SOTA提升23.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体做黑盒移动应用测试时多以Activity Coverage衡量，只统计访问到的不同界面比例，无法反映测试是否真正覆盖了用户关心的功能，因此需要（1）可自动度量用户关注功能覆盖的方法，（2）能实现更全面功能覆盖的框架。

Method: 评估侧构建User-Centric Feature Coverage基准：基于真实评论与应用描述人工整理3,012个用户目标功能，并将智能体生成的测试用例与目标功能映射到共享语义空间，用LLM-as-a-judge计算覆盖率。方法侧提出ECS框架：先探索应用，用LLM将探索轨迹转为关键用户旅程（CUJ，含LLM推断的用户意图与可复现测试步骤），再用带人格设定的合成评论聚合多个CUJ以覆盖更复杂功能，模拟真实用户跨多屏积累认知后再写评论的过程。

Result: ECS达到64.1%的功能覆盖率，比SOTA基线高23.8个百分点；覆盖应用描述中72.5%的功能，说明能捕获最突出的功能特征。

Conclusion: 以用户为中心的功能覆盖是比Activity覆盖更有意义的评测指标；ECS通过CUJ语义化与合成评论聚合显著提升覆盖。失败分析表明无状态性（statelessness）与探索可发现性是主要失败原因，为后续研究指明方向。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for black-box mobile application testing, where the ultimate goal is the comprehensive coverage of the features users rely on. However, most existing studies focus on Activity Coverage, which measures the proportion of distinct application screens visited during a test session but does not directly measure whether agents actually test the features users care about. To address this, we focus on (1) how to automatically measure whether a testing framework covers the features users care about, and (2) how to design a framework that achieves more comprehensive feature coverage. To answer (1), we introduce the User-Centric Feature Coverage benchmark, which consists of two components: a manually crafted dataset of 3,012 user-centric target features based on real reviews and app descriptions, and an automated evaluation pipeline that translates agent-generated test cases and target features into a shared semantic space, then uses an LLM-as-a-judge to compute coverage. To answer (2), we introduce ECS (Exploration, Critical User Journeys, and Synthetic Reviews). ECS is a framework that explores the application, then uses an LLM to convert exploration traces into Critical User Journeys (CUJs) to bring the semantic meaning of the trace closer to a distinct feature. Each CUJ consists of an LLM-inferred user intent paired with reproducible test steps. ECS then aggregates multiple CUJs using persona-augmented synthetic reviews to capture more complex features, simulating real users who build knowledge of an application across multiple screens before writing a review. ECS achieves 64.1% feature coverage, a 23.8% gain over the state-of-the-art baseline, and covers 72.5% of features in app descriptions, capturing the most prominent features. Our failure analysis shows statelessness and exploration discoverability as main reasons of failures, providing future directions.

</details>


### [191] [A Multi-Modal Robotic Framework for Physical GUI Interaction Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06939)
*Davi Freitas*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出RFNIT——一个多模态、完全非侵入式的机器人框架，通过外部视觉感知+LLM推理+机械臂执行真实触屏操作，在无需instrumentation或ADB的情况下对手机GUI进行物理交互测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动应用自动化测试在需复现真实用户交互时仍困难。现有方法（如DLD、R-DLD）虽能检测活动重启导致的数据丢失，但依赖系统级访问（instrumentation、ADB控制），在真实设备上适用性受限，因此需要一种完全非侵入的测试方式。

Method: RFNIT集成了三部分：基于视觉的感知模块（外部相机图像+OCR文本的多模态识别GUI元素）、LLM驱动的推理代理（决定测试决策）、以及可执行触摸/滑动/输入手势的机器人执行器；通过外部传感感知设备状态并执行物理操作，实现类人动作且保持可复现性与执行精度。

Result: 初步结果显示，RFNIT能从外部相机输入准确识别按钮、文本框和虚拟键盘，视觉检测准确率超过85%。

Conclusion: RFNIT展示了非侵入式物理GUI交互测试的可行性；后续工作将聚焦提升长时间测试中的鲁棒性、可重复性和GUI状态覆盖度。

Abstract: Automated testing of mobile applications remains challenging when realistic user interactions must be reproduced and GUI behavior verified without relying on invasive mechanisms such as instrumentation or ADB-level control. Existing approaches, including DLD and R-DLD, detect data loss triggered by activity restarts but still depend on system-level access, which limits their applicability on real devices.
  This doctoral research proposes RFNIT, a multi-modal, fully non-invasive robotic framework for physical GUI interaction testing on smartphones. RFNIT supports end-to-end automation by perceiving the device state through external sensing and executing physical interactions, enabling human-like actions while preserving reproducibility and execution accuracy.
  The framework integrates a vision-based perception module, an LLM-driven reasoning agent, and a robotic actuator capable of performing touch, swipe, and typing gestures. Multimodal data, including external camera images and OCR-extracted text, are combined to identify GUI elements and guide subsequent testing decisions.
  Preliminary results indicate that RFNIT accurately recognizes buttons, text fields, and virtual keyboards from external camera input, achieving over 85\% visual detection accuracy. Ongoing and future work will focus on improving robustness, repeatability, and coverage of GUI states during long-running testing sessions.

</details>


### [192] [Beyond the Agent Harness: Boundary Criteria for Software-Factory Orchestration - A Single-Operator Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06946)
*Lei Hua*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一套"边界准则"用于判定一个机制或故障应归属哪一层（agent harness、factory harness、领域层或基础设施/模型），并在真实故障与已发表系统上开发与冻结准则、做双人编码一致性检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期系统在编码智能体外层又增加了把多次运行组织成持续交付的层面，但缺乏判定某机制或某故障属于哪一层的规则，导致层级归属混乱。

Method: 基于"一次运行(run)"的操作性定义给出准则：仅限单次运行的机制归 agent harness；协调多次运行、跨运行传递状态或由运行结果更新的归 factory harness；需随应用领域变化的归领域层；另设两项残余测试判定基础设施与模型原因。对故障分三个字段编码：缺陷起源、哪个控制未拦截、何处修复，并要求"正面证据"才归因于环境。在单个运营者六个项目管线中的已记录故障及三个已发表系统的 26 个组件上开发准则，随后冻结，由同族两个模型编码者对 46 个留出单元的相同描述独立编码。

Result: 机制层面 26/26 完全一致；故障字段 20 个中一致 18–19 个（kappa 0.86–0.93）。但两编码者各有每字段 20 例中 8–13 例记为"未定/未记录"，且各标记约一半单元为歧义（多为信息缺失）。修订版把机制分类与故障归因分离可解决规则冲突，但敏感性重编码一致性下降（kappa 0.78–0.93）。

Conclusion: 一致性既不等同于准确性也不等同于有用性，且尚未测试人类编码者；案例证据与七条假设作为初步结果报告。

Abstract: Several recent systems add a layer above the coding-agent harness that organises many agent runs into continuous delivery. The existence of such a layer is not our contribution. What is missing is a rule for deciding which layer a mechanism or a failure belongs to. We propose boundary criteria based on an operational definition of a run. A mechanism confined to one run belongs to the agent harness. One that coordinates runs, hands state from one run to a later one, or is updated from run outcomes belongs to a factory harness. One that must change with the application domain belongs to the domain layer. Two residual tests assign infrastructure and model causes. For failures, we code where the defect originated, which control failed to stop it, and where it was fixed as three separate fields, and we require positive evidence before attributing a failure to the environment. We developed the criteria on documented failures from a single operator's pipeline serving six projects and on 26 components of three published systems. We then froze them and had two model coders of the same family apply them to the same descriptions of 46 held-out units. They agreed on all 26 mechanism layers and on 18-19 of 20 incident fields (kappa 0.86-0.93), but both coders recorded the incident as undetermined or unrecorded in 8-13 of the 20 cases per field, and each flagged half of all units as ambiguous, mostly for missing information. The check exposed conflicts in the rules; a revision that separates mechanism classification from incident attribution resolves them but, in a sensitivity re-coding, agreed less (kappa 0.78-0.93). Agreement here is neither accuracy nor usefulness, and human coders have not yet been tested. Case evidence and seven hypotheses are reported as preliminary.

</details>


### [193] [How Python Audio Libraries Change Across Releases: Module Structure and Documentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06947)
*Mateusz Modrzejewski,Michał Rokita,Łukasz Neumann*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文挖掘56个机器学习用音频Python库（49个包、1,395个版本）的导入图与20,864条release note，用三个开放权重LLM加两名人工编码员对齐标注，分析模块结构变化与发行说明的覆盖情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 升级Python音频库的开发者需要知道所导入代码发生了什么变化、发行说明是否如实记录；现有研究分别挖掘release notes与破坏性变更，但尚未把音频库的模块结构与文档放在一起研究。

Method: 构建49个包在1,395个版本上的导入图，与20,864条release note/changelog条目对齐；用三个开放权重语言模型标注，并由两名人工编码员校验匹配结果。

Result: (1) 86.1%的相邻版本对顶层模块集合不变，模块文件集合不变的比例为61.4%；(2) 主版本号变更引发顶层变化的频率是其他版本的5.2倍，major与0.x minor合计占观测变化的48.7%；(3) 删除模块的版本中，词法匹配下notes仅提及8.9%的删除单元，人工核查后估计为4.3%；(4) notes越长，含“结构性”条目的概率越高，且同长度区间内存在模块删除的版本该比例更高。

Conclusion: 音频库模块结构总体稳定，但破坏性变更集中于主版本号与0.x次版本；发行说明对模块删除的记录严重不足。作者计划公开对齐数据集与流水线。

Abstract: Developers who upgrade a Python audio library need to know what changed in the code they import and whether the release notes say so. Release notes and breaking changes have been mined for general software, but the module structure of audio libraries and its documentation have not been studied together. We mine 56 audio repositories used in machine learning workflows: the import graph of 49 packages at 1,395 releases, joined to 20,864 release-note and changelog entries, labeled by three open-weight language models and checked against two human coders. We find that (1) the set of a package's top-level modules is unchanged in 86.1% of consecutive release pairs, while the set of module files is unchanged in 61.4%. (2) A major increment changes the top level 5.2 times as often as another increment, and major and 0.x minor increments together account for 48.7% of the observed changes. (3) When a release removes modules, its notes name 8.9% of the removal units under a lexical match, an estimated 4.3% after a hand check of the matches. (4) Longer notes are more likely to contain an entry labeled as structural, and within each length band this proportion is also higher for releases with module removals. We intend to release the aligned dataset and the pipeline

</details>


### [194] [When Does Combining Software-Effort Estimates Help? Evidence from Four Public Project Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06948)
*Azzeddine Ihsine,Sara Ihsine*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在四个软件工作量数据集上，用三种模型（含Kitchenham中的人工估计）比较五种组合规则：与主导性人工估计合池会显著损害精度，而在其余数据集上增益虽存在但统计上不显著，因此组合是条件性决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合估计可降低个体预测误差，但也可能稀释异常准确的估计器或重复成员间的共同错误。作者希望量化这两种相反效应在软件工作量估计中的实际表现，并检验组合规则是否真的带来可靠收益。

Method: 使用四个档案数据集（Kitchenham 145、Desharnais 77、China 499、Maxwell 63），每数据集做100次重复的70/30训练/测试划分。三种常规模型（参数回归、类比、随机森林）相互组合，Kitchenham中再与记录的人工估计组合。基于折外校准误差采用五种规则：等权、逆MSE加权、非负单纯形组合、有符号Bates-Granger加权、带协方差收缩的Bates-Granger；所有预处理均在训练折内学习。

Result: 模型误差相关性为0.54–0.97。Kitchenham中人工估计占主导：等权使平均测试log-MAE从0.239升至0.455，经修正重采样t检验与Holm校正仍显著；单纯形规则仅使其升至0.250。其余三个数据集上所有规则均降低平均log-MAE（1.3%–8.6%），收缩BG在100次划分中分别有75、83、83次优于校准选出的单模型，但考虑重复划分重叠后均不显著。Desharnais按完成年份切分时，等权略变差、逆MSE接近基线，单纯形与收缩规则仍保持约5%的平均增益。

Conclusion: 组合相关的工作量估计是有条件的决策：在存在主导性估计源时，朴素合池的损害明确且显著；其他情形下收益小且不确定，不能默认组合必然优于单模型。

Abstract: Combining estimates can reduce individual prediction errors, but an ensemble may also dilute an unusually accurate estimator or repeat errors shared by its members. We study these competing effects on four archival software-effort datasets (Kitchenham: 145 projects, Desharnais: 77, China: 499, Maxwell: 63) with 100 repeated 70/30 training and test partitions per dataset. Three conventional models (parametric regression, analogy, and random forest) are combined with each other and, in Kitchenham, with a recorded human estimate. Out-of-fold calibration errors drive five combination rules: equal weighting, inverse-MSE weighting, a nonnegative simplex combination, signed Bates-Granger weighting, and Bates-Granger with covariance shrinkage. All preprocessing is learned within training folds. Model-error correlations range from 0.54 to 0.97. In Kitchenham, the human estimate dominates: equal weighting raises mean test log-MAE from 0.239 to 0.455, a loss that remains significant under a corrected resampled t-test with Holm adjustment, whereas the simplex rule limits the increase to 0.250. In Desharnais, China, and Maxwell, every rule lowers mean log-MAE (by 1.3 to 8.6%) and BG with shrinkage beats the calibration-selected individual on 75, 83, and 83 of 100 splits, but none of these gains is statistically distinguishable from zero once the overlap between repeated splits is accounted for. On a completion-year split of Desharnais, equal weighting becomes slightly worse and inverse-MSE is near the individual baseline, while simplex and shrinkage retain mean gains of about 5%. Combining correlated effort estimates is therefore a conditional decision: the harm of naive pooling next to a dominant source is clear, while the benefit elsewhere is small and uncertain.

</details>


### [195] [KG-AST for Cheaper CI/CD: Budgeted Test Selection and AI Bug Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06950)
*Henry Yeung*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: KG-AST 用 git 历史和代码图特征在重型测试或 AI 审查前给每个提交打分，把预算优先分配给高风险提交，并只给 AI 审查器变更附近的图切片。跨 11 种语言 155 个项目的单一跨语言模型，在最危险 20% 提交上覆盖 49-64% 的引入 bug 提交（随机为 20%，最大改动优先为 40-55%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CI 与 AI 辅助审查对每个 commit 花费相同的预算，但真正引入 bug 的 commit 很少。作者希望先估计提交风险，使有限的重型测试与 AI 审查预算优先投向高风险提交，并缩减 AI 审查器看到的上下文。

Method: KG-AST 结合 git 历史与代码图（code-graph）特征，在重型测试/AI 审查之前对每个 commit 给出风险分数；并向 AI 审查器只提供变更附近的图切片（graph slice）。实验在 11 种语言、155 个开源项目上评估，采用在其他项目上训练的单一跨语言模型，与随机选择和“最大改动优先”基线比较，并考察训练项目数量、特征丰富度、标签清洗等因素的影响。

Result: 在高风险 20% 上重型测试可覆盖 49-64% 的引入 bug 提交，随机为 20%，最大改动优先为 40-55%；每种语言都优于最大改动基线 3.8-13.2 个百分点。20 个 Java 项目在 20% 预算下提升 15.1 点（64.6% vs 49.5%，95% 区间 +11.6 至 +18.4），20 个项目中有 19 个胜出。约 12 个训练项目即够用；更丰富的特征、调参和更干净标签未带来提升。只看 diff 的 AI 审查器精确发现 26% 的后续修复缺陷（带图上下文为 32%），其未匹配后续修复的发现中约一半被独立 AI 评判认为真实。静态调用图选择器仅运行约 8% 的测试套件，却在 67 个修复提交中的 85% 里包含了为修复新写的测试。Poincare 嵌入在此无可测收益，提交风险 AUC、bug 审查与严重度排序持平或更差。

Conclusion: 基于历史与代码图的提交风险排序能显著提高 CI 与 AI 审查预算的效率，且跨语言、跨项目可迁移，所需训练项目数量少。但标签存在噪声、预算指标假设重型测试能捕获其覆盖的 bug，且未实测 CI 分钟数；Poincare 嵌入无增益。

Abstract: Continuous integration and AI-assisted review spend the same budget on every commit, although few commits introduce bugs. We study KG-AST, which scores each commit risk from git history and code-graph features before heavy tests or AI review run, so the budget goes to the riskiest commits first, and which hands the AI reviewer only a graph slice around the change. On 155 open-source projects in 11 languages, a single cross-language model trained on other projects ranks commits so that heavy testing of the riskiest 20% covers 49-64% of bug-introducing commits depending on the language, against 20% for random selection and 40-55% for testing the biggest change first.
  Every language beats the biggest-change baseline, by 3.8 to 13.2 points. In 20 Java projects the gain at a 20% budget is 15.1 points (64.6% vs 49.5%, 95% interval +11.6 to +18.4), and the model wins in 19 of the 20 projects. About twelve training projects suffice; richer features, tuning and cleaner labels did not help. An AI reviewer that sees only a commit's diff finds 26% of later-fixed defects exactly (32% with graph context), and about half of its findings that did not match a later fix were judged real by independent AI judges. A static call-graph selector runs about 8% of a test suite while including a test written for the fix in 85% of 67 fix commits. The Poincare embedding used in our retrieval work adds nothing measurable here: commit-risk AUC, bug review and severity ranking are unchanged or worse. The labels are noisy and the budget metric assumes a heavy test catches the bug it covers; no CI minutes were measured.

</details>


### [196] [Operationalizing Responsible AI in MLOps and ML Production: A Systematic Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06961)
*Hinduja Nirujan,Siddhartha Paudel,Gouri Ginde*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过系统文献综述，梳理了在ML生产与MLOps中将负责任AI原则落地为工程机制的研究现状，指出证据分散、缺乏闭环整合是核心空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 负责任AI原则被广泛讨论，但如何在MLOps和ML生产工作流中转化为具体机制尚不清楚，需要系统性证据综合。

Method: 系统性文献综述，覆盖监测与运行时保障、审计与合规、ML生命周期集成、可追溯/溯源/文档四大主题，综合相关研究。

Result: 文献呈现从抽象伦理原则转向工程机制的趋势（漂移监测、运行时检查、审计日志、溯源记录、证据包、治理门禁、policy-as-code、模型护照、合规文档等）；但证据基础不均衡，多为架构或原型，缺乏真实生产环境与纵向运行的评估。

Conclusion: 识别出"集成式、可产出证据的负责任MLOps"这一核心空白——现有机制仅孤立地检测、记录或治理生命周期局部，未将运行时信号、生命周期溯源、人类问责与合规证据连成闭环；呼吁未来软件工程研究走向可追溯、可评估、运行集成的负责任AI支持。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled systems are increasingly deployed in operational environments where machine learning (ML) models interact with changing data, users, infrastructure, and organizational processes. While Responsible AI principles are widely discussed, less is known about how these principles are translated into concrete mechanisms within Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) and ML production workflows. This paper reports a systematic literature review of studies that operationalize Responsible AI in ML production. The review synthesizes evidence across monitoring and runtime assurance, audit and compliance, ML lifecycle integration, and traceability/provenance/documentation. Across the final study set, the literature shows a shift from abstract ethical principles toward engineering mechanisms such as drift monitoring, runtime checks, audit logs, provenance records, evidence bundles, governance gates, policy-as-code, model passports, and compliance-oriented documentation. However, the evidence base remains uneven: many studies propose architectures or prototypes, while fewer evaluate the mechanisms in realistic production settings, longitudinal operations, or organizational governance workflows. The review identifies a central gap around integrated, evidence-producing Responsible MLOps: current mechanisms often detect, document, or govern isolated parts of the ML lifecycle, but rarely connect runtime signals, ML lifecycle provenance, human accountability, and compliance evidence into closed operational loops. These findings motivate future software engineering research on traceable, evaluable, and operationally integrated Responsible AI support for ML production.

</details>


### [197] [When Can Self-Play Fix a False Belief? Answer Keys, Pass Bands and Replacement Rules in an Execution-Grounded Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06965)
*Nirdesh Chauhan,Dushyant Rajput,Siddharth Kosaraju*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文检验"可执行的代码作为答案键"的自博弈循环究竟能消除哪些错误信念，发现执行键能显著纠正被植入的规格误读，但会带来新的替换性错误规则，且"仅诊断项"指标会漏掉这些错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自博弈循环（模型写任务、生成答案键、在自己的匹配解上训练）常因答案键来自执行代码而被称为"有依据的"。但尚不清楚这种循环究竟能移除哪些错误信念、是否可靠。

Method: 用 Qwen3-4B-Base 做输出预测任务的专家迭代自博弈，变化答案键来源：生成器自身代码执行、无错误的"未植入"模型实现，并通过微调植入两种规格误读（"at most n"读成< n；"第k小"读成0索引），追踪自然信念变化；采用"pass band"（8次中解出1-7次）筛选任务。

Result: 执行生成器自身代码得到的键在每次审计任务上都编码了"at most"误读，训练后真值率从未超过0.03；而未植入模型（教师）的键在四轮中三次将真值率提升到0.23-0.58。执行键在两个种子下都明显降低了自然运行时信念错误。但纠正伴随的替换规则会在旧信念本来答对的邻近项上失败：一致出现的稳健案例是"at most"修正后，模型越来越多地把不存在的最近上限值也计入（第3轮对照样本过计0.18-0.38），而该情形植入生成器几乎从不生成（10,924任务中仅4个）。询问该情形时，植入生成器在2,061个可检查任务中一个也没写，而未训练未植入模型一轮内达27%。两类生成器常把请求移进规格（"上限本身不计入"），而去相关键会遵循规格。

Conclusion: "可执行键=正确键"并不充分：正确答案不等于有效教学信号，pass band 会筛掉几乎全部纠错任务；执行键能纠正部分信念但引入新错误规则（如过计不存在值），而这些恰恰被仅诊断项指标遗漏。需要关注替换性错误与规格搬移现象。

Abstract: Self-play loops in which a model writes tasks, derives an answer key and trains on its own matching solutions are often called grounded when the key comes from executing code. We ask which false beliefs such a loop removes. We run expert-iteration self-play with Qwen3-4B-Base on output-prediction tasks, vary the source of the answer key, and track natural beliefs about Python semantics and two misreadings of task specifications planted by fine-tuning ("at most n" read as < n; "the k-th smallest" read as 0-indexed). Executing the generator's own code gave a key that encoded the "at most" misreading on every audited task, and training on it never raised the truth rate above 0.03. A key from an implementation by the unplanted model, a teacher without the error, raised it to 0.23-0.58 after three rounds in four runs. A correct key is not sufficient: the pass band, which keeps tasks solved 1-7 times of 8, admits almost no corrective task while a belief is held on nearly every sample. Execution keys sharply reduced both natural runtime beliefs on diagnostic items in both seeds. Corrections came with replacement rules that fail on neighbouring items the old belief got right. The robust case, present in all four spec runs, is that after the "at most" fix the model increasingly counts the nearest value above a limit that is absent from the list (overcount 0.18-0.38 of control samples at round 3), a case our planted generators almost never wrote (4 of 10,924 tasks); diagnostic-only metrics miss it. Asked for those cases, the planted generator wrote none in 2,061 checkable tasks, against 27% for the untrained unplanted model in one round. Both generators often moved the request into the specification instead ("the cap itself does not count"), and a decorrelated key follows the specification.

</details>


### [198] [Call-Level Revision Contracts for LLM-Authored Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06967)
*Chenyang Jiang,Benyang Pan,Puqu Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文为模型编写的持久化工作流提出"修订契约"：以调用点、扇出位置与出现次数构成稳定结构身份，冻结已提交调用表达式，用静态门与运行时摘要防止已付费结果被篡改或重复付费。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持久化执行引擎回放录制历史但不比较 activity 负载。当模型修复中途失败的工作流时，要么为已成功的调用再付一次费，要么接受负载已变的旧结果，两者都不可接受。

Method: 定义每类能力调用的结构身份（callsite + fanout 位置 + 出现计数），该身份在调用保持不变的改写下稳定，形成冻结前缀，冻结单元是调用表达式。静态门在容器启动前拒绝会改变已提交调用的改写；运行时摘要阻止已提交身份处负载变化；出现台账命名重复付费负载。

Result: 证明在三个假设下，门通过的候选会重放其调用的每个已提交调用、只执行新工作并报告跳过的身份；并证明不存在既满足重定位不变性又无误复用的本地身份，故调用点身份把重定位转为付费前停止。媒体工作流上22个门通过的修复重放258个已提交身份且无重复，六路扇出由12次付费降为7次；12任务客服研究在两个模型上应用了同样的身份、重放与边界检查。

Conclusion: 调用点式结构身份可为模型改写的工作流提供可证明的重放正确性与付费节约，是持久化执行中可行的修订契约机制。

Abstract: Durable execution engines replay a recorded history and do not compare activity payloads. When a model repairs a workflow that failed partway through, it must either pay again for calls that succeeded or accept a recorded result whose payload changed. We define a revision contract for workflows whose orchestration code is written by a model. Each capability call carries a structural identity built from its callsite, its fanout position, and its occurrence count, and the identity stays stable under rewrites that leave the call in place, so committed identities form a frozen prefix. The frozen unit is the call expression, and the surrounding code stays writable. A static gate rejects a rewrite that would change a committed call before a container starts. A runtime digest stops a changed payload at a committed identity, and an occurrence ledger names a repeated paid payload. Under three assumptions, a candidate the gate accepts replays every committed call it invokes, executes only new work, and reports the identities it skips. No local identity is both relocation-invariant and free of wrong reuse, so callsite identity turns a relocation into a pre-spend stop. On media workflows, 22 gate-passed repairs replay 258 committed identities with no duplicate, and a live six-way fanout makes seven paid calls instead of twelve. A 12-task customer-support study applies the same identity, replay, and boundary checks on two models.

</details>


### [199] [An LLM-Orchestrated Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Verifying Diagnostic Signal Reachability in Electronic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07040)
*Heba Jaradat,Mohammed-Khalil Ghali,Saurabh Kulkarni,Rohan Kulkarni,Sangwon Yoon*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NetFlow-DSR：用LLM负责设备语义解析与流程编排、用确定性图引擎在权威网表上验证，检测电路板级诊断信号可观测性（DSR），在5块量产板上421条信号上把F1从0.578提升到0.944，精度与特异度均为100%，且每个"可观测"判定都附带可审计的证明路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心大规模部署下，诊断信号能否被BMC/CPLD等管理控制器观测（DSR）是现场可诊断性的关键，但现有验证基本靠人工，逐条信号跨原理图页、重命名网络、串联器件和监控器件手工追踪。LLM虽被寄予厚望，却在结构化连通性推理上不可靠，容易"过度声称"，从而悄悄掩盖罕见的覆盖缺口。

Method: 神经-符号框架：LLM只负责流程编排与设备角色判定（主要依据器件型号族与库引脚名，仅在歧义器件时查规格书）；引脚方向性从设计库读取；确定性图引擎在权威网表上做连通性验证。流程含三步：识别诊断网络、对重命名网络片段做规范化、在可接纳性图上做以控制器为种子且带电源感知的BFS（计入器件中介的监控关系）。每个判定输出一张可审计的"trace card"，其证明路径即证据。

Result: 在AI平台5块量产板、421条专家标注信号上，三阶段消融使合并F1由0.578升至0.944；因"可观测"判定必须附证明路径，验证器构造上可靠，评测数据中精度与特异度均为100%。在系统控制模块上的跨模型实验中，三种LLM下精度保持100%，召回率随各模型的器件语义抽取能力变化。

Conclusion: 精度取决于网表接地的验证器和正确的设备语义，而非任何单一LLM；将LLM限制在语义抽取、把结构推理交给确定性引擎，可在保证可靠性的同时实现自动化DSR验证，适合大规模数据中心场景。

Abstract: Diagnostic Signal Reachability (DSR) captures whether board-level health signals are observable by management controllers, including baseboard management controllers (BMCs), complex programmable logic devices (CPLDs), and other smart controllers. Verifying DSR is essential for field diagnosability in datacenter fleets, where one design is deployed at massive scale, yet it remains largely manual, since each signal is traced by hand across schematic sheets, renamed nets, series components, and monitoring devices. Large language models (LLMs) are attractive but unreliable at structural connectivity reasoning, where over-claiming can silently hide a rare coverage gap. We present NetFlow-DSR, a neuro-symbolic framework in which an LLM orchestrates the DSR pipeline and resolves device roles mainly from part-name families and library pin names, consulting specifications only for ambiguous parts. Pin directionality is read from the design library, and deterministic graph engines verify connectivity over the authoritative netlist. The pipeline detects diagnostic nets, canonicalizes renamed net fragments, and performs controller-seeded, power-aware breadth-first search over an admissibility graph that credits device-mediated monitoring. Each verdict carries an auditable trace card whose proof path is the witness. Across five production boards from an AI platform, covering 421 expert-graded signals, a three-stage ablation improves pooled F1 from 0.578 to 0.944. Because a monitored verdict is emitted only with a proof path, the verifier is sound by construction, and precision and specificity were 100% in the evaluated data. In a cross-model study on the system-controller module, precision remained 100% across three LLMs while recall tracked each model's device-semantic extraction. Precision therefore depends on the netlist-grounded verifier and correct device semantics rather than on any single LLM.

</details>


### [200] [Automatic Assistance to Reduce Information Overload during Software Issue Report Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07109)
*Salma Begum Tamanna,Gias Uddin,Junaed Younus Khan,Lan Xia,Longyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 iSum，一个自动对 issue 报告中的信息类型进行分类与摘要的工具，提供开发者视图和管理者视图，并通过实证、用户研究和可行性研究验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代问题跟踪系统中的 issue 报告往往冗长且包含多方利益相关者的多样讨论，开发者难以快速分析，访谈显示开发者急需自动化的信息分类和摘要技术。

Method: 设计 iSum，包含两种视图：开发者视图输入单个 issue 报告并输出可视化的信息摘要；管理者视图输入项目下全部 issue 报告，展示不同信息类型的普遍性与趋势。通过三项研究进行评估。

Result: 1）在两个基准上，信息类型检测的 F1 平均比 SOTA 基线高 11–13%；2）30 名开发者的任务型用户研究表明，相比人工检查，使用 iSum 提升了效率与准确性；3）可行性研究表明 iSum 对开发者和管理者的 issue 理解与趋势监控均有用。

Conclusion: iSum 能够有效地对 issue 报告进行信息分类与摘要，提升开发者在 issue 探索中的效率与准确性，并对开发与管理任务具有实际价值。

Abstract: Modern issue tracking systems are used to log an issue and track it from its inception to closure. Issue reports with diverse discussions from stakeholders can be large and verbose, making them challenging to analyze quickly. Our developer interviews revealed that they struggled with the diverse information in issue reports and demanded automated techniques to classify and summarize information. We designed a tool, iSum (issue summarizer), that helps with the automatic classification and summarization of information types discussed in issue reports. The summarizer offers two views: 1. Developer View takes an issue report as input and outputs visualized summaries of information in the report. 2. Manager View takes a suite of all issue reports under a given software project as inputs and shows the prevalence and trends of different information types across the reports. We evaluated iSum through three studies. 1. In an empirical study over two benchmarks, iSum offers, on average, 11-13% higher F1-scores than state-of-the-art baselines to detect information types. 2. We conducted a user study in task-based setup with 30 developers to determine iSum's effectiveness in issue exploration scenarios. Results showed increased productivity and accuracy with iSum compared to manual inspection. 3. We assessed iSum's feasibility for development and management tasks. It proved useful to both developers and project managers for issue comprehension and trend monitoring.

</details>


### [201] [Multi-step SWE: Can Coding Agents Keep Building on Their Own Code Over Long Horizons?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07166)
*Xiangkai Zeng,Zheng Liu,Zihao Lin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出Multi-step SWE，一个针对编码agent的长期多步基准，包含69个任务，每个任务是由5-15个相互依赖步骤组成的链，基于agent自身前序代码持续推进。最强前沿模型解决率仅18.5%，38个任务无人解决，凸显长程工程能力缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中开发者会让编码agent在它自己写的代码上反复扩展、升级和优化，任务具有长程依赖；但现有基准大多一次只评估单个任务，无法反映早期设计决策和错误向后传递的影响。

Method: 构建Multi-step SWE基准：69个软件工程任务，每个为单代码库上5-15个依赖步骤的链条；每步都是完整的多小时工程请求，且从agent前序产出代码出发。任务覆盖四类工程工作和九种语言，包含从零构建与已有开源代码库，并以既有权威来源同时定义指令与验证器。

Result: 在九个前沿模型上评测，最强模型解决率仅18.5%；69个任务中有38个未被任何模型解决。

Conclusion: 长程多步软件工程是当前前沿模型仍未攻克的难题，基准已公开于 https://multistepswe.com。

Abstract: Developers rarely give a coding agent a single request: they ask it to build a component and then to extend, upgrade, and optimize it, each time on code the agent itself wrote. Most benchmarks, however, score one task at a time. We introduce Multi-step SWE, a long-horizon benchmark of 69 software engineering tasks, each a chain of 5-15 dependent steps on a single codebase. Every step is a complete, multi-hour engineering request that starts from the code the agent produced in the preceding steps, so early design decisions and errors carry forward. The tasks span four families of engineering work and nine languages, include both from-scratch builds and existing open-source codebases, and ground every step in an existing source of truth that defines both the instruction and its verifier. Across nine frontier models, the strongest model reaches a solve rate of only 18.5%, and 38 of the 69 tasks are not solved by any model. We release Multi-step SWE publicly at https://multistepswe.com.

</details>


### [202] [SeVerus: Context-Aware, Gamified Benchmarking for Rust Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07194)
*Álvaro F. Silva,Martim Afonso,Nuno Saavedra,Emily First,Alexandra Mendes,João F. Ferreira*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SEVERUS 是一个上下文感知的基准生成技术，将 Verus 验证任务组织成游戏化的"任务(quests)"与"关卡(levels)"，通过逐步撤除证明上下文来评估编码智能体自主发现和证明辅助引理的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Verus 基准通常直接提供完成证明所需的辅助引理，而实际场景中这些引理必须由智能体自行发现和证明；现有基准因此无法刻画这一更难、更真实的挑战。

Method: 利用已验证项目中原有的证明依赖关系，为每个验证目标构造一个任务，并逐步移除证明上下文生成不同关卡：从只需补全单个缺失引理，到无任何辅助引理需证明目标。独立检查器拒绝可执行代码修改、规格弱化和不健全证明构造；用噪声二分搜索估计智能体能稳定求解的最高关卡。

Result: 在六个开源 Verus 项目上生成 819 个任务、共 10,095 个关卡。实验（Codex 的 GPT-6 Sol/Luna，Claude Code 的 Sonnet 4.6）显示：随证明上下文撤除，成功率下降、成本上升；最强智能体解出 60 个抽样任务的最终关卡中的 52 个，但仅能稳定求解 35% 的关卡，失败集中于较长任务；GPT-6 Sol 的成功证明很少复现被撤除的引理，而采用替代证明分解。

Conclusion: 通过系统性改变证明上下文，SEVERUS 为构建能持续挑战更强编码智能体的验证基准奠定了基础。

Abstract: Coding agents achieve high success rates on existing benchmarks for Verus, a verifier for Rust programs. These benchmarks typically provide the auxiliary lemmas needed to complete a proof. In practice, however, such lemmas must be discovered and proved. To capture this challenge, we present SEVERUS, a context-aware technique to generate Verus benchmarks that organizes verification tasks into quests, each divided into levelsin a gamified manner. Using the original proof dependencies in verified projects, SEVERUS constructs one quest per verification target and progressively removes proof context to create individual levels. These levels range from the easiest, requiring completing only a single missing lemma, to the hardest, requiring proving the target without any supporting lemmas. An independent checker rejects changes to executable code, weakened specifications, and unsound proof constructs. A noisy binary search estimates the highest level that an agent can solve reliably. Applied to six open-source Verus projects, SEVERUS generates 819 quests comprising 10,095 levels. Experiments with Codex using GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, and with Claude Code using Sonnet 4.6, show that success decreases and cost increases as proof context is withdrawn. The strongest agent solves the final level of 52 of 60 sampled quests, yet can only reliably solve 35% of their levels, with failures concentrated in longer quests. Successful GPT-6 Sol proofs rarely reproduce the withheld lemmas, instead, using alternative proof decompositions. By systematically varying proof context, SEVERUS provides a foundation for constructing verification benchmarks that can continue to challenge increasingly capable coding agents.

</details>


### [203] [How Should Agents See Code? Rethinking Code Representations for Agentic Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07286)
*Melika Sepidband,Jiho Shin,Song Wang,Hadi Hemmati*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究五种基于代码地图的表示工作流（AST、调用图、模块依赖、文档增强检索、混合）对LLM智能体在仓库级软件工程任务中检索行为、成功率、token用量与延迟的影响，发现其益处因任务而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体多以原始文件、词法搜索和shell命令访问仓库，把代码当作纯文本处理，缺乏结构化仓库视图。作者希望将"代码表示工作流"作为设计变量，系统考察不同仓库视图如何影响智能体行为与成本。

Method: 对比五种地图式工作流（抽象语法树、调用图、模块依赖、文档增强搜索、混合），每种向智能体提供可查询的仓库地图；以Claude Code + Haiku 4.5为对象，在四个仓库级任务上对照原始工具基线：LinuxFLBench故障定位、SWE-bench Pro代码生成与修复、SWT-bench测试生成、SecBench安全补丁。

Result: 定位是瓶颈时工作流省token效果显著：LinuxFLBench上recall@10全部提升（0.757–0.829 vs 0.717），token降25–39%；SWE-bench Pro解决率接近基线（44.3–50.6% vs 49.0%），token降17–26%；SecBench上Callgraph补丁解决率最高（34.3% vs 28.9%）但所有工作流延迟增加；SWT-bench上Hybrid与Docs复现测试率最高（47.8%/47.2% vs 44.7%），但token更多、耗时更长。

Conclusion: 基于地图的工作流同时改变了智能体"看什么"和"花多少"，但在补丁/测试编写为决定性环节时成功收益有限，其优势是任务依赖的而非普适的。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for repository-level software engineering tasks. However, most agents still access repositories through raw files, lexical search, and shell commands, treating code primarily as text. This paper investigates map-based code-representation workflows as a design variable in agentic software engineering, examining how different repository views change agents' retrieval behavior, task success, token use, and latency.
  In this paper, we study five code-representation workflows: abstract syntax trees, call graphs, module dependencies, documentation-enriched search, and a hybrid workflow that combines them. Each workflow exposes a repository map that the agent can query during a task. We evaluate Claude Code with Haiku 4.5 against a raw-tool baseline on four repository-level tasks: fault localization with LinuxFLBench, repository-level code generation and repair with SWE-bench Pro, test generation with SWT-bench, and security patching with SecBench.
  The results show that representation workflows are most useful as token-saving tools when localization is the bottleneck, while their success gains narrow when the decisive step is patch or test authoring. On LinuxFLBench, all five workflows improve recall@10 over the baseline (0.757-0.829 vs. 0.717) and reduce token usage by 25-39%. On SWE-bench Pro, resolution remains close to the baseline (44.3-50.6% vs. 49.0%) while token usage drops by 17-26%. On SecBench, Callgraph has the highest patch-resolution rate in this sample (34.3% vs. 28.9%) and uses fewer tokens, but all workflows increase latency. On SWT-bench, Hybrid and Docs have the highest reproducing-test rates in this sample (47.8% and 47.2% vs. 44.7%), but all workflows use more tokens and take longer. Overall, map-based workflows change both what the agent inspects and how much it spends, but their benefits are task-dependent rather than universal.

</details>


### [204] [Take It From Here: Evaluating Coding Agents On Project Takeover](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07307)
*Dingxian Wang,Zhe Fu,Jiaqi Deng,Chao Yin,Ganesh Prabhu,Karthik Gomadam Rajagopal,Darwin Yi,Huan Huo,Guandong Xu,Xianzhi Wang,Andrew Rabinovich,Zhao Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出ReqnMemBench基准，评估编码智能体"接管项目"时从交互历史重建需求、更新需求并交付的能力，发现现有模型完整交付率仅4.95%，且需求状态构建与目标落地均存在显著困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体日益参与长期项目协作，接管项目时需从历史交互中恢复当前有效需求并随新请求更新。但现有基准多缺乏长期交互历史，部分考虑历史的评测也未覆盖"从需求重建到项目交付"的完整流程，因此缺乏系统性评估手段。

Method: 向智能体提供交互历史、当前请求与请求前项目环境，要求其完成修改，并以交付测试评估接管表现。采用"需求原子"对更大规模接管目标做独立诊断，分别考察相关信息识别、请求前状态重建、当前请求处理；并额外提供正确的请求前状态或目标状态，以隔离需求处理与项目修改中的剩余难点。

Result: 六种模型-框架配置、37个可执行验证目标下，全历史条件的平均完整交付率仅4.95%；六种配置均未产出完全正确的请求后需求状态，案例显示更新时会遗漏此前已恢复的约束。即便提供正确目标状态，完整交付率也仅8.11%，构建与回归通过率为96.40%和90.99%，但目标测试成功率仍仅9.01%。

Conclusion: 结果表明难点既在于形成正确的目标需求状态，也在于将给定目标落实到既有项目中。据此提出ReqMemBench，将需求诊断与交付验证结合，支持对项目接管的系统化评估。

Abstract: Coding agents increasingly collaborate on long-term projects. When taking over a project, they need to recover currently applicable requirements from the interaction history and update them in response to new requests. However, most coding benchmarks do not include long interaction histories, and some evaluations that consider history still do not cover the full process from requirement reconstruction to project delivery. We therefore provide agents with the interaction history, current request, and pre-request project environment, ask them to make the requested changes, and assess takeover performance through delivery tests. Across six model-harness configurations and 37 targets eligible for executable validation, the mean complete-delivery rate under Full History is only 4.95%. We then use requirement atoms to independently diagnose a larger set of takeover targets, examining relevant information identification, pre-request state reconstruction, and current request processing. We further supply correct pre-request or target states to examine the remaining difficulties in requirement processing and project modification. The diagnostics show that none of the six configurations produces fully correct post-request requirement states, and a case illustrates omission of previously recovered constraints during updating. With correct target states supplied, the mean complete-delivery rate is 8.11%, with build and regression pass rates of 96.40% and 90.99%, but target-test success remains 9.01%. These results show difficulties in both forming target requirement states and implementing supplied targets in existing projects. Based on these findings, we introduce ReqMemBench, which combines requirement diagnostics with delivery validation to support systematic evaluation of project takeover.

</details>


### [205] [Req2Rust: A Requirements-Guided Agent Harness for Project-Level C++-to-Rust Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07442)
*Shengbo Wang,Mingwei Liu,Yuwen Chen,Yanlin Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Req2Rust 是首个项目级 LLM 驱动的 C++ 到 Rust 迁移框架，通过推导迁移需求规格（MRS）与 Rust 设计规格（RDS）并迭代精化生成可构建、语义对齐的 Rust 工程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遗留 C/C++ 系统现代化迁移到 Rust 有内存安全收益，但项目级迁移需兼顾语义保真与 Rust 风格重构：保留源码结构会带入不安全惯用法与工程假设，直接让 Agent 翻译则依赖模型自行识别需保留的语义，而 C++ 的语义（对象模型、析构驱动的生命周期协议等）难以局部化，易被遗漏。

Method: Req2Rust 分三阶段：1）从源码提取证据支撑的迁移需求规格 MRS，记录须保留的行为与约束；2）基于 MRS 合成 Rust 设计规格 RDS 并生成初始 Rust 工程；3）将初始工程视为可执行的精化状态，用编译器、语义、unsafe 削减三类验证器生成报告，迭代提升可构建性、行为一致性与 unsafe 使用质量。

Result: 在通用 C++ 项目与 OpenHarmony 大规模代码库模块上对比 ClaudeCode 基线：两种场景均生成可构建的 Rust crate；通用项目测试通过率由 69.5% 提升至 91.9%，OpenHarmony 模块由 45.4% 提升至 87.9%。

Conclusion: 以需求规格为中介、以验证反馈迭代精化的项目级迁移流程，能有效弥补直接 Agent 翻译中语义覆盖不足的问题，在可构建性、行为一致性和降低 unsafe 使用上优于基线，适用于大型真实代码库的 C++→Rust 现代化迁移。

Abstract: Memory-safety concerns make Rust an attractive target for modernizing legacy C/C++ systems, yet project-level C++ migration must balance semantic fidelity with Rust-oriented reconstruction. Source-structure-preserving migration can track low-level behavior, but it can also carry source-language organization, unsafe idioms, and project assumptions into Rust. Direct agent-based translation gives the model more freedom to construct a Rust project, but semantic coverage depends on the model identifying the source behaviors that must be preserved. This problem is especially acute for C++, where source behaviors are often hidden in object models, destructor-driven lifetime protocols, and other hard-to-localize C++ semantics. This paper presents Req2Rust, the first project-level LLM-based C++-to-Rust migration harness. Req2Rust first derives an evidence-grounded Migration Requirements Specification (MRS) that records the behaviors and constraints that must be preserved. It then synthesizes a Rust Design Specification (RDS) and realizes it as an initial Rust project. Because real projects contain implementation details and idioms that only become visible during build and validation, Req2Rust treats the initial Rust project as an executable refinement state. Compiler, semantic, and unsafe-reduction validators produce validation reports for improving buildability, behavioral alignment, and unsafe usage. We evaluate Req2Rust on general C++ projects and modules from the large-scale Openharmony codebase against a ClaudeCode baseline. Req2Rust produces buildable Rust crates in both settings and improves test pass rate from 69.5% to 91.9% on general projects and from 45.4% to 87.9% on Openharmony modules.

</details>


### [206] [Route Before Response: Fail-Closed Routing for LLM-Enabled Customer-Service Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07534)
*Yuchen Cao,Zhenyu Mao,Jacky Wai Keung,Yifei Wang,Guancheng Lin,Jingyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RouteBR 将"边界感知的响应前路由"建模为：模型提议目标服务与注册实体，确定性代码校验标识符与版本化规则后才放行派发，低排名候选不得替补被阻断的主路由。在金融机构 600 个隐私保护场景上，CONFIRM MAIN 子集 200 例最终路径精确匹配 97.5%，且 166 个非派发案例零误派发。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融客服 LLM 应用在回复前必须选定下游服务，但分类器/路由器只能给出标签或目的地，组合系统仍需额外验证派发权限与实体注册状态，这一集成缺口在真实合规环境中未被充分研究。

Method: 提出 RouteBR 控制器：单次模型调用产出主服务动作与注册对象提议；随后由确定性代码检查标识符及版本化规则，决定派发或预定义的非派发结果；被阻断的主路由不允许由低排名候选替代。基于真实金融机构高频机密请求模式构造 600 个隐私保护场景，三名工程师共同审核场景与标签；并与同规则下的单调用基线、无规则程序的诊断基线对比，同时提供全量 1960 条预测与原始凭据配对的可复现工件。

Result: CONFIRM MAIN 200 例上最终路径精确匹配 97.5%；同规则单调用基线 95.5%；无规则诊断基线动作准确率 94.0% 但最终路径精确匹配仅 41.0%；166 个非派发 MAIN/FLIP 案例中 RouteBR 零误派发。

Conclusion: 将模型提议与代码拥有的可重放执行分离，能显著提升端到端路由的可靠性与审计性；动作准确率不足以衡量组合系统的实际派发正确性。

Abstract: LLM-enabled customer-service software in financial institutions must choose a downstream service before responding. Classifiers and LLM routers can identify a relevant label or destination, but a composed application must still verify dispatch permission and entity registration. We study this integration problem as boundary-aware pre-response routing. We present RouteBR, a controller in which one model call proposes a primary service action and registered object, then deterministic code checks identifiers and versioned rules before dispatch or a specified non-dispatch outcome. Lower-ranked candidates cannot replace a blocked primary route. We construct 600 privacy-preserving scenarios from recurring confidential-request patterns at a real financial institution; three engineers jointly reviewed the scenarios and labels. On the 200-case CONFIRM MAIN split, RouteBR reaches 97.5% final-path exact match. A matched one-call baseline given the same rules reaches 95.5%, whereas a diagnostic baseline without the rule program obtains 94.0% action accuracy but only 41.0% final-path exact match. Across 166 non-dispatch MAIN and FLIP cases, RouteBR produces no false dispatch. The artifact pairs all 1,960 prediction rows with raw receipts while excluding gold and reviewer fields from model requests. These results support separating model proposals from code-owned, replayable execution. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YgcCoder/RouteBR.

</details>


### [207] [Evolver: Turning Agent Exploration into Evolving Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07595)
*Haoyang Zhang,Qumeng Sun,Xiao Zhang,Xiang Liu,Zhidong Fan,Junjie Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Evolver 将智能体探索中产生的经验固化为可复用的"Gene"资产，在不更新基础模型参数的前提下提升任务成功率并降低 token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体探索能产生有价值的程序性知识，但这些经验大多停留在短暂的执行轨迹中，缺乏系统化复用。

Method: 提出经验驱动框架 Evolver，以结构化 Gene 资产为核心，整合经验获取、检索与反馈引导的演化，支持在现有智能体框架上做经验条件化执行；在 Claude Code 与 Codex 两种模型配置、四个基准（Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-rebench、GAIA）上评估。

Result: 在 320 组配对执行中，任务成功率由 83.13% 提升至 87.50%（+4.38 个百分点），执行 token 消耗降低 24.24%；在 265 组双方均成功的配对中，token 消耗降低 17.57%。

Conclusion: 持续积累的程序性经验可同时提升任务有效性与执行效率，为把智能体探索转化为不断演化的能力提供了实践基础。

Abstract: Agent exploration produces valuable procedural knowledge, yet much of this experience remains confined to transient execution traces and is not systematically reused. We introduce Evolver, an experience-driven framework that transforms agent exploration into persistent, reusable capabilities without updating foundation model parameters. Built around structured Gene assets, Evolver integrates experience acquisition, retrieval, and feedback-guided evolution to support experience-conditioned execution across existing agent harnesses. We evaluate Evolver using Claude Code and Codex, two foundation model configurations, and four benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-rebench, and GAIA. On a selected diagnostic set of 320 paired executions, Evolver improves task success from 83.13% to 87.50% (+4.38 percentage points) while reducing recorded task-execution token consumption by 24.24%. Furthermore, among 265 pairs successful under both conditions, token consumption decreases by 17.57%, demonstrating efficiency benefits even when task success is preserved. These findings suggest that persistent procedural experience can improve both task effectiveness and execution efficiency, providing a practical foundation for transforming agent exploration into evolving capabilities.

</details>


### [208] [AiXapply: Fast and Reliable Full-File Code Integration with Specialized Small Models for IDE Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07634)
*Siyuan Jiang,Xiang Cai,Peixu Wang,Yu Han,Yihong Dong,Wei Ning,Xuyuan Guo,Jincheng Wen,Dexin Liu,Wei Zhao,Ge Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文将"把局部代码更新片段合入原文件"形式化为独立的 Code Integration (Apply) 任务，构建多语言数据集并训练 4B 专用模型 aiXapply（SFT + GRPO），准确率达 94.4%，超过 Deepseek-V3.2，并通过投机解码与工业部署把 Apply 延迟从 50 秒降到 1.89 秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地为开发者提出小规模代码修改，但把部分更新片段可靠地合入现有文件、同时不破坏无关内容，现有代码生成工作流支持不足；大模型全文件生成在 IDE 场景下延迟、成本和隐私都不可接受。

Method: 形式化 Apply 任务（原文件 + 更新片段 → 完整合并文件）；用结构化流水线从真实 commit 构建多语言数据集（改动转片段 + 全文件真值 + 校验过滤）；训练 4B 专用模型 aiXapply，采用监督微调与强化学习（GRPO）；对比时使用语言感知的评估方式，并用投机解码加速推理。

Result: SFT 版本准确率 94.4%，超过 Deepseek-V3.2 基线 91.6%；投机解码使 aiXapply-RL 在单张 A100 上达到约 2700 tokens/s，全基准上延迟约为 API 版 Deepseek-V3.2 的 1/75；aiXcoder IDE 插件实际部署后，平均 Apply 延迟由 50 秒降至 1.89 秒；按时间容量规划，替换五个上游实例之一可节省 20% 上游机器成本（未计新增共享 A100 成本）。

Conclusion: 把代码集成当作独立任务，能让小模型兼具高准确率与实用效率，在延迟、成本和隐私敏感的 IDE 真实工作流中产生可量化的工业收益。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly assist developers by proposing small code edits, yet reliably integrating a partial update snippet into an existing file while preserving unrelated content remains poorly supported by current code-generation workflows. We formalize the Code Integration (Apply) task as follows: given an original file and an update snippet, the system must produce the complete merged file while preserving all content outside the requested edit. We construct a high-quality multi-language dataset from real commits via a structured pipeline that converts code changes into update snippets paired with full-file ground truth and enforces consistency through verification and filtering. We then train a specialized 4B model, aiXapply, using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (GRPO). The supervised variant achieves 94.4% accuracy under our language-aware comparison, surpassing a strong large-model (Deepseek-V3.2) baseline (91.6%). Speculative decoding enables aiXapply-RL to reach $\sim$2700 tokens/s on a single A100 in a decoding subset; on the full benchmark, it achieves roughly 75$\times$ lower latency than the API-served Deepseek-V3.2 baseline. We further conduct an industrial deployment of aiXapply-RL in the aiXcoder IDE plugin as a dedicated Apply service, reducing mean Apply latency from 50 seconds to 1.89 seconds by offloading full-file generation from the upstream large model. Under time-based capacity planning, replacing one of five upstream serving instances would save 20% of upstream machine cost before the additional shared A100 service cost. Overall, our results demonstrate that treating code integration as a standalone task enables small models to achieve high accuracy, practical efficiency, and concrete industrial benefits in real-world IDE workflows where latency, cost and privacy are critical.

</details>


### [209] [What the Middleman Delivers: Answer Behavior, Tool Permissions, and Billed Usage in LLM API Relays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07650)
*Xiaodong Wu,Zhimin Zhao,Qi Li,Chaklam Cheong,Xiangman Li,Jianbing Ni*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了20家提供GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5的第三方API中转服务，发现低价中转存在行为差异、工具权限违规与token计费虚高问题，说明广告中的模型与价格不足以判断中转可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户依赖第三方API中转获取低价大模型服务，期望模型质量、指令遵循和计费准确，但已有研究不清楚中转服务能否同时满足这些期望，缺乏对三者联合的实证检验。

Method: 对20家提供GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5的中转进行三轮测试：(1) 与批量匹配的官方回答比较知识问答，标记行为差异并在35对上重测评估稳定性；(2) 在3,332条固定非对抗性代码与配置请求中筛查内容注入并检测工具权限违规；(3) 对比输入token计数与官方参考并核查账户余额，将上报用量与实际扣费关联。

Result: 首轮10家低价中转中7家、10家同价或高价中转中2家被标记行为差异；重测35对时原规则下7对、匹配校正族下6对标记状态改变。3,332条响应中未确认注入，但四家中转在指令禁用工具的情况下首轮仍返回工具调用。相同请求下五家中转上报比官方多4,200至60,000输入token；有余额数据的6家按标价依上报用量扣费，其中一家对虚增token也收费。

Conclusion: 广告宣称的模型与价格不足以判断中转可靠性；无法解释的计费token量与工具权限违规构成风险；服务评估需重复测量以应对标记的不稳定性。

Abstract: Third-party application programming interface (API) relays offer access to large language models (LLMs), often at lower prices. Users depend on these services for model quality, instruction compliance, and accurate billing. However, existing studies leave unclear whether relays meet these expectations together. We test 20 relays offering GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5. First, we compare answers to knowledge questions with batch-matched official responses. In our first-round sample, the analysis flags 7/10 low-price and 2/10 same- or higher-price relays for behavioral differences. On retesting 35 pairs, seven gain or lose a flag under the original rules, and six under matched correction families. Because answer comparisons cannot reveal every delivery problem, we examine returned content and tool permissions.
