No injection is confirmed in 3,332 screened responses to a fixed, non-adversarial code and setup workload, yet four relays return tool calls despite instructions disabling them in the first round. Finally, to connect reported usage to actual costs, we compare input-token counts with official references and check balances. For identical requests, five relays report 4,200 to 60,000 more input tokens than the official API. Where balances are available (six services), charges follow reported usage at listed prices, including extra reported input tokens at one service. Our study shows that advertised models and prices are insufficient to judge relay reliability. It identifies unexplained billed token quantities and tool-permission violations as risks and shows why service evaluations need repeated measurements.

</details>


### [210] [Fix One, Miss Another: Leveraging Historical Bug Fixes to Uncover Residual Bugs in Database Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07739)
*Yankai Rong,Zhaoyang Zhang,Shuang Liu,Wei Lu,Xiaoyong Du*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出Reaper，一种由历史bug修复引导的"兄弟bug"检测方法：从修复中推断触发画像与验证画像，通过语法引导的测试变异把触发条件投影到语法兄弟handler上，再用分阶段验证降低误报，在四个DBMS中发现61个新bug，57个被确认、13个已修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DBMS通过语法驱动的dispatch handler实现SQL构造，语法兄弟handler虽对应不同SQL构造，却共享参数提取、类型检查、权限校验等实现模式。因此针对某个handler的历史bug修复往往只加固该handler，其兄弟handler中的同类语义缺陷被遗漏（兄弟bug）。现有bug检测技术很少系统利用历史修复来发现这类关联缺陷。

Method: Reaper分三步：1）分析一个bug修复，推断"触发画像"（缺陷暴露所需条件）和"验证画像"（区分错误行为与正确行为的语义证据）；2）通过语法引导的测试变异，将触发画像投影到语法兄弟handler上，生成覆盖对应语义路径的测试；3）利用验证画像进行分阶段验证，判定可疑行为，降低因DBMS复杂行为导致的误报。

Result: 在MariaDB、MySQL、OceanBase、CockroachDB四个主流DBMS上评估，Reaper发现61个此前未知的bug，其中57个已被开发者确认，13个在撰写时已修复。

Conclusion: 历史bug修复蕴含可迁移的语义知识，将其系统地跨语法兄弟handler传播，能有效发现原本被忽视的缺陷。Reaper验证了以修复为引导的兄弟bug检测思路的实用性与有效性。

Abstract: Database management systems (DBMSs) implement SQL constructs through grammar-driven dispatch handlers. Although handlers for syntactic siblings implement different SQL constructs, they often share a common implementation pattern, including argument extraction, type checking, and permission validation. Consequently, a bug fix that hardens the handler exercised by a historical bug may leave the corresponding logic in sibling handlers vulnerable to the same semantic flaw. We refer to such defects as sibling bugs. Despite the structural similarity among sibling handlers, existing bug-finding techniques rarely exploit historical fixes to systematically uncover these related defects.
  We present Reaper, a novel approach for detecting sibling bugs guided by historical bug fixes. Reaper first analyzes a bug fix to infer a trigger profile, which characterizes the conditions under which the defect is exposed, and a validation profile, which captures the semantic evidence needed to distinguish buggy behavior from correct behavior. It then projects the trigger profile onto syntactic siblings through grammar-guided test mutation, generating tests that exercise corresponding semantic paths in sibling handlers. Finally, Reaper validates suspicious behaviors using the inferred validation profile through a staged validation process, reducing false positives caused by complex DBMS behavior.
  We evaluate Reaper on four widely used DBMSs, including MariaDB, MySQL, OceanBase, and CockroachDB. Reaper uncovers 61 previously unknown bugs, of which 57 have been confirmed by developers and 13 have been fixed at the time of writing. These results demonstrate that historical bug fixes contain actionable semantic knowledge that can be systematically transferred across syntactic siblings to uncover otherwise overlooked defects.

</details>


### [211] [Uncovering Systematic Blind Spots in Graph Database Testing through Integration and Process-Level Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07754)
*Tinghan Li,Aoyang Fang,Longbin Lai,Zifan Xie,Hongbo Zhao,Yu Shao,Ying Zhang,Pinjia He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 针对图数据库测试中误报泛滥与等价类变形测试因优化机制失效的问题，本文提出集成平台 GraphWeave，用多智能体系统过滤报告并适配方言，再用计划感知的分诊跳过同执行计划的变形测试对。在工业图数据库 NeuG 上发现 19 个此前未知且均被确认的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图数据库测试技术众多但彼此割裂，各自只能发现特定类别的缺陷，合并使用是自然的下一步。然而评测标准是能否发现真实缺陷，而非无用报告或永不失败的测试。作者整合 8 种测试技术后发现两个盲点：(1) 12 小时测试产生数千条报告，远超成熟数据库真实缺陷数，多数为方言与模式匹配差异导致的误报，其余多为重复；(2) 进程级数据显示，优化机制使许多基于等价性的变形测试用例丧失缺陷检测能力。

Method: GraphWeave 集成 8 种测试能力，包含两部分核心机制：(a) 多智能体系统分析海量 bug 报告，生成用于问题过滤的 gating rules 与用于方言适配的 adapter rules；(b) plan-aware triage 依据执行计划对变形测试对进行路由，跳过在同一图状态下共享同一执行计划、因而不可能检测到缺陷的测试对。

Result: 在未被以往图数据库测试工作覆盖的近期开源工业图数据库 NeuG 上应用 GraphWeave，以较少的人工投入发现 19 个此前未知的 bug，且全部已被确认。

Conclusion: 将多种测试技术整合时，关键在于抑制误报与保留测试有效性：通过 LLM 多智能体自动生成过滤与适配规则，以及基于执行计划的变形测试分诊，可在低人工成本下显著提升真实缺陷发现率，并在真实工业系统中得到验证。

Abstract: Graph databases are becoming foundational infrastructure for connected data, and a growing body of automated testing techniques has uncovered many bugs across mature graph database systems. Each technique checks a different aspect of correctness and exposes a different class of defect. Combining them is the natural next step, but each technique is judged by the real bugs it finds, not by useless reports or tests that can never fail, and that is what decides whether a developer can afford to fix the problems. To identify the remaining gaps, we integrated test capabilities from 8 testing methods and conducted an empirical study of their behavior, during which we found two blind spots. First, 12 hours of testing produce thousands of bug reports, far more than the number of genuine defects a mature database is likely to contain. Most reports are false positives caused by dialect or pattern-matching differences, and many of the remaining reports are duplicates. Second, analysis of process-level data reveals that many equivalence-based metamorphic test cases lose their ability to detect defects because of the optimization mechanism. Based on these findings, we summarize and realize these guidelines in GraphWeave, an integrated testing platform for graph databases. This includes a multi-agent system that analyzes the flood of bug reports to produce gating rules for issue filtering and adapter rules for dialect adaptation, and a plan-aware triage routes metamorphic pairs by plan, skipping those that share a plan on the same graph state and therefore cannot detect defects. We apply GraphWeave to NeuG, a recently open-sourced industrial graph database that has not been covered by prior graph database testing work. With modest manual effort, GraphWeave uncovers 19 previously unknown bugs, all of which have since been confirmed.

</details>


### [212] [ReConMem: A Graph-Based Dual Memory System for Repository-Oriented Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07759)
*Zhishuo Yang,Li Zhang,Yang Liu,Donghao Yang,Fang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出ReConMem——面向仓库级开发对话的图结构双记忆系统，协同组织会话记忆与代码实体，提升多轮辅助效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代码助手用于迭代式仓库级开发，需同时利用演进的对话历史与仓库上下文；但现有记忆系统面向通用对话，未能把会话信息与其所指的结构化代码实体协调起来。

Method: 将蒸馏后的会话记忆与对话相关代码实体组织为语义图与结构图，并随交互演进维护跨图关联；召回时结合自然语言与代码对齐检索（基于代码草稿的查询落地），沿图内与跨图关系扩展，并按结构粒度压缩检索到的代码。

Result: 在LoCoEval上，单跳与多跳子集Pass@1分别比最强基线提升7.917与7.292个百分点，上下文压缩程度相当；在CodeAssistBench上取得27.61% Correct与44.03% Partially Correct，分别超过Full History 4.10与7.09个百分点，并提升交互质量。

Conclusion: 将会话记忆与仓库结构对齐，能有效改善仓库导向多轮交互中的上下文管理。

Abstract: LLM-based code assistants are increasingly used in iterative repository-level development, where effective assistance requires jointly leveraging evolving conversational history and repository context. Existing memory systems, however, are primarily designed for general-purpose conversations and do not sufficiently coordinate conversational information with the structured code entities to which it refers. We propose ReConMem, a graph-based dual memory system for repository-oriented conversations. ReConMem organizes distilled conversational memories and conversation-relevant code entities into interconnected semantic and structural memory graphs, while maintaining their cross-graph associations as interactions evolve. For memory recall, ReConMem combines natural-language and code-aligned retrieval through code-draft-based query grounding, expands retrieved information over intra- and inter-graph relations, and compresses retrieved code according to its structural granularity. We evaluate ReConMem on two repository-oriented conversational benchmarks spanning long-horizon context management and realistic project-grounded multi-turn assistance. On LoCoEval, ReConMem improves Pass@1 over the strongest baseline by 7.917 and 7.292 percentage points on single-hop and multi-hop subsets, respectively, with comparable context compression. On CodeAssistBench, it achieves 27.61% Correct and 44.03% Partially Correct, exceeding Full History by 4.10 and 7.09 percentage points, respectively, while improving interaction quality. These results demonstrate that aligning conversational memory with repository structure improves context management for repository-oriented multi-turn interactions.

</details>


### [213] [Fast Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Methods on Software Logs - An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07760)
*Jesse Nyyssölä,Mika Mäntylä,Yuqing Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文系统评估无监督日志异常检测中预处理、模型与表示、数据集等因素的影响，结论是跨数据集差异大、难以给出普适建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际场景中很少有带标签的日志训练数据，因此需要无监督方法；但预处理选择、检测模型和表示方式对性能的影响尚不清楚，需系统研究。

Method: 测试三种预处理（仅用无异常数据训练、随机 vs 时序选取训练数据、自定义加载器提取日志消息）、四种模型（KMeans、IsolationForest、RarityModel、OOV检测器）和三种表示（词、trigram、解析事件）；在BGL、HDFS、Hadoop、Spirit、Thunderbird、Liberty、LO2Token七个数据集上跑所有组合，用AUCROC和F1评估，并用广义线性模型分析因素间关系，同时统计运行时间。

Result: 各数据集间差异极大：日志解析在部分数据集上有益、在另一些上有害；用无异常数据训练可提升性能但需额外标注成本；打乱数据导致的“数据泄漏”效应在所测无监督模型中不存在（有监督模型仍存在）；追求速度可用词表示并避开IsolationForest。

Conclusion: 无法给出普适推荐；实践者应针对具体数据集做验证，无异常训练数据值得投入，速度优先时选择词表示并避免IsolationForest。

Abstract: Anomaly detection on software logs ensures system reliability through failure identification, root cause analysis and fault localization. While supervised models show excellent performance, in a practical setting there rarely are labeled training data available. This calls for the use of unsupervised models. We study effects of data preprocessing, anomaly detection method, and the dataset. For preprocessing, we examine three options: The use of anomaly-free training data, using randomized as opposed to chronologically selected training data, and the use of a custom loader to extract log message from the log line. Regarding anomaly detection we use four models (KMeans, IsolationForest, RarityModel, Out-Of-Vocabulary Detector) and three representations (Words, trigrams, and parsed events). We evaluate these approaches on seven datasets: BGL, HDFS, Hadoop, Spirit, Thunderbird, Liberty, and LO2Token. We run each combination of the selected factors and measure performance with AUCROC and F1-score metrics. Then we utilize a generalized linear model to establish relationships between the factors. Furthermore, we address execution times.
  Our evidence reveals large variability across all datasets, preventing us from making recommendations that apply universally. For instance, log parsing enhances performance on some datasets but reduces it on others. The evidence suggests that using anomaly-free data for training unsupervised models can improve anomaly detection performance, though this requires extra effort to identify such data.Previous work has argued that shuffling data leads to unrealistic model performance (data leakage). Yet, our results show this does not hold for the unsupervised models we tested, while it remains true for supervised models in the same setup. For fast execution of the pipeline, use word representation and avoid IsolationForest model.

</details>


### [214] [Adapt the Object to the Subject: Representative Study Material for Empirical Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07772)
*Max Unterbusch,Julian Frattini,Michael Mircea,Alexander Korn,Kurt Schneider,Jonathan Ullrich,Andreas Vogelsang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 外部效度讨论多聚焦参与者代表性，而研究对象的代表性（subject-object fit）被忽视。作者用LLM在在线调查中根据参与者提供的简短语境即时生成"语境适配的合成需求"，并可选注入需求坏味。31名从业者参与2x2实验（静态vs合成 × 干净vs坏味），每人评估20条需求。贝叶斯因果推断显示：感知代表性正向影响可评估性；合成需求比公开数据集静态需求更被认为有代表性，并因此更可评估；坏味注入不影响两种感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件工程实证研究对外部效度的争论几乎只关注研究参与者是否有代表性，却很少关注研究对象（代码、模型、需求）是否贴合参与者自身工作。理想情况是使用从业者真实工件，但难以获取，研究者通常退而采用公开数据集或人工构造的对象。这种"主体—对象不匹配"是否会削弱参与者对材料的判断能力尚不清楚，本文针对需求对象迈出第一步。

Method: 提出基于LLM的方法：在在线调查期间，依据参与者提供的简短语境描述，即时（just-in-time）生成语境适配的合成需求，并可选择性注入需求坏味作为受控刺激。随后开展对照实验：31名产业从业者，2x2设计（刺激生成方式：静态 vs 合成；质量：干净 vs 坏味），每人评估20条需求的感知代表性与可评估性，并采用统计因果推断框架下的贝叶斯数据分析。

Result: 感知代表性与可评估性之间存在强正效应；合成需求被评为比公开数据集静态需求更具代表性，且主要因这一增益而更具可评估性；注入需求坏味对代表性和可评估性两种感知均无显著影响。

Conclusion: 结果支持将研究对象代表性不足视为一类首要的效度威胁，并将"语境适配的合成研究对象"定位为实证方法学工具箱中的实用补充。该工作为需求领域之外更广泛的研究对象适配问题提供了初步证据与方法示范。

Abstract: External validity is a central concern in empirical software engineering, yet the debate has largely focused on whether study participants are representative. How well the study objects they reason about - code, models, or requirements - are representative of each participant's own work is often overlooked. Practitioners' own artifacts would be ideal, but are often out of reach, so researchers sample from public datasets or construct objects artificially. Whether this lack of subject-object fit affects participants' ability to act on the material remains unknown. We take a first step toward answering this question for requirements. We propose an approach that uses an LLM to generate context-adapted synthetic requirements just-in-time during an online survey from a short, participant-supplied context description, optionally injecting requirements smells as controlled stimuli. To validate the approach, we conducted a controlled experiment with 31 industry practitioners in a 2x2 design that crosses stimulus generation (static vs. synthetic) with quality (clean vs. smelly). Each participant rated the perceived representativeness and assessability of 20 requirements. Using Bayesian data analysis within a statistical causal-inference framework, we find that perceived representativeness has a strong positive effect on assessability. Synthetic requirements are rated as more representative and, primarily due to this gain, more assessable than static ones sourced from public datasets; smell injection leaves both perceptions unchanged. Our results support treating a lack of study-object representativeness as a first-class validity threat and position context-adapted synthetic study objects as a practical addition to the empirical methodology toolbox.

</details>


### [215] [Which Signals of Code Correctness Survive Distribution Shift? Hidden-State and Causal Predictors of Program and Verdict Correctness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07876)
*Viola Campos,Thomas Klassert,Adrian Ulges*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 比较6种无执行正确性预测器（含两种新引入的因果定位方法）在Qwen3-Coder-30B与gpt-oss-20b上的分布偏移鲁棒性，覆盖基准偏移与语言偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型对代码的判断缺乏外部反馈时不可靠，而用测试执行或长推理验证代价高；现有基于输出概率、采样解、隐状态的无执行预测器在跨项目、跨语言分布偏移下可能退化。

Method: 在LiveCodeBench与BigCodeBench之间（基准偏移）及Python/C++/Java之间（语言偏移）比较来自4个家族的6种无执行预测器；评估两个目标：模型自身判定是否可信、程序本身是否正确；并将两种自然语言中表现更OOD鲁棒的因果定位方法适配到代码上。

Result: 对判定正确性，因果定位在语言偏移下提升鲁棒性：Qwen3-Coder在因果定位子空间上的探针在语言偏移下比输出置信度高0.09 AUROC（同分布下高0.11），平均比最佳非因果预测器高0.04 AUROC；但该优势不能一致迁移到gpt-oss或基准偏移。对程序正确性，预测器跨基准迁移较好，主要靠识别模型易失败的问题，但同题内候选排序能力有限。

Conclusion: 因果定位是在特定模型与语言偏移下提升判定可信度估计鲁棒性的有效手段，但非通用；程序级正确性预测的跨基准迁移来自问题难度信号而非细粒度区分能力。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly judge code, yet without external feedback such judgments are unreliable, and verifying them by executing tests or by extended reasoning is costly. Instead, execution-free correctness predictors use signals from the model's output probabilities, sampled solutions, or hidden states to identify judgments that warrant further verification. However, these predictors may degrade under distribution shifts when generalizing across projects and languages.
  We compare six execution-free predictors from four families on Qwen3-Coder-30B and gpt-oss-20b under benchmark shift between LiveCodeBench and BigCodeBench and language shift across Python, C++ and Java. We evaluate two targets: whether the model's own verdict on a program can be trusted, and whether the program itself is correct. Besides established approaches, we adapt two novel causal localization methods to code, which have been shown to be more robust out-of-distribution on natural language tasks. For verdict correctness, causal localization improves robustness to language shift. For Qwen3-Coder a probe on the causally localized subspace stays 0.09 AUROC ahead of output confidence under language shift (0.11 in distribution), significantly outperforming the best non-causal predictor by 0.04 AUROC on average. This advantage, however, does not generalize consistently to gpt-oss or to benchmark shift. For program correctness, predictors transfer more successfully between benchmarks, largely by identifying problems on which the model tends to fail. However, their ability to rank candidates within the same problem is limited.

</details>


### [216] [Compositional Loop Invariant Inference for Multiphase Programs via Structured Neurosymbolic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07882)
*Mingxiu Wang,Jiawei Wang,Shuangxiang Kan,Angela Huo,Yuekang Li,Xi Zheng,Xiao Cheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CLOVER 是一个神经符号框架，通过组合式推理与反例引导的局部修复，为多阶段程序自动推断循环不变式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段程序的循环包含条件分支，导致多种行为不同的执行阶段，现有 LLM 方法要么整体推理循环，要么跨分支联合生成原子断言，缺乏完整候选子不变式的独立生成与针对性修复，自动推断仍为开放问题。

Method: 两大机制：1）组合式推理——静态将循环分解为符号化的循环分支序列（守卫与分支条件的合取），指导 LLM 对每个执行场景独立生成候选子不变式；2）反例引导的局部精化——SMT 验证拒绝组合析取不变式时，回溯反例定位致错的特定分支序列，仅修复该子不变式并保留正确部分。两者由基于分支语义的共享符号结构统一指导生成、组合与修复。

Result: 在 316 个线性算术、50 个非线性算术和 54 个多阶段基准上评估。多阶段任务解决 35/54，比最佳 LLM 基线（29）高 20.7%，比最佳传统方法（22）高 59.1%；线性/非线性任务保持竞争力，总体解决 355/366。

Conclusion: 将循环按分支语义分解并配合反例引导的局部修复，能有效提升多阶段循环不变式推断，同时在常规基准上保持竞争力。

Abstract: Loop invariants are essential for deductive program verification, yet automatically inferring them for {multiphase programs}, whose loops contain conditional branches that induce multiple execution phases with distinct behaviors, remains an open problem. Existing LLM-based methods either reason about loops as a whole or use explicit branch information to generate atomic assertions jointly across branches, without maintaining complete candidate sub-invariants for independent generation and targeted repair. We present CLOVER, a structured neurosymbolic reasoning framework for multiphase invariant inference built on two interlinked mechanisms. First, compositional inference: CLOVER statically decomposes a loop into symbolic {loop branch sequences}, conjunctions of the loop guard and branch conditions that characterize distinct execution scenarios, and guides the LLM to generate candidate sub-invariants for each one independently, so that each LLM query focuses on a single execution scenario rather than the entire loop. Second, counterexample-guided localized refinement: when SMT verification rejects a composed disjunctive invariant, CLOVER traces the counterexample back through the branch structure to identify which specific loop branch sequence caused the failure and repairs only that sub-invariant, preserving all correct components. Both mechanisms are unified by a shared symbolic structure derived from the loop's branch semantics, which guides what the LLM generates, how candidates are composed, and where refinement is directed. We evaluate CLOVER on 316 linear arithmetic, 50 nonlinear arithmetic, and 54 multiphase benchmarks. CLOVER solves 35 of 54 multiphase benchmarks, outperforming the best LLM-based baseline (29) by 20.7\% and the best traditional method (22) by 59.1\%. On linear/nonlinear benchmarks, CLOVER remains competitive, solving 355 of 366 programs overall.

</details>


### [217] [A Low Similarity Score Does Not Show Independence after Source-Conditioned Repository Rewriting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07887)
*Micheline Bénédicte Moumoula,Serge Lionel Nikiema,Tailia Malloy,Abdoul Kader Kaboré,Jacques Klein,Tegawendé F. Bissyande*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文检验在"源条件重写"场景下，低token相似度分数能否作为LLM辅助重写copyleft项目具有独立性的证据，结论：单次低分是不可靠的独立性证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 维护者常用低token相似度分数论证LLM辅助重写的copyleft项目独立于原作，但该做法的证据效力未被严格检验。

Method: 在6个copyleft Python项目上进行69次源条件重写：编码代理保留原作在工作副本中，反复重写直至通过固定行为测试harness，全程无人工改码；测量JPlag相似度、重复实验的分数分布，并与同任务手写独立实现及无关项目对比provenance信号。

Result: 代理重写成本低、常得低分（"从零重构"提示下多数低于25% JPlag且仍通过harness，初版通常半小时内完成）；但相同配置下相似度差异极大，run-to-run波动主导项目与代理效应，超三分之一配置的3次重复跨越阈值；重写保留的import与指纹事实多于无关项目，但手写独立实现亦然，两个信号均无法优于随机区分二者。

Conclusion: 单次低相似度是独立性的弱证据（同一代理另一次运行可能高分）；基于相似度的主张应报告重复生成结果，provenance信号须对照同任务独立实现而非仅与无关项目比较。

Abstract: Maintainers sometimes cite a low token-similarity score as evidence that an LLM-assisted rewrite of a copyleft project is independent of the original. We test what such a score can support under \emph{source-conditioned} rewriting: a coding agent keeps the original in its working copy, rewrites the repository, and iterates until a fixed behavioural harness passes, with no human edit to the code. On 69 rewrites of six copyleft Python projects we find that: \ding{182}~Agent-only rewriting is inexpensive and often yields low scores. Every controlled rewrite passes the harness after repair, usually within half an hour for the initial rewrite. Under a ground-up rearchitecture prompt, most rewrites fall below 25\% JPlag similarity and still pass the harness. \ding{183}~A single low score is an unreliable witness. Identical project--agent--prompt configurations produce wide spreads in similarity; run-to-run variation dominates project and agent effects, and in more than a third of configurations the three repeats straddle the threshold. Rewrites retain more of the original's imports and fingerprint facts than unrelated projects do, yet hand-written independent implementations of the same task often retain as much, and neither signal separates the two groups better than chance. Thus a low score on one rewrite is weak evidence of independence: another run of the same agent may score high. Claims based on similarity should report repeated generations, and candidate provenance signals should be checked against same task independent implementations, not only against unrelated projects.

</details>


### [218] [Requirements Nobody Wrote Down: Emergence in a Public-Sector ML Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07951)
*Ronivaldo Ferreira,Vinicius Costa Girard,Cleidson de Souza,Igor Steinmacher,Carla Aguiar,Filipe Roseiro Cogo,Gustavo Pinto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文基于巴西国家数字参与平台主题分类系统的15个月案例研究，分析公共部门机器学习需求如何产生与演化：需求多源于实验与集成过程，仅40%被正式化，技术与非技术制品共同充当需求获取工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政府对ML处理数据的需求增长，但缺乏对ML从实验走向运营过程中需求如何产生和演化的理解；传统RE假设需求可预先获取，而公共部门需求模糊、利益相关方语言各异、"良好结果"标准未知。

Method: 对巴西国家数字参与平台（含6万余条公民提案）的主题分类流水线开展15个月案例研究，三角验证43个项目制品与6名参与者访谈，重构95项需求及标准，分析其正式化情况与来源。

Result: 机构需求以宽泛目标形式提出，被认可但无明确赞助，95项需求中仅40%被正式化；关键需求多来自实验、模型输出与集成工作；核心的分类类别由政府分类法因制度合法性而确定；验收依赖技术指标、领域判断与政治评估，无共享阈值或实践有效性验证。

Conclusion: 公共部门ML中，技术与制度制品充当需求获取工具，实验与集成应纳入需求过程本身，挑战了需求可 upfront 获取的RE假设。

Abstract: Governments increasingly use machine learning (ML) to handle data volumes beyond their analytical capacity, yet little is known about how requirements arise and evolve as an ML experiment moves toward operational use. Requirements Engineering (RE) for ML often assumes that requirements can be elicited upfront; in the public sector, however, demands arrive vague, stakeholders speak different professional languages, and what counts as a ``good'' result is unknown in advance. We report a 15-month case study of a thematic classification pipeline for Brazil's national digital participation platform, which holds over 60,000 citizen proposals, triangulating 43 project artifacts with interviews of six project participants. Institutional demands arrived as broad goals, endorsed but not sponsored, and only 40\% of the 95 reconstructed requirements and criteria were ever formalized. The pipeline's key requirements emerged largely from experiments, model outputs, and integration work, shaped by technical decisions and institutional constraints; the central one, the classification categories, was settled by a government taxonomy chosen for its institutional legitimacy. Acceptance relied on technical metrics, domain judgment, and political assessment, without shared thresholds or validation of usefulness in practice. In public-sector ML, technical and institutional artifacts thus act as elicitation instruments, and experimentation and integration belong to the requirements process.

</details>


### [219] [RouteAlign: Aligning Task Requirements with Model Profiles for LLM Service Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08162)
*Jihao Zhao,Ding Chen,Yanfang Chen,Bo Tang,Feiyu Xiong,Junchi Yan,Zhiyu Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RouteAlign 用任务需求(能力需求与难度)来结构化 LLM 性能测量与服务选择,使测量粒度与当前任务对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合分数掩盖了模型能力差异与任务难度差异,且语义相近的样例可能涉及不同技能组合,导致 LLM 服务选择缺乏反映当前任务需求的性能证据。

Method: 用任务需求同时驱动性能测量与服务选择:历史需求决定结果如何贡献到全局画像与局部能力估计,当前需求决定这些测量如何用于当下决策;通过共享打分器整合证据,并用生成成本偏好约束可选服务间的选择。

Result: 在多样任务与异构 LLM 服务上的评测显示,RouteAlign 将经验质量-成本前沿向更高质量方向推近;相比开源 Jev 风格决策后端取得稳定质量提升,且生成成本低于其最强测试配置;消融实验支持局部性能证据的作用,目录更新实验证明拟合打分器可在模型测量刷新后被有效复用。

Conclusion: 以任务需求为中心的测量与选择对齐,可在控制成本的同时提升 LLM 服务路由质量,并具备良好的可复用性。

Abstract: LLM service selection requires performance evidence that reflects the demands of the current task. Aggregate scores obscure differences in capability and difficulty, while semantically related examples can involve different combinations of skills. We present RouteAlign, which uses task requirements to structure both the measurement of model performance and the selection of services. Task requirements describe capability demand and difficulty, enabling alignment with corresponding model performance measurements. Historical requirements determine how outcomes contribute to global profiles and local capability estimates; incoming requirements determine how those measurements inform the current decision. A shared scorer integrates the evidence, and a generation-cost preference controls selection among eligible services. Evaluation across diverse tasks and heterogeneous LLM services shows that RouteAlign extends the empirical quality-cost frontier toward higher task quality. Comparisons with open Jev-style decision backends show consistent quality gains, with lower generation cost than their strongest tested configuration. Ablations support the contribution of local performance evidence, while catalog-update experiments demonstrate effective reuse of the fitted scorer with refreshed model measurements.

</details>


### [220] [Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08269)
*Xiaobo Chen,Genliang Zhu,Ziyuan Wang,Chu Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究运行时/API迁移后由LLM修复的程序"能跑但结果错"的问题，通过73个任务、覆盖CPython/Node.js/SQLite共60项有文档记录的行为变化，验证"典型输入上的全断言门禁"会大量放行错误修复；引入来自发布说明的一条边界输入可把错误放行率从0.410降到0.065，前沿模型盲写输入达0.070。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM修复的迁移代码常能正常运行却返回错误结果，而基于典型测试输入的发布门禁会将其放行，存在真实的工程风险，需量化并寻找低成本的检测手段。

Method: 预注册研究：73个任务、60项文档化变更；每个候选在真实运行时上对隐藏契约执行；比较典型输入门禁、基于发布说明的单条边界输入、盲写GPT-5.6-luna的三条输入、自测；扩展到1491片段菜单并加入233个在典型输入上与旧输出一致的困难干扰项；跨四个模型族（含三个开源权重族）评估；另做盲AI审计检查契约是否过严。

Result: 典型输入全断言门禁错误放行率0.410；一条边界输入降至0.065（15个未见簇0.061）；盲写前沿模型输入0.070；加入困难干扰项后边界输入0.058、前沿模型0.058通过预注册测试，但仍有0.168与0.153的硬错误程序被放行；两个本地模型写作者未通过预注册测试；边界输入在三个开源权重族的全部菜单上均降低每次尝试的错误放行（如0.233→0.057）且不降低正确完成率；自测帮助较小；AI审计标出34条过严契约，删除后判定结论不变。

Conclusion: 少数精心设计的边界输入是低成本、可泛化的防错放行手段，明显优于典型输入全断言门禁与自测；幻觉式"硬干扰项"仍能骗过前沿模型写作者，说明单一输入策略有上限。删减被质疑的契约不改变结论，但类标签争议尚未解决；未执行任何模型生成的代码，工件需向作者索取。

Abstract: After a runtime or API migration, an LLM-repaired procedure can run cleanly yet return wrong results, and a release check on typical test inputs ships it. We report a preregistered study of 73 tasks covering 60 documented changes in CPython, Node.js and SQLite. Every candidate is executed on the real runtimes against withheld contracts. Over the complete repair space, the all-assertions gate on typical inputs released 0.410 of wrong repairs. One edge input written from the release note cut this to 0.065, and to 0.061 on 15 unseen clusters. Three inputs from a blind GPT-5.6-luna writer that never saw the program reached 0.070. Two further frozen stages enlarged the menu to 1491 fragments and then added 233 hard distractors that match the legacy output on typical inputs. The edge input (0.058) and the frontier-model writer (0.058) passed their preregistered tests. Yet 0.168 and 0.153 of the hard wrong programs still passed. Two local-model writers failed their preregistered tests. Across four model families, the edge input cut wrong releases per attempt in all three open-weight families on all three menus, for example from 0.233 to 0.057, without lowering correct completion. Self-tests helped less. A blind AI audit flagged 34 contracts as stricter than their requirements. Dropping the disputed checks changed 0 verdicts, but class-label disputes remain open. No model-written code was executed. Artifacts are available from the authors on request.

</details>


### [221] [Hard Issue, Weak Model, or Bad Run? Rethinking Failure Prediction for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08285)
*Xingyue Shi,Wesley K. G. Assunção*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 轨迹型失败预测器（trajectory-based failure predictors）在SWE-bench Verified上几乎没学到"运行本身"的信息，其性能主要被议题难度和模型能力这两个与运行无关的因素主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SE智能体的轨迹失败预测器被用于在运行时判断成败并触发停止/重试/切换模型，但作者质疑这些预测器是否真正学到了关于该次运行的信息，还是仅仅在隐式预测议题难度与模型能力。

Method: 在公开SWE-bench Verified轨迹上做对照分析：构造一个不查看轨迹、只看议题对其他模型难度的参考分数；比较"是否知道哪个模型执行"的预测力；对轨迹增益做统计等价性检验；检验切换增益与随机波动的关系，并做重复运行试点实验。

Result: 难度参考分数达0.92 AUROC，而轨迹预测器仅约0.62；在同一议题内，仅凭模型身份预测失败优于预测器；轨迹带来的额外增益统计上等于零。最佳单模型与any-model oracle之间的差距不超出随机波动，按议题切换在留出运行上无收益；重复运行显示重试只能挽救"坏运行"类失败。

Conclusion: 当前预测器主要预测的是"议题"和"模型"而非"运行"。作者呼吁开发能解释失败原因的失败预测，并在重复运行基准与闭环、等预算设定下评估。

Abstract: Trajectory-based failure predictors for software engineering (SE) agents read the partial trajectory of a run to flag whether it is going right or wrong. If it is going wrong, the run can be stopped, retried, or switched to another model. We ask whether these predictors learn anything about the run itself. On public SWE-bench Verified trajectories, where each model attempts each issue once, two run-independent factors dominate predictor performance. The first is issue difficulty: a reference score that never looks at the run, only at how hard the issue is for other models, reaches 0.92 AUROC, whereas trajectory predictors reach about 0.62. The second is model ability: within an issue, knowing which model ran predicts failure better than our predictors do, and the predictors largely reproduce the overall ability ranking of the models. Beyond difficulty and ability, what predictors gain from the trajectory is statistically equivalent to zero. This confusion carries over to the actions taken after a prediction. Model switching is often motivated by the gap between the best single model's resolution rate and an any-model oracle. This gap is no larger than random variation alone produces. Per-issue switching gains nothing on held-out runs. In a repeated-run pilot, the same model often solves an issue in some runs and fails it in others. Retrying thus has real room to repair failures, but it rescues only failures caused by a bad run, not those on an issue beyond the model's ability. Current predictors cannot tell the causes apart, as they mostly predict the issue and the model, not the run. We call for failure prediction that explains why a run fails, evaluated on repeated-run benchmarks and in closed-loop, equal-budget settings.

</details>


### [222] [SoK: Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Integration in Software Development: Approaches, Gaps, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08442)
*Shakya R. D. N.,Craig Costello,Nalin A. G. Arachchilage*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文是对软件中后量子密码(PQC)集成的系统性知识梳理(SoK),指出标准化算法不足以支撑安全集成,现有研究虽奠定技术与组织基础,但在软件开发生命周期上支持碎片化,评估证据多集中于受控/早期场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PQC标准化对抵御量子威胁至关重要,但仅靠标准算法无法提供安全集成的路径,缺乏对现有集成、迁移与开发者教育方法的整体性认识。

Method: 对软件开发中PQC集成的现有方法进行SoK,从实现、迁移、开发者教育三方面综合,并以NIST PQC标准与迁移指南、开发生命周期覆盖、网络安全实践、部署成熟度、测试与评估证据为维度分析。

Result: 现有工作奠定重要技术与组织基础,但生命周期各阶段(准备、实现、迁移、部署、维护与开发者实践)之间协调不足;评估证据集中于受控或早期阶段,技术可行性证据强于运行就绪性。

Conclusion: 识别出跨领域空白,提出面向生命周期、经实证验证的研究方向,以连接技术、开发者与组织需求,实现安全的PQC集成。

Abstract: Standardised post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is critical for protecting software systems against future quantum threats, but standardised algorithms alone do not provide a pathway for their secure integration into software. This paper presents a Systematisation of Knowledge (SoK) of PQC integration in software development, synthesising existing approaches across implementation, migration, and developer education. We analyse these approaches against NIST PQC standards and PQC migration guidance, software development lifecycle coverage, cybersecurity practices, deployment maturity, and testing and evaluation evidence. Our analysis shows that existing work establishes important technical and organisational foundations but provides disconnected support across the software development lifecycle, with limited coordination between preparation, implementation, migration, deployment, maintenance, and developer practices. Evaluation evidence also remains concentrated in controlled or early-stage settings, providing stronger evidence of technical feasibility than operational readiness. We identify cross-cutting gaps and research directions for developing lifecycle-oriented, empirically validated approaches that connect technical, developer, and organisational requirements for secure PQC integration.

</details>


### [223] [Cognitive Tours: Making Understanding a Deliverable in AI-Assisted Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08456)
*Margaret-Anne Storey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出名为Cognitive Tours的网页原型，通过构建连接用户需求、设计决策、代码、测试与开放问题的"curated paths"来缓解生成式AI与agentic coding带来的认知债与意图债，AI辅助审计、人类负责意义建构，并用自举示例展示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI与智能体编码加速软件开发，引发技术债担忧；但更隐蔽的认知债（团队共享理解缺失，无人能解释系统如何工作或预测变更影响）与意图债（缺少明确目标、约束与理由）正成为软件健康的关键风险。

Method: 设计并实现Cognitive Tours网页原型：创建/跟踪连接用户需求、设计决策、代码、测试与开放问题的设定路径（tour/waypoint）；AI辅助技能审计路标的过时或问题、推荐新路标，人类决定重要性、核实关系并构建叙事，刻意保留"生产性摩擦"以促进共享理解。

Result: 以工具自身的tour作为演示，介绍工具并说明其设计决策与交互机制；提供在线demo；论文以提出的评估议程收尾。

Conclusion: AI辅助+人类叙事分工的设计可维护认知与意图债；未来需按评估议程验证其对团队理解与软件健康的作用。

Abstract: Generative AI and agentic coding are accelerating software development, leading to concerns about technical debt. But two less visible forms of debt, cognitive debt and intent debt, are emerging as key risks to software health. Cognitive debt is the absence or erosion of a team's shared understanding where no one can confidently explain how a system works or predict the impact of a change. Intent debt is the lack of clearly articulated goals, constraints, and rationale that explain what the system is for and guide how it should evolve. This paper presents Cognitive Tours, a tool designed to mitigate and repair cognitive and intent debt. Cognitive Tours is a web-based prototype for creating and following curated paths connecting user needs, design decisions, code, tests, and open questions. AI-assisted skills help audit existing waypoints and tours for possible problems or staleness and suggest candidates for new ones; humans decide what matters, verify relationships, and construct the narrative. This division of work deliberately preserves productive friction: the sensemaking involved in selecting, explaining, and revising a tour, which is intended to foster and share understanding. Our demonstration uses a tour of Cognitive Tours itself to introduce the tool and illustrate its design decisions and interaction mechanisms. A proposed evaluation agenda concludes the paper. A demo is available at https://cognitive-tours-demo.vercel.app/

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [224] [DiaHeads: Jointly Generating Coordinated 3D Dialogue Heads with Non-verbal Cues from Dual Audio](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06970)
*Jiahe Wang,Yuxin Wang,Xin Yun,Binyan Chen,Tong Pan,Zhenjie Liu,Shangfei Wang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: DiaHeads：联合生成双人对话双方音频驱动的3D头部行为，引入四种非言语线索与基于流的先验以提升人际协调性，并构建CANDOR-FG数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对话头部生成方法忽略了两位参与者之间非言语行为语义的建模，难以生成协调的双人交互行为。

Method: 将两条音频流拼接后联合解码，使每人的动作以对方为条件；引入注视、摇头、点头、微笑四种离散非言语线索，通过专家乘积后验与连续参数在共享潜空间融合；用基于流的先验替代标准高斯先验以建模时间依赖；并构建带同步FLAME参数和3D注视的CANDOR-FG语料。

Result: 在CANDOR-FG上，单人保真度具竞争力，人际协调性较单人及双人基线显著提升；消融实验确认联合生成、流式先验与多线索监督是协调性来源；用户研究表明其优势来自感知到的交互协调而非单纯动作保真度。

Conclusion: 对话头部生成的关键在于显式建模双人交互语义与时间依赖，而非仅提升单人生成质量。

Abstract: Audio-driven 3D head animation has made considerable progress in generation realism, yet generating coordinated behavior for two-person dialogue remains difficult, because current dialogue head generation methods overlook the modeling of non-verbal behavior semantics between the two participants. To address this limitation, we present DiaHeads, a framework that generates the behavior of both participants jointly. The two audio streams are concatenated and decoded together, so each participant's motion is conditioned on the other, which makes the interaction part of the generation itself. We further introduce four discrete non-verbal cues, gaze-on, head shaking, nodding, and smiling, and fuse them with the continuous parameters in a shared latent space through a product-of-experts posterior. These cues carry the interaction semantics and constrain how the continuous motion is generated. A flow-based prior over the shared latent variable replaces the standard Gaussian prior and makes the latent motion temporally dependent. These designs therefore yield coordinated 3D dialogue heads. To support this task we build CANDOR-FG, a dialogue corpus derived from CANDOR and augmented with synchronized FLAME parameters and 3D gaze for both interlocutors. Experiments on CANDOR-FG show that DiaHeads achieves competitive per-participant fidelity and substantial gains in interpersonal coordination over single-speaker and dyadic baselines. In addition, ablations confirm that joint generation, the flow-based prior, and multi-cue supervision are the sources of this coordination. Finally, a user study shows that the advantage of DiaHeads comes from perceived interactional coordination rather than from raw motion fidelity alone.

</details>

### [225] [Formalizing inverse problems in the age of AI: possibilities, pitfalls, and an invitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06962)
*Christian Clason,Tapio Helin,Medet Nursultanov,Lauri Oksanen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AutoIP——一个由 AI 智能体自动形式化的 Lean 库，收录经典线性正则化理论及其依赖的泛函分析内容；其核心组织原则是让人类评审者只需对照形式化陈述与自然语言陈述，无需阅读证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证明助手（如 Lean）能从头验证数学证明，AI 智能体也让写形式化证明变得廉价，但机器验证只保证形式陈述本身，不保证它表达了原本意图；因此真正的风险与人力瓶颈转移到了"陈述是否忠实"这一环节。

Method: 用 AI 智能体将线性正则化理论及相关泛函分析形式化进 Lean，并围绕"陈述审查"来组织库的结构：评审者只比较形式陈述与其自然语言对应物，不必读证明；同时对陈述设计简单的自动化测试以暴露问题。

Result: 经验表明风险主要在陈述而非证明；针对陈述的简单自动测试甚至能发现既有文献（如某教科书定理的假设比其表述更严格）中的问题。

Conclusion: 机器验证的瓶颈已从证明转向陈述正确性；作者邀请反问题社区扩展并基于该库继续工作。

Abstract: Proof assistants such as Lean check mathematical proofs down to the axioms, and AI agents have recently made writing such proofs cheap. We describe AutoIP, a Lean library in which classical linear regularization theory, together with the functional analysis it rests on, has been autoformalized by AI agents. A machine-checked proof certifies only the formal statement it proves, so the remaining human task is to confirm that each formal statement says what was intended. We organize the library around this task: a reviewer compares the formal statements with their natural-language counterparts and never needs to read a proof. Our experience is that the risks lie in the statements rather than in the proofs, and that simple automated tests on the statements can expose problems even in the established literature. We illustrate this with a textbook theorem whose hypothesis is more restrictive than asserted. We invite the inverse problems community to extend and build on the library.

</details>


### [226] [SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08483)
*Qile Jiang,George Em Karniadakis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SwarmEvolve 用大量低成本Agent在潜空间中协同进化，通过共享KV cache实现并行swarm探索，大幅加速LLM引导的程序搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化搜索每轮需生成冗长的文本思维链，且为维持种群多样性需反复生成，导致速度慢、成本高。

Method: 每轮数百个低成本Agent组成swarm，从不同角度研究问题；在潜空间中推理不解码为文本；通过传递KV cache共享信息；用基于隐藏状态向量距离的新颖性过滤器保留最独特的想法；汇总Agent接收全体成员的KV cache组合，实现潜空间中的自然交叉。

Result: 在21个数学发现与科学计算问题上取得最高平均分；达到其他SOTA框架60分钟才达到的最佳分数，仅需中位数3–8分钟；在若干问题上Qwen3 8B版本的SwarmEvolve超越了AlphaEvolve用前沿LLM首次找到的解。

Conclusion: 在潜空间通信的Agent swarm为科学问题的程序搜索提供了快速、低成本的途径。

Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. We present SwarmEvolve, a framework in which hundreds of low-cost agents per round work in swarms, reason in latent space without decoding to text, and share information by passing KV caches. Each swarm studies the problem from a different angle. A novelty filter keeps the most distinct agent ideas by directly measuring the distances between the agents' hidden state vectors. Crossover of ideas happens naturally in latent space, as a summarizer agent receives the combined KV caches of all swarm members. On 21 problems in mathematical discovery and scientific computing, SwarmEvolve gets the highest average score and needs a median of only 3 to 8 minutes to reach the best scores that other state-of-the-art frameworks reach in 60 minutes. On several problems, SwarmEvolve with Qwen3 8B improves on the solutions that AlphaEvolve first found with frontier LLMs. Our work shows that agent swarms that communicate in latent space offer a fast, low-cost approach to program search for scientific problems.

</details>


### [227] [KDASO: Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization for Liability Adjudication Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06972)
*Zi-Jian Cheng,Weiming Wu,Jie Meng,Zhen Peng,Shan Huang,Qun Li,Guobing Wu,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KDASO通过"数据驱动技能归纳+执行对齐精炼+上下文预算路由"持续演化技能库，解决技能陈旧、语义执行差距与技能遗漏三大问题，在多类责任判定任务上优于通用与领域基线，并具备良好迁移性与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 责任判定任务需依据领域技能分析事件描述以判定责任归属。现有基于LLM可执行技能的可解释推理存在三缺陷：技能库随现实演化而陈旧、技能描述存在"语义-执行差距"使LLM偏离专家逻辑、技能规模超出上下文预算导致关键技能遗漏。

Method: 提出知识-数据双驱动的自动化技能优化框架KDASO，包含三部分：(1) 基于近期判例数据的邻域条件归纳，持续扩充演化技能库；(2) 基于LLM轨迹分析的执行对齐精炼，弥合语义与执行差距；(3) 上下文预算约束下的技能路由，实现可扩展的技能选择。

Result: 在网约车判责、法律责任认定、逻辑推理判断三类任务上显著优于通用及领域专用基线；技能迁移至概念相似场景时提升8.96%，并在持续优化中保持稳定增益。

Conclusion: KDASO能生成高可迁移、稳定的技能，支撑责任判定类任务的持续演化与可解释推理，验证了知识-数据双驱动技能优化的有效性。

Abstract: Liability adjudication tasks (e.g., legal charge determination) require analyzing event descriptions against domain-specific skills to determine whether a party should bear liability. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in this area by leveraging executable skills for interpretable reasoning, existing approaches face three critical limitations: skill libraries become stale as real-world scenarios dynamically evolve, skill descriptions often suffer from a semantic execution gap where LLMs deviate from intended expert logic, and growing skill collections exceed context budgets causing critical skill omission. To address these challenges, we propose Knowledge-Data Dual-Driven Automated Skill Optimization (KDASO), which continuously evolves a skill library through neighborhood-conditioned induction from recent adjudication data, execution-aligned refinement based on LLM trajectory analysis, and context-budgeted routing for scalable skill selection. Experiments across ride-hailing adjudication, legal liability determination, and logical reasoning judgment demonstrate that KDASO significantly outperforms current general-purpose and domain-specific baselines. KDASO further achieves 8.96% improvement when transferring skills to concept-similar scenarios and maintains consistent performance gains through continuous optimization, underscoring the high transferability and stability of generated skills.

</details>


### [228] [BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06977)
*Xiuyuan Qi,Pedro Reviriego,Javier Conde,Shanshan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 BlockLock，通过固定受保护请求所见的计算几何结构，在保留共享批量 prefill 的前提下实现逐位可复现的 LLM 推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复现推理要求同一请求的输入输出不受同批次其他请求影响，但现有方法（batch-invariant 内核约束所有算子、隔离 prefill 加定形 decode）分别带来性能损失或浪费共享 prefill 计算。

Method: BlockLock 仅固定受保护请求的数值路径：BlockLock-Rows 使用固定宽度行并保留所有请求的批量 decode；BlockLock-Pack 使用终端锚定的打包方式加独立 dummy 段，然后提取受保护请求的 KV 状态进行仅目标 decode。两种模式在给定部署契约下保持目标输出逐位一致。

Result: 在 5 个稠密模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT）与 A6000/A100/H100 三种单卡部署上于 tinyBenchmarks 和 BFCL 评测，并含双 A6000 张量并行初步实验；两种模式均保持目标序列与 Top20 logit 位一致。等交付工作量下，BlockLock-Rows 相比 vLLM Batch-Invariant 降低时延 53.5–55.0%，吞吐提升 115.2–122.2%。

Conclusion: BlockLock 无需自定义内核、仅约束受保护请求即可实现可复现推理，在保持共享 prefill 的同时显著优于 batch-invariant 内核方案。

Abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. Under a stated per-deployment contract, both modes preserve the target's output bitwise when its companions change.} Across five {dense} models (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT) and three single-GPU deployments (NVIDIA A6000, A100, and H100), we evaluate our approach on both tinyBenchmarks and BFCL{; we also include initial tensor-parallel experiments on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Both modes preserve target sequences and Top20-logit bits in the reported tests.} At equal delivered work, {BlockLock-Rows} reduces latency by 53.5--55.0\% and improves throughput by 115.2--122.2\% relative to vLLM Batch-Invariant; compared with batch-invariant kernels, it needs no custom kernel implementations and constrains only the protected requests.

</details>


### [229] [Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06984)
*Jia Wei,Ziyi Qiu,Yi Xu,Xuehai Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FlexFloor 通过联合调整响应调度与活跃 worker 组，在同步生成过程中提前释放完成任务的 worker，同时保留他人所需的专家计算，显著提升 MoE 模型 RL 后训练的效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 后训练能提升大模型能力，但生成训练响应是主要计算瓶颈。在 MoE 模型中，先完成响应的 worker 因自身专家仍被长响应任务使用而无法释放，导致基线中约三分之一的占用 worker 时间浪费在本地生成结束之后。

Method: 提出 FlexFloor 系统，在同步响应生成中实现早期资源释放：联合自适应响应调度与活跃 worker 组；利用历史响应长度和内存约束指导 batching 与 prompt 分配，随后渐进释放 worker，同时保证专家可用性与通信正确性。

Result: 相比 verl 基线，单位占用计算时间生成的响应 token 数增加约 65.40%，响应生成吞吐量提升 52.74%，rollout reward 几乎无变化。

Conclusion: FlexFloor 提升了 RL 后训练效率，有助于加速大模型与 AI 智能体的开发与迭代改进。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning post-training improves the capabilities of large language models, but generating training responses is a major computational bottleneck. In mixture-of-experts models, workers that finish their assigned responses may remain occupied because their experts are still needed by workers processing longer responses. Consequently, approximately one-third of occupied worker time in the baseline occurs after local response generation finishes. Here we present FlexFloor, a system that enables earlier resource release during synchronous response generation while preserving the expert computation required by ongoing responses. FlexFloor jointly adapts response scheduling and the active group of workers. It uses historical response lengths and memory constraints to guide batching and prompt placement, then progressively releases workers while maintaining expert availability and correct communication. Compared with the verl baseline, FlexFloor generates approximately 65.40% more response tokens per unit of occupied computing time and increases response generation throughput by 52.74%, with little observed variation in rollout reward. By making reinforcement learning post-training more efficient, FlexFloor supports faster development and iterative improvement of large language models and AI agents.

</details>


### [230] [The Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds, Models, and Systems of Record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06989)
*Vivek Acharya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"双账本模型"(Two-Ledger Model),将FOCUS合规的结算账本与基于OpenTelemetry GenAI的调用粒度归因账本关联,解决AI成本无法按业务交易(订单/理赔/案件)归集的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业用多智能体AI系统(involving clouds, LLMs, orchestration harnesses, systems of record)运行业务交易,但财务只能拿到按SKU和计费周期聚合的结算粒度AI成本。云厂商看不到企业交易边界,因此"这笔订单/理赔/案件消耗了多少AI成本"无法从账单数据回答。FOCUS虽统一了账单schema并加入token与请求者归因,仍停留在结算粒度,存在粒度错配(grain mismatch)。

Method: 形式化粒度错配并推导出七项需求。设计双账本:(1)符合FOCUS的结算账本;(2)基于OpenTelemetry GenAI遥测的调用粒度归因账本。用分层关联脊(spine)把每条记录指派到业务交易——依次为trace context、A2A/MCP元数据、业务键关联、概率匹配,并记录匹配方法与置信度;版本化价目表(rate card)近实时计价;周期性对账将两账本与发票核对,未解释残差识别影子AI(shadow AI)。用已知真值的仿真评估。

Result: 仿真显示:当trace传播降至零时,关联脊仍维持99%以上成本覆盖率;对账残差在0.24个百分点内恢复被植入的未计量支出,同时能标记供应商计费错误;飞行中门控(mid-flight gating)将p99交易成本最多降低61%,误暂停率2-4%。

Conclusion: 按订单、理赔或业务成果报告成本,并提供智能体化成本指标。建议将归因账本作为调用粒度的FOCUS profile提交标准化。

Abstract: Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. The FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) gives billing data one schema across providers but remains settlement-grain even as it adds AI token and requester attribution. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. A layered correlation spine (trace context, A2A/MCP metadata, business-key correlation, probabilistic matching) assigns each record to its business transaction with recorded method and confidence; a versioned rate card prices usage in near real time; period reconciliation ties both ledgers to the invoice, and the unexplained residual identifies shadow AI. Costs are reported per order, claim, or outcome with agentic cost metrics. A simulation with known ground truth shows the spine sustaining cost coverage above 99% as trace propagation falls to zero, the reconciliation residual recovering planted unmetered spend within 0.24 percentage points while flagging provider billing errors, and mid-flight gating cutting p99 transaction cost by up to 61% at a 2-4% false-pause rate. We propose the attribution ledger as an invocation-grain FOCUS profile for standardization.

</details>


### [231] [Autonomous AI Agents Systematically Diverge From Human Preferences in Proof Formalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06995)
*Bálint Gyevnár,Simon DeDeo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"模拟协作"方法，通过对比AI与人类在Lean证明构建中的注意力偏好，发现AI更关注表层语法（如显式标记的缺口），回避复杂的证明核心，并倾向将异常证明体规则化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI带来"证明过剩"，但人类难以理解这些证明。需要研究AI智能体与人类在证明构建任务中的行为差异，特别是二者对表层语法与深层语义的注意力分配，以及下一步行动偏好的分歧点。

Method: 提出"模拟协作"（simulated collaboration）方法论，基于Lean中九项重要的人类协作项目（470万条定义、逾6000次提交），对AI智能体与人类在证明构建过程中的关注点和行为偏好进行对比分析。

Result: 发现：(1) AI比人类更强烈地被显式标记的缺口吸引；(2) AI相对回避密集连接的证明核心以及复杂或意外的证明目标；(3) AI相对被意外的证明体吸引，并倾向将其规则化至基线水平。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了AI在数学证明中的盲点，并为未来人机数学协作中的干预措施提供了启示。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems have ushered in a new age of proof abundance, but helping humans understand these proofs requires new attention to the differences in how AI agents and humans pursue a proof-making task. We present "simulated collaboration", a methodology that allows us to examine two key questions: (1) the relative attention AI agents pay to surface syntax or, conversely, deeper underlying semantics, and (2) how and where AI agent preferences for what to do next diverge from human preferences. On a set of nine major human collaborations in Lean with 4.7M definitions across more than 6K commits, we find that, over the course of proof construction, AI agents (1) are far more strongly drawn than humans to explicitly marked gaps; (2) show a relative aversion to densely connected proof centers and to complex or surprising proof goals; and (3) are relatively attracted to surprising proof bodies, which they tend to regularize toward baseline. Our results highlight important blind spots and potential interventions for future human-AI collaboration in mathematics.

</details>


### [232] [Trust Responsive Runtime Authorization for Agentic AI with Empirical Characterization of Policy Behavior and Parameter Sensitivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06996)
*Ahsan Habib Shihab,Imre Felde,Ramis Akhmedov,Stefan Gubo,Berik Sabdenaliyev,Madina Mansurova,Amir Mosavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文实证刻画了"信任响应授权策略"(TRAP)：将运行时信任、运行稳定性与情境风险加权成授权就绪分(ARS)，并用非对称规则映射为离散授权级别（升级需连续多次超过带边界加余量，就绪骤降则立即限权）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体常把运行时状态估计转化为操作权限，但这种转换策略极少被明确规定或度量，缺乏可比较、可复现的评估。

Method: 在100条匹配的蒙特卡洛轨迹上，将TRAP与静态、仅信任、仅风险、对称四类策略对比；用配对bootstrap区间检验差异，并做单因子扫描与降级跨5–20区间的探索性后冻结实验。

Result: 突变降级下TRAP在起点即限权、恢复后比对称策略更快重授权，稳定性最高且描述上波动最小，但更多重授权发生在低于信任阈值处；恢复时间随升级余量与运行长度上升、随权重变化、不受限权阈值影响。降级被摊薄到多区间时，TRAP仅在4条保留单区间骤降的轨迹上限权，平均有15.9–18.9/20区间越权持有。

Conclusion: TRAP的限权优势依赖降级的突变性；渐进降级下其非对称规则几乎不触发，安全优势不成立。所有数值可在公开版本化研究发布中追溯。

Abstract: The policy that converts runtime estimates of an autonomous agent's condition into operational authority is rarely specified or measured. We empirically characterize the Trust Responsive Authorization Policy (TRAP), which maps an Authorization Readiness Score (ARS), a weighted combination of runtime trust, operational stability, and contextual risk, onto discrete authorization levels through an asymmetric rule: escalation requires consecutive observations above a band edge plus a margin, while a sharp drop in readiness restricts authority at once. On one matched set of 100 Monte Carlo traces, we compare TRAP with static, trust-only, risk-only, and symmetric policies. Under abrupt degradation, TRAP restricts at onset and re-escalates sooner after recovery than the symmetric policy, with the highest and, descriptively, least variable stability among the adaptive policies, although more of its post-recovery escalations occur below the selected trust threshold. Paired bootstrap intervals exclude zero for the remaining differences. In one-factor sweeps, recovery time rises with the escalation margin and run length, shifts with the score weights, and is unchanged by the restriction threshold. In an exploratory post-freeze experiment, when the same degradation is spread over 5-20 intervals, TRAP restricts only on the 4 traces that retain a single-interval drop above that threshold; averaged over all 100 traces, it holds authority above what readiness supports for 15.9-18.9 of the 20 degradation intervals, against 0.8 under abrupt degradation and about 10 for the symmetric policy. Its restriction advantage therefore depends on degradation being abrupt. All reported values are traceable to the publicly available, versioned research release.

</details>


### [233] [Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07048)
*Andrew W. Lo,Chaoyi Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出理论框架比较达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体主导式演化，指出学习越有效、变异生成越多则适应越快，但目标评估错误会导致更快的错误收敛，对AI安全构成挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体已能修改并评估自身行为，智能或可指导自身演化；需理解这种自我改进的速度以及如何保持安全，尤其在地理/环境变化之后不同演化机制的适应效率差异尚缺理论刻画。

Method: 构建理论框架，对比达尔文式演化（自然选择）、拉马克式演化（加入可继承的学习）与智能体主导式演化（智能体生成并评估行为变体、选择搜索广度），分析环境变化下的适应速度、搜索努力的最优性与评估目标错配的影响。

Result: 学习足够有效时三种机制适应依次加快；生成更多变体加速适应；最优搜索努力取决于学习能力、问题难度与实验成本；当评估目标被错误指定时，更多搜索会加速收敛到错误行为，即使测得的性能在提升，且此类错误可在递归自我改进中跨代持续。

Conclusion: 核心挑战不只是加速智能演化，而是保持人类引导方向、限制速度并在必要时干预的能力；独立评估与监督必须跟上自主AI的发展步伐。

Abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior, how quickly could they improve, and how can that improvement remain safe? We develop a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian, and agent-directed evolution following environmental change. Darwinian evolution relies on natural selection, Lamarckian evolution adds inherited learning, and agent-directed evolution allows agents to generate and evaluate behavioral variants and choose how extensively to search. When learning is sufficiently effective, these mechanisms exhibit progressively faster adaptation. Generating more variants accelerates adaptation, while optimal search effort depends on learning ability, problem difficulty, and experimentation costs. However, an agent's ability to direct its improvement does not ensure that improvements are evaluated against the intended objective. When the evaluation target is misspecified, additional search accelerates convergence toward the wrong behavior, even as measured performance improves. In recursive self-improvement, such errors may persist across generations, posing challenges for AI safety. Independent evaluation and oversight must keep pace with autonomous AI development. The central challenge is not simply to accelerate the evolution of intelligence, but to preserve humanity's ability to guide its direction, limit its speed, and intervene when necessary.

</details>


### [234] [Closed-Loop Agent Evaluation: Layered Measurement and Self-Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07051)
*Ruifeng Ren,Gun Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"闭环评估"方法，将已部署智能体的评估建模为有偏评分者与删失结果条件下的性能估计，并通过内外双环实现证据可追溯与逐组件回归改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体评估多为一次性：跑一次基准、看一遍轨迹、给一个分数，结论既不自我校验也不回流到智能体本身，难以回答"部署后它是否在干好本职工作"。

Method: 把评估视为有偏评分者+删失结果下的性能估计；要求各层级结论可回溯到原子数据并由版本化规则计算。覆盖span、trace、conversation、engagement四层分析，沿Execution、Substance、Trajectory、Results主干度量，Conduct作为全程约束，用Provenance与Adjudication组件认证证据与评估者。由Agent Factory生成带领域知识包与适配器harness的评估者智能体。内环审计证据/规则/指标本身，外环以逐组件回归检查驱动改进，并给出自动化流水线。

Result: 以商业分析智能体SharpInsight为案例并移植到公开对话数据：不同层级问题表现不同；证据-规则式判断比整体打分更可靠（ICC 0.86 vs 0.81；kappa 0.81 vs 0.63）。

Conclusion: 闭环评估为部署后智能体提供可追溯、可自检、可回流的评估范式，证据-规则判断优于holistic评分，并通过自动化流水线落地。

Abstract: Once an agent is live, teams want to know whether it is doing its job, not just whether it throws errors. Yet most evaluation is one-off: a benchmark run, a look at traces, a single score. Its conclusions neither check themselves nor reach the agent. We propose closed-loop evaluation, an evaluation method for deployed agents. It models evaluation as performance estimation under biased raters and censored outcomes, and it requires every level's conclusion to trace back to atomic data and to be computed by versioned rules. The method covers four levels of analysis (span, trace, conversation and engagement), measures along a spine of Execution, Substance, Trajectory and Results, treats Conduct as a constraint throughout, and uses Provenance and Adjudication components to certify the evidence and the evaluators. Evaluator agents generated by an Agent Factory carry these components, each with a domain knowledge pack and an adapter harness. Two loops close the evaluation: an inner loop audits the evidence, rules and metrics themselves, and an outer loop uses per-component regression checks to drive agent improvement. We also give a pipeline that runs this process automatically. Using the business-analysis agent SharpInsight as a case and porting the method to public conversation data, we show how problems differ across levels and how evidence-and-rule judgment is more reliable than holistic scoring (ICC 0.86 vs. 0.81; kappa 0.81 vs. 0.63).

</details>


### [235] [Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Form Guided Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07066)
*Sungil Son,Hoseong Jung,Dahyun Oh,H. Jin Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EFXPLORER，一种带约束的探索框架，在保持任务性能的前提下最大化探索目标，通过 epigraph 重构成自适应探索预算，结合后继距离内在奖励促进长时程多样化探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MARL 中联合状态-动作空间的组合复杂度使协同行为难以仅靠试错发现；常用内在奖励与团队目标简单混合会扭曲学习信号、损害任务性能，因此需要一种既鼓励探索又不破坏已有任务性能的机制。

Method: 将探索建模为约束优化问题：在"保持现有任务性能"的约束下最大化探索目标；用 epigraph 重构引入自适应探索预算，将内在奖励与任务目标分离并用任务可行性调节探索；并加入基于后继距离（successor distance）的内在奖励以捕获长时程依赖、鼓励多样化且时间延展的探索。

Result: 在 SMAX、VMAS 和 MPE 三个基准套件上优于强基线，并诱导出新的协同策略。

Conclusion: 通过约束式探索与任务可行性调节，EFXPLORER 能有效平衡探索与任务性能，促进 MARL 中协同行为的发现，具备跨多种基准的泛化性。

Abstract: Discovering cooperative behavior in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is challenging due to the combinatorial complexity of joint state-action spaces, which hinders the emergence of coordinated behaviors from trial-and-error alone. Intrinsic rewards are often used to aid discovery, but naively combining them with team objectives can distort the learning signal, compromising task performance. In this paper, we propose EFXPLORER, a constrained exploration framework that maximizes exploration objectives subject to a constraint that preserves established task performance. We solve the resulting problem using an epigraph reformulation that introduces adaptive exploration budgets. This approach separates intrinsic rewards from task objectives and regulates exploration through task feasibility. To further encourage diverse and temporally extended exploration, we incorporate a successor distance-based intrinsic reward that captures long-horizon dependencies. Empirically, our method outperforms strong baselines and induces novel cooperative strategies across SMAX, VMAS, and MPE benchmark suites.

</details>


### [236] [Persistent Retrieval for Conversational Agents: A Study of Retrieval Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07899)
*Karthik Ravula,Sathwik Kowtha,Rishabh Verma,Kala Mehak Jain,Gunjit Mittal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 比较三种对话检索架构：主智能体技能式检索、非持久化检索子智能体、以及本文提出的持久化检索子智能体（跨轮维护检索历史并直接返回证据），在五类多轮企业问答场景中取得更优的token/成本/时延权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话智能体可选择自行检索或委托子智能体检索，这一设计影响检索历史的维护、每次模型调用所接收的上下文，以及后续追问中需要重新检索的信息，因此需要系统比较不同设计的效果。

Method: 提出持久化检索子智能体：在多轮对话中维护检索历史，向主智能体直接返回检索到的证据而非合成答案，并支持主智能体向同一子智能体请求修正。与技能式检索、非持久化检索子智能体在独立问题、共享会话问题及依赖式追问三类企业问题上进行对比评估，覆盖五种多轮设置。

Result: 相比技能式检索：记录token减少43.3%，估计API成本降低45.0%，平均响应时间缩短9.1%。相比非持久化检索：每问题响应时间减少15.6秒，但token多65.1%、API成本高29.1%。

Conclusion: 该设计将检索子智能体的角色从"生成合成回答"转变为"维护检索状态并提供证据"，由主智能体直接评估证据并生成答案，从而在成本与延迟间取得更优权衡。

Abstract: Conversational agents can retrieve information directly or delegate retrieval to a subagent. This design choice affects how retrieval history is maintained, what context each model call receives, and what information must be re-retrieved in follow-up questions. We compare three designs: skill-based retrieval in the main agent, a non-persistent retrieval subagent that generates a findings response, and our persistent retrieval subagent, which maintains retrieval history across turns and returns retrieved evidence directly to the main agent. Our approach also allows the main agent to request corrections from the same subagent.
  We evaluate the three designs on enterprise questions posed independently, within shared conversations, and as dependent follow-ups. Across five multi-turn settings, our approach uses 43.3% fewer recorded agent-model tokens and incurs 45.0% lower estimated API cost than skill-based retrieval, while reducing average response time by 9.1%. Compared with non-persistent retrieval, it reduces response time by 15.6 seconds per question, while using 65.1% more tokens and incurring 29.1% higher estimated API cost.
  Our approach shifts the retrieval subagent from producing synthesized responses to maintaining retrieval state and supplying evidence that the main agent can directly evaluate and use for answer generation.

</details>


### [237] [When Verification Is Not Agreement: Cross-Agent LLM-to-Dafny Formalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07073)
*Priyanath Maji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出跨智能体验证协议：Specifier将临床试验标准翻译为Dafny谓词，Implementer编写受其验证的操作方法，并揭示"验证通过≠独立推理一致"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已验证的Dafny后置条件只能证明公式成立，无法保证结果源于真正独立的推理；作者想检验跨模型交叉形式化能否作为独立一致性证据。

Method: 设计Specifier/Implementer双角色协议，在96份临床试验文件上评测四种模型配置，并设同模型对照（相同文本独立再抽取）作为基线，另做结构审计以识别验证伪迹。

Result: 同模型对照一致性仅59.3%；GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini在强模型作Implementer时53.0%，角色互换仅14.3%；最强配置GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini为34.4%，仍低于基线且42.7%为直接矛盾；发现弱Implementer直接调用Specifier谓词的后置条件伪迹，审计后14.3%降至13.2%。

Conclusion: 验证成功本身不足以证明跨代理独立一致；模型能力不保证独立形式化同一来源时的一致性，需进行结构审计。

Abstract: A verified Dafny postcondition certifies that a formula holds, but it does not guarantee that the result was reached through genuine independent reasoning. We introduce a cross-agent formalization protocol where a Specifier model translates clinical trial criteria into a Dafny predicate, and an Implementer model writes an operational method checked against it. A same-model control establishes that even with no capability gap, independent re-extraction from identical text agrees only 59.3% of the time. Evaluating four model configurations on 96 clinical trial documents, we find that agreement is highly sensitive to how model capability is allocated across the two roles: the GPT-4.1-nano/GPT-4.1-mini configuration achieves 53.0% agreement when the stronger model is the Implementer, but only 14.3% when the roles are reversed. The strongest tested configuration, GPT-5.6-luna/GPT-5.4-mini, improves agreement to 34.4% but remains below the same-model baseline and is dominated by direct contradiction (42.7%). We also detect a critical verification artifact in which a weaker Implementer satisfies the postcondition by invoking the Specifier's predicate directly; after structural auditing, corrected agreement falls from 14.3% to 13.2%. Our results show that verification success alone is insufficient evidence of independent cross-agent agreement, and that model capability does not guarantee agreement when formalizing the same source independently.

</details>


### [238] [Synthesizing symbolic models of human and machine reasoning at scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07088)
*Solim LeGris,Philipp Mondorf,Jinran Jin,Akshay K. Jagadish,Brenden M. Lake,Todd M. Gureckis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Behavior-Conditioned Symbolic Synthesis (BCSS)，用AI自动搜索可解释的确定性符号程序以复现人类与机器的行为，并在数百个推理问题上揭示两者共享的"过度简化"与"局部规则"等认知特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 符号模型虽能有力解释认知，但受限于人工设计与计算可行性；作者希望借助AI进展扩展符号建模规模，并以此作为解读和比较人类与黑箱AI推理机制的统一工具。

Method: BCSS方法：自动化搜索可解释、确定性的符号程序，使其能可验证地复现行为；在数百个挑战性推理问题上，对人类与机器行为分别进行符号建模，并分析所得程序的结构与规律。

Result: 人类与机器都倾向于过度简化、采用仅能部分解释观察的规则、并错误推断问题特征间的依赖关系；这些共同特征受可用资源调节，推理投入程度可预测机器的简化与解释程度。

Conclusion: 人类与机器均呈现类似"满足化(satisficing)"的底层机制；BCSS为解释与比较人类及黑箱AI的规则化推理提供了通用方法。

Abstract: Symbolic models offer a powerful account of cognition, but their scope has historically been limited by the need for hand-engineering and computational tractability. We show how advances in artificial intelligence (AI) can scale symbolic modeling and help overcome these engineering limitations. We introduce Behavior-Conditioned Symbolic Synthesis (BCSS)---an approach for automated search of interpretable, deterministic symbolic programs that verifiably reproduce behavior---and apply it to model both human and machine behavior across hundreds of challenging reasoning problems. Analyzing these programs reveals that both people and machines tend to oversimplify, adopt rules that are partial explanations for their observations, and misinfer dependencies between problem features. These shared signatures are modulated by available resources, with reasoning effort predicting the extent to which machines simplify and explain their observations. Together, these results point to underlying mechanisms reminiscent of satisficing in both people and machines, and illustrate how BCSS offers a general approach for interpreting and comparing rule-based reasoning of humans and black-box AI systems.

</details>


### [239] [PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07123)
*Sven Kleinkop,Tamás Janusko,Ricardo Bochnia,Gunnar Hempel,Steffen Tomschke,Jürgen Anke,Maik Thiele*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"评判漂移"(judge drift)问题与PromptOps闭环框架，将部署中LLM评判器的持续校准拆分为何时优化、用何种优化、用哪些反馈、如何更新提示四个决策，并用五种提示优化方法在受控分数分布偏移下验证迭代优化可恢复性能，但最优算法与时机的选择依赖具体情境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多被用作自动评判器(LLMaaJ)，但部署后随用户交互和分数分布变化，其与既定人工评估标准的一致性会退化。现有自动提示优化多在静态开发集上以一次性流程研究，难以为评判器的长期维护提供指导。

Method: 将问题形式化为judge drift，提出闭环框架PromptOps，分离出四项运行决策：何时优化、采用哪种优化流程、使用哪些反馈记录、如何更新评判提示。以此实例化五种提示优化方法：GEPA、SIMBA、评分量表合成(Rubric Synthesis)，以及基于模拟退火或TPE的示例选择。

Result: 实验表明迭代提示优化能重新校准LLM评判器，并在参考分数分布受控偏移后恢复性能；但有效维护本质上是情境相关的——优化算法的选择与更新时机都无法在所有设置中普遍泛化。

Conclusion: 部署中的LLM评判器提示优化应被视为本质上迭代的维护问题，PromptOps为研究和实现该过程提供了实用的抽象框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for evaluating the behavior of chatbots and other AI systems. In deployment, however, their agreement with the intended human evaluation policy may degrade as user interactions and score distributions change. Existing automatic prompt optimization methods are primarily studied as one-shot procedures on static development sets and therefore provide limited guidance for maintaining LLM judges over time. We frame this problem as judge drift and introduce PromptOps, a closedloop framework for monitoring and iteratively recalibrating LLM-as-a-Judge (LLMaaJ) systems. PromptOps separates four operational decisions: when to optimize, which optimization procedure to apply, which feedback records to use, and how to update the judge prompt. We instantiate the framework with five prompt optimization methods: GEPA, SIMBA, Rubric Synthesis, and exemplar selection using either simulated annealing or a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator. Our experiments demonstrate that iterative prompt optimization can recalibrate LLM judges and recover performance after controlled shifts in the referencescore distribution. However, effective maintenance is inherently contextdependent: neither optimization algorithm choice nor update timing generalizes universally across settings. These findings establish prompt optimization for deployed LLM judges as an inherently iterative maintenance problem and demonstrate that PromptOps provides a practical abstraction for studying and implementing this process.

</details>


### [240] [Goal Revelation as a Bridge Between Information-Theoretic Empowerment and Capability-Based Human Power](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07247)
*Jaime Ruiz-Serra,Tomáš Gavenčiak,Jobst Heitzig*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文在马尔可夫博弈中将信息论赋权与基于能力的个体权力联系起来，建立链条 B(s) ≤ I(G;ξ|s) ≤ I(A_h→ξ|s) ≤ 𝔈_h(s)，并指出各量之间存在不可互换的失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体具有工具性收敛倾向，在嵌入社会技术系统时可能导致人类逐步丧失权力；因此需要形式化、可量化的权力度量。

Method: 对比两种马尔可夫博弈中的权力度量：信息论赋权（动作到未来状态的通道容量）与基于能力的个体权力（目标族中目标达成概率）。由个体权力借助Fano不等式得到下界B(s)，即目标揭示度（人类潜在目标与实现轨迹的互信息）的下界；赋权则为揭示度提供上界，从而构成不等式链。

Result: 链中各量可独立取大或为零：最大化赋权的助手可能偏好具有广泛但不相关自由度的接口；最大化揭示度的助手无法区分有效接口与被重连（目标标签置换）的接口，因为互信息不变而达成概率归零。仿真显示三者相关但远不可互换。

Conclusion: 正向保证只能来自达成端；一个可由交互日志两项统计量计算的满足度下界，可作为监测部署系统中用户保留权力的手段。

Abstract: Power matters for AI safety. Optimal agents tend to acquire power across a wide range of objectives (instrumental convergence). As we embed AI agents into socio-technical systems, humans risk gradual disempowerment. Both concerns call for a formal, quantitative measure of power. Two such measures in the context of Markov games are information-theoretic empowerment, the capacity of the channel from an agent's actions to future states, and capability-based individual power, a measure of goal attainment built from the probabilities that a human would attain each goal in a family of candidates were they pursuing it. We show where the two meet. From individual power, Fano's inequality yields a floor $B(s)$. This floor is a lower bound on what we term goal revelation, the mutual information $\mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s)$ between the human's latent goal and the realised trajectory. Empowerment caps revelation from above, so that $B(s) \le \mathbb{I}(G;ξ\mid s) \le \mathbb{I}(\mathbf{A}_h \to ξ\mid s) \le \mathfrak{E}_h(s)$. Each quantity can be large while the one below it stays at zero, highlighting the following failure modes. An assistant maximising empowerment can prefer an interface offering broad influence over goal-irrelevant degrees of freedom to one that lets the human attain every goal they might hold. An assistant maximising revelation cannot tell a working interface from one rewired so that every goal yields the wrong outcome, since relabelling goals leaves mutual information unchanged while zeroing every attainment probability. Positive guarantees therefore come only from the attainment end of the chain. A satisfaction floor, computable from two statistics of interaction logs, offers a way to monitor the power users retain in a deployed system, and simulations in random environments show the three quantities are correlated but far from interchangeable.

</details>


### [241] [Robust Ranking of Port Impacts from Impending Tropical Cyclones: A Two-Stage Recommendation System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07296)
*Chenchen Kuai,Shixuan Tang,Chaolun Ma,Xiaoqiang Kong,Xiubin Bruce Wang,Yunlong Zhang,Zihao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段推荐框架（候选港口检索+影响天数排序），利用AIS数据与31个飓风样本，比较三种港口-气旋交互建模方式，发现Wide & Deep Learning最贴合观测排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一热带气旋可能威胁多个港口，但单个港口历史观测稀少且登陆点存在不确定性，难以预估哪些港口受影响、影响持续多久，港口当局缺乏跨港优先级排序依据。

Method: 两阶段框架：先按港口与预期登陆点距离检索候选港口，再按估计影响天数排序。数据为墨西哥湾37个港口、31个气旋的AIS影响天数。对比三种交互表示：成对特征交互、树模型特征组合、显式特征交叉+学习嵌入，并以Nicole和Ian飓风测试，评估对登陆不确定性的敏感度。

Result: 检索阶段在登陆不确定下稳定识别出全部实际受影响港口；排序模型中Wide & Deep Learning与观测排序一致性最高，平均排序一致性较距离基线在Nicole上提升85.5%、Ian上提升55.5%，且对登陆位置不确定性更不敏感。

Conclusion: 该框架可为港口当局在同一次气旋事件中安排事后巡检优先级与恢复资源分配提供参考；Wide & Deep Learning是表现最佳的港口影响排序方案。

Abstract: When a tropical cyclone (TC) threatens several ports, preparedness planning depends on anticipating which ports are likely to be affected and where disruptions may last longest. Limited historical observations at individual ports and uncertainty in landfall location make these relative impacts difficult to estimate. We use a two-stage recommendation framework that first selects candidate ports based on their proximity to the expected landfall location and then ranks them by their estimated number of impact days. Using AIS-derived impact days for 37 ports and 31 TCs in the Gulf of Mexico study region, we compare three ways of representing port--cyclone interactions: pairwise feature interactions, tree-based feature combinations, and explicit feature crosses combined with learned embeddings. In tests on Hurricanes Nicole and Ian, the retrieval stage consistently identifies all observed affected ports under landfall uncertainty. Among the ranking models, Wide & Deep Learning achieves the closest agreement with the observed port rankings. Its mean ranking agreement exceeds that of the distance-based baseline by 85.5% for Nicole and 55.5% for Ian and is less sensitive to uncertainty in the landfall location. These rankings could help port authorities prioritize post-cyclone inspections and allocate recovery resources across ports threatened by the same event.

</details>


### [242] [EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07372)
*Mingxuan Li,Huanzhi Mao,Qiuyang Mang,Hanchen Li,Joseph E. Gonzalez,Alex Dimakis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出环境优化这一新方向：对"静态环境"做端到端自动优化，在无需评分器或参考答案的情况下降低智能体成本并提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体的成本与成功率取决于模型、harness 与环境三者的组合。现有研究集中在参数微调与 harness 优化，第三维度"环境"被忽视。而智能体常部署在承载大量任务的丰富环境中（如企业 Slack 工作区、复杂数据源/文档/工单集合），这类"静态环境"值得优化。核心洞察是：信息呈现给智能体的方式会同时影响成本与成功率。

Method: 提出 EnvOpt，一种针对任意给定模型与 harness 的静态环境自动化端到端优化方法。它利用真实或合成任务进行优化，不需要任何评分器或参考答案作为监督信号。同时总结了自动优化过程中常见的高效与失败的优化策略。

Result: 在 AutomationBench 上，EnvOpt 将 Claude Haiku 4.5 成本降低 72.7%、通过率提升 14.34%；同一环境可直接迁移到 Opus 5，成本降低 68.1%、成功率提升 1.34%；叠加在 Meta-Harness 优化后的 harness 之上，成本再降 83.4%、准确率再提升 11.17%。在 5 个基准上均显著降本并保持或提升通过率，且可跨模型、跨 harness 迁移。

Conclusion: 环境表示为智能体的成本与成功率的关键因素，因此除参数与 harness 之外，环境本身也值得作为独立优化对象。EnvOpt 提供了可行、可迁移的方案，并具备与 harness 优化叠加的互补性。

Abstract: An LLM agent's cost and success depend on its model, its harness, and its environment. In addition to the widely studied directions of parameter tuning and harness optimization, we propose the third direction: optimization over stationary environments. Agents are often deployed in rich environments shared by many tasks, such as a company's Slack workspace or a complex collection of data sources, documents or tickets. We call these environments stationary environments. We introduce EnvOpt, a method for automated end-to-end optimization of stationary environments for any given model and harness, using real or synthetic tasks without needing any graders or reference answers. On AutomationBench, EnvOpt reduces the cost of Claude Haiku 4.5 by 72.7% and raises its pass rate by 14.34%. The same environment transfers to Opus 5, cutting its cost by 68.1% with a 1.34% gain. Added on top of Meta-Harness's optimized harness for Haiku 4.5, it lowers cost by a further 83.4% and adds 11.17% accuracy over Meta-Harness alone. Across 5 benchmarks, EnvOpt significantly reduces the cost of agents while improving or maintaining pass rate, and is transferable to different models and different harnesses. We also discuss common successful and rejected environment optimization strategies during automated optimization. More broadly, our results show that how information is represented to an agent shapes both its cost and its success, making the environment worth optimizing in addition to the parameters and the harness.

</details>


### [243] [FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07464)
*Yupeng Cao,Xueqing Peng,Lingfei Qian,Haohang Li,Yangyang Yu,Anke Xu,Wenbo Cao,Yan Wang,Yuechen Jiang,Yuyan Wang,Zhuohan Xie,Yankai Chen,Zehan Li,Jimin Huang,Xue Liu,Jian-Yun Nie,Sophia Ananiadou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出FINCOSMOS，一个面向开放Web环境中金融任务的智能体评测范式：模拟用户持有隐藏策略、仅在追问时透露，智能体须自行从Web获取数据、在数据截止下自建回测并交付可验证结果；评测不依赖参考答案，而通过程序化校验时点正确性、重算指标、比对隐藏策略以及15项否决检查来判定，最终以用户满意且无误判运行才算成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融是用户最难信任语言智能体的领域：数据须来自Web、策略藏在用户脑中、正确性依赖时间，因此智能体可能"静默失败"——执行用户从未要求的策略、使用未验证数据或用未来信息回测，却产出与正确答案一样可信的报告。现有基准通过固定任务、数据或时间线来封闭世界，等于消除了这些失败模式而非测量它们。
