Conclusion: 结果表明，基于序列基础的多尺度表示有助于解码细胞类型特异的调控程序；代码、数据集与模型检查点已开源。

Abstract: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

</details>


### [278] [Create Your Own Work Stack: Deploying Self-hosted AI and Tooling in a Tech Startup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08116)
*Saad Ahmed Bazaz,Talha Amjad,Abdurrehman Subhani,Sohaib Ahmed Bazaz,Abdullah Aamir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文报告了小公司Grayhat Developers部署"混合AI架构"的经验：本地开源模型并非全面替代商业AI，而应承担低复杂度任务，从而估算降低27–36%的商业推理负载/成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业AI使用成本持续增长（Claude/Codex约每月\$325、记录超259.3亿token），自托管AI被视为降本增控的手段，但部署本身也带来成本；作者希望探索一种可行的降本方案。

Method: 在Grayhat Developers进行部署实践：先尝试本地开源模型替代商业编码代理，发现性能与推理速度不足后转向混合方案——商业代理负责复杂任务，本地模型负责低复杂度任务、组织信息检索及与Outline、Plane、ERPNext等自托管工具的同步；并对比了首次部署（因UX摩擦失败）与集中配置部署（反馈与采用率显著改善）。

Result: 估算约30–40%的商业AI负载属于上下文传递、文档同步、任务管理等协调工作，其中约90%可由本地模型处理，对应整体商业AI负载或成本约降低27–36%。首次内部部署因UX摩擦未被采用，改为集中配置后反馈与采用率明显提升。

Conclusion: 本地推理最有价值的用法不是全面替代商业AI，而是作为混合架构的一部分，按任务的能力需求、成本、上下文需求和运营敏感性进行任务分配。

Abstract: Self-hosting AI is often presented as a way to reduce inference costs and increase control, but deployment introduces its own costs. We report our experience deploying a hybrid AI stack at Grayhat Developers, a small software company with an AI-intensive development workflow. Our initial motivation was to counter the growing cost of commercial AI usage: Claude/Codex incurred approximately \$325 per month, with more than 25.93 billion recorded tokens. We experimented with local open-source models as replacements for commercial coding agents, but after learning that their performance and inference speed were insufficient, we adopted a hybrid approach in which commercial agents remained responsible for complex tasks while local models handled lower-complexity tasks, organizational information retrieval, and synchronization with self-hosted tools including Outline, Plane, and ERPNext.
  We estimated that approximately 30--40\% of our commercial AI workload was associated with context transfer, documentation synchronization, task management, and related operational coordination. By moving this work to local models, we estimate that approximately 90\% of this coordination workload could be handled without commercial inference, corresponding to an estimated 27--36\% reduction in overall commercial-AI workload or cost-equivalent usage. Our first internal deployment nevertheless failed to achieve adoption because it introduced UX friction. Replacing it with a centrally configured deployment substantially improved feedback and adoption. We conclude that local inference is most useful not as a wholesale replacement for commercial AI, but as part of a hybrid architecture that assigns tasks according to their capability requirements, cost, context demands, and operational sensitivity.

</details>


### [279] [A Generative Foundation Model for Multimodal Tokamak Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08153)
*Yingshuai Ji,Haodong Feng,Guohong Deng,Gelin Bian,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GenToka，一个面向托卡马克实验的生成式多模态基础模型，并在扩展后的 TokaMark 基准（MAST 上 20 个任务、6 组）上验证其优于 TokaMind。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有托卡马克模型多为单任务、固定输入输出、依赖预设诊断子集而构建，未能利用完整多模态观测中的全局跨信号信息，且每换一种配置都需重新训练，缺乏可复用的基础模型。

Method: 1) 扩展 TokaMark 基准，新增执行器动作反演与破裂预测两组任务，形成 6 组共 20 个 MAST 任务，并给出显式 schema 与评测协议；2) 提出 GenToka，用共享的条件扩散 Transformer 联合生成由 schema 选定的目标，配合信号专用 codec 保留原生时间序列、剖面、场和标量；3) 通过基础预训练与任务特定适配跨六组迁移跨信号结构。

Result: 在 MAST 测量数据上，GenToka 相比 TokaMind：第 1–4 组宏平均归一化 RMSE 降低 4.7%，第 5 组降低 17.7%；在共同验证集选定阈值下，第 6 组宏平均窗口级 F1 提升 8.4%。

Conclusion: GenToka 提供了可复用、生成式、多模态的托卡马克实验建模路径，将等离子体状态重建、执行器推断与破裂预警统一到共享测量之上，支撑更集成的数据驱动聚变预测与控制研究。

Abstract: Tokamak experiments record diverse measurements, including waveforms, profiles, fields, and scalars, which are used to reconstruct the plasma, forecast its evolution, recover associated control signals, and estimate disruption risk. Most models are built separately for one task and a fixed set of inputs and outputs, and each relies on a prescribed subset of diagnostics rather than structuring the full multimodal observation set to extract global, cross-signal information about the discharge. These limitations motivate a reusable foundation model that adapts to each task's input-output schema and models heterogeneous target signals jointly, rather than retraining a separate model for every configuration. In this work, we extend the TokaMark benchmark with two groups of tasks for actuator action inversion and disruption prediction, yielding 20 MAST tasks in six groups with explicit schemas and evaluation protocols. Then, we introduce GenToka, a generative tokamak foundation model that jointly generates schema-selected targets through a shared conditional diffusion Transformer, with signal-specific codecs preserving native time series, profiles, fields, and scalars; foundation pretraining and task-specific adaptation transfer cross-signal structure across all six groups. Evaluation on MAST measurements shows that GenToka reduces macro-average normalized root mean squared error relative to TokaMind by 4.7% on Groups 1-4 and by 17.7% on Group 5, and improves macro-average window-level F1 on Group 6 by 8.4% at a common validation-selected threshold. GenToka provides a reusable, generative, and multimodal pathway for experimental tokamaks, linking plasma-state reconstruction, actuator inference, and disruption warning from shared measurements to support more integrated, data-driven fusion plasma prediction and control research.

</details>


### [280] [PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08175)
*Yue Zhang,Jilei Sun,Liqiang Jing,Yijie Wei,Ruohan Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PCBRouteAgent 是一个受人类工程师"全局策略+局部执行"启发、结合板图与电气/几何信息规划布线拓扑、再由 KiCad 原生引擎执行并带结构化反馈回路的 PCB 布线智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PCB 布线需要把板级连接决策与严格设计规则下的几何执行统一协调；尽管近期智能体可调用原生布线工具，复杂电路板上仍难以可靠布线。

Method: 双模块架构：Global Routing Planner 融合板图像与结构化电/几何信息，指定连接拓扑、布线顺序、通道(corridors)与层切换；Detailed Routing Executor 通过 KiCad 原生布线引擎实现这些引导，并执行有界局部恢复；未解决失败以结构化反馈返回，用于针对性修订引导同时保留已接受的布线。

Result: 在 PCBWorld-Bench 四个测试划分共 247 块合成与真实板上评测，clean-pass 率分别为 D2 100%、D3-A 94.9%、D3-B 100%、D3-C 40%；在三个真实场景子集上，比最佳基线分别高出 13.9、36、10 个百分点。

Conclusion: 显式分离全局规划与详细布线执行，并辅以结构化失败反馈，可显著提升复杂 PCB 布线成功率，真实板场景优势明显。

Abstract: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent, a multimodal PCB routing agent inspired by how human engineers coordinate global strategy with local execution. A Global Routing Planner combines board images and structured electrical and geometric information to specify connection topology, routing order, corridors, and layer transitions. A Detailed Routing Executor realizes these guides through KiCad's native routing engine and performs bounded local recovery. Unresolved failures are returned as structured feedback, enabling targeted guide revisions while preserving accepted routes. We evaluate PCBRouteAgent on 247 synthetic and real-world boards from four PCBWorld-Bench test splits. It achieves clean-pass rates of 100%, 94.9%, 100%, and 40% on D2, D3-A, D3-B, and D3-C, respectively. On the three real-world subsets, PCBRouteAgent outperforms the best evaluated baseline in clean-pass rate by 13.9, 36, and 10 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [281] [BabyTheorist: A Benchmark for Learning to Theorize the World from Observation Alone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08177)
*Doojin Baek,Junyeob Baek,Mingyu Jo,Hosung Lee,Taegu Kang,Gyubin Lee,Sungjin Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 BabyTheorist 基准，用于受控地训练和评估"观察式理论学习"能力；该方法从纯观察中习得可复用的理论并迁移到新情境，而现有视觉推理基准只考察少量样本拼图式的应用。七类主流基线远低于上限且随课程推进差距扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断机器是否真正理解世界的关键能力之一是观察式理论学习：从纯观察中获取可复用理论并应用于新情境。现有视觉推理基准主要评测"应用"而非"学习"，以按共同规则分组的 few-shot 拼图形式呈现任务，无法隔离理论学习本身。

Method: 构造 BabyTheorist 基准：由隐藏的组合式程序生成连续的"前后对比"视觉观察流；训练时学习者只见转移结果，无程序标签、任务身份或支持集。基准控制四方面：程序语言、程序复杂度课程、重复出现的频繁子程序，以及带层级跳跃的持续训练-测试协议。

Result: 七种代表性基线均远低于性能上限并出现平台期，且随课程推进差距进一步扩大，说明该基准所隔离的能力是当前程序学习方法尚未解决的。

Conclusion: BabyTheorist 提供了一个可控工具，用于训练与评估观察式理论学习，揭示现有方法在从纯观察中归纳可复用理论方面的显著不足。

Abstract: How would we know whether a machine truly understands the world? We argue that one key capability is \textit{observational theory learning}: acquiring reusable theories from pure observations and applying them to new situations. Current visual reasoning benchmarks focus primarily on the latter, presenting each task as a few-shot puzzle grouped by a common rule. We introduce BabyTheorist, a benchmark for controlled training and evaluation of observational theory learning. BabyTheorist generates continual streams of before-after visual observations from hidden compositional programs; during training, learners see only the resulting transitions, with no program labels, task identities, or support sets. To support theory learning and evaluation, BabyTheorist controls the program language, a curriculum over program complexity, recurring frequent subprograms, and a continual train-test protocol with level skipping. Seven representative baselines plateau well below ceiling, with the gap widening as the curriculum advances---evidence that BabyTheorist isolates a capability current program-learning approaches do not yet address.

</details>


### [282] [SMART: State-based Multi Agent Reasoning Traces for Verification-oriented Problem-Solving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08196)
*Sai Vallurupalli,Francis Ferraro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多智能体框架SMART，通过捕获问题语境中参与实体的隐式状态来补足知识，用多样化LLM和结构化角色提示生成前提，用于复杂科学论断推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂问题（如论断验证）语境信息有限，需要额外知识才能完成推理，而现有方法缺乏获取这类隐含知识的有效手段。

Method: SMART多智能体框架：捕获参与实体的隐式状态，用多种LLM和基于角色的结构化提示策略，将状态知识整理为多样、互补且对解题关键的前提（premises），再以知识引导的方式进行解题推理。

Result: 在3个数据集的复杂科学论断任务上，验证性能最高提升20%；将前提落地于真实世界知识是必要的，并可带来最高5%的性能提升。

Conclusion: 隐式状态知识的显式化与真实世界知识 grounding 能显著提升复杂论断的验证推理效果。

Abstract: Complex problems with limited context, such as claims, require a means to obtain additional knowledge necessary for solution reasoning. We propose a multi-agent framework, SMART, to obtain knowledge through capturing the implicit state of participating entities in a problem context. SMART curates the state knowledge as diverse, complementary and solution-salient premises using a variety of LLMs and a structured role-based prompt strategy. Using knowledge from these real-world verified curated premises, SMART's knowledge guided solution reasoning improves validation performance up to 20% on complex scientific claims spanning 3 datasets. We show that grounding premises in real-world knowledge is necessary and improves performance up to 5%.

</details>


### [283] [Signals, Evidence, and Context: User Scrutiny in Real-World LLM Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08232)
*Ahana Biswas,Yu-Ru Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析大模型回答的特征（如归因语言、不确定性、URL等）如何影响用户后续的接受、核查与质疑行为，发现"声称有依据"与"可核查证据"之间存在巨大差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM常给出综合答案却不便于用户检验其支撑证据，亟需理解回答特征与用户验证行为之间的关系。

Method: 对ShareChat和WildChat中489,283对助手—用户对话进行观察性统计分析，考察归因、不确定性等回答线索与用户接受/核查/质疑的关联，并区分对话层面差异与回答顺序效应。

Result: 31.9%的合格回答含宽泛归因表述，仅1.33%含明确URL；归因与不确定性等线索同时伴随核查与质疑，仅不确定性有微弱但统计显著的"偏好核查"合并关联；技术帮助场景下不确定性更促核查，信息寻求场景下拒绝与推理链更促质疑；核查行为集中于部分对话，逐轮持续性在控制对话差异后大幅减弱。

Conclusion: 支持用户验证需同时关注可检验证据、用户试图解决的问题类型以及交互历史。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often present synthesized answers without making their supporting evidence easy to inspect. We study how features of these answers relate to users' subsequent accepting, checking, and challenging in 489,283 assistant-user response pairs from ShareChat and WildChat. Broad attribution language appears in 31.9% of qualifying responses, compared with explicit URLs in 1.33%, revealing a gap between claims of grounding and preserved inspectable support. Attribution, uncertainty, and other response cues generally accompany both checking and challenging; only uncertainty shows a small statistically distinguishable pooled association favoring checking. Within Technical Help, uncertainty favors checking relative to challenging; refusals and reasoning traces favor challenging in Seeking Information. Scrutiny is concentrated in some conversations, while its apparent turn-to-turn persistence becomes much smaller when conversation-level differences and response ordering are examined separately. These results suggest that supporting verification requires attention to what evidence can be inspected, which question a user is trying to resolve, and the history of the interaction.

</details>


### [284] [Value-oriented policy distillation for interpretable wind farm power control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08245)
*Max Bruninx,Timothy Verstraeten,Jan Decuyper,Ann Nowé,Jan Helsen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于可解释提升机(EBM)的策略蒸馏框架，将强化学习策略转化为透明、可解释的风电场隐式平衡控制策略，并在比利时电网真实数据上实现82%的不平衡成本降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风电场隐式平衡可帮助系统维持平衡并降低自身不平衡成本，但结算价格事先未知且受控制策略影响；强化学习虽能求解，却缺乏可解释性，难以部署于真实风电场。因此需要一种既有效又可解释的控制策略。

Method: 提出策略蒸馏框架，采用广义加性模型变体——可解释提升机(EBM)获得透明控制策略；引入受能源预测领域启发的"价值导向"视角以提升EBM模型所捕获的价值；并在模型设计中融入专家知识，使策略对利益相关方可解释、可证成。

Result: 使用比利时电网与某海上风电场的真实数据，价值导向且基于专家的控制器将不平衡成本降低82%，性能优于价格阈值控制器及基于决策树的策略蒸馏基线。

Conclusion: 可解释的策略蒸馏方法能够生成透明且高效的风电场隐式平衡控制策略，兼顾经济收益与可解释性，具备实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Wind farm power control can help the system maintain balance and avoid blackouts. In Europe, this can be achieved through implicit balancing, where a wind farm adjusts its power setpoint in anticipation of the imbalance price using information published by the Transmission System Operator. Thereby, the wind farm helps restore system balance while also reducing its own imbalance costs resulting from forecast errors. However, implicit balancing is a challenging problem since the settlement price is unknown in advance and can be impacted by the pursued control strategy. Reinforcement learning methods could help to solve this problem, but lack the interpretability needed to be deployed on real wind farms. Therefore, we propose a policy distillation framework using explainable boosting machines (EBMs), a variant of generalized additive models, to obtain a transparent control policy. To increase the value captured by the EBM model, we introduce a value-oriented perspective to policy distillation inspired by research in the field of energy forecasting. Furthermore, we suggest to include expert knowledge during model design, such that the control strategy is also justifiable to stakeholders. Using real data of the Belgian grid and an offshore wind farm, we find that our value-oriented and expert-based controller can reduce imbalance costs by 82%, while outperforming a price threshold controller as well as a policy distillation baseline using decision trees.

</details>


### [285] [The Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08262)
*Mathis Immertreu,Fitim Abdullahu,Thomas Kinfe,Claus Metzner,Helmut Grabner,Patrick Krauss,Achim Schilling*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在角色（persona）条件下"视觉趣味性"判断的内部表征几何，发现表征随层深重组、提示框定对表征影响大于角色本身，而角色内容对行为影响更大，二者存在解离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态语言模型能模拟不同观察者，但被赋予的"视角"如何重塑其内部表征、这些表征变化是否真正驱动判断，尚不清楚。

Method: 以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为对象，100张图像×53种提示条件，系统变化persona内容与其引入时的语言框定方式，同时记录行为评分与逐层隐状态，分析表征几何。

Result: 表征几何随处理深度系统性重组：浅层主要编码图像身份，persona特异的结构在深层才出现；提示框定对内部表征的塑造强于persona身份，而persona内容对行为判断影响更大。极简身份陈述可在不改变回答的情况下改变表征。

Conclusion: 表征距离不必然反映行为相关性；模拟视角作为独立结构浮现于人工认知系统的表征空间中，揭示了内部表征几何与其功能后果之间的根本区分。

Abstract: Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.

</details>


### [286] [XBridge: Entity-Grounded Latent Bridge for Heterogeneous LLM Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.11676)
*Wooseong Yang,Wei-Chieh Huang,Weizhi Zhang,Yu Wang,Philip S. Yu,Junhyun Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出无解码通信协议XBRIDGE，通过词法锚点映射(LAM)与潜在增强桥(LEB)解决异构LLM智能体跨架构通信中的实体接地问题，在3个模型家族7个基准上全面超越文本通信且延迟降低11倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构多智能体LLM系统（不同模型家族）能通过减少冗余推理模式优于同构配置，但现有通信协议要么用文本传递而丢弃发送方内部表征，要么要求架构同构才能做潜在级传输。跨架构通信存在实体接地问题：跨注意力桥接连续表征时会出现稀有token压缩崩溃，实体身份在连续瓶颈中丢失（仅用桥接时F1约30%）。

Method: XBRIDGE为无解码通信协议，含两机制：(1) 词法锚点映射(LAM)，将发送方原始上下文token映射到接收方词表，提供离散实体锚点；(2) 潜在增强桥(LEB)，让接收方查询发送方隐状态获取上下文增强信号。实体锚点通过接收方自身自注意力将桥接的上下文信号接地到具体实体。LEB仅264M可训练参数(接收方3.8%)，用小型平衡样本集训练，推理开销可忽略。

Result: 在Llama、Qwen、Mistral三个模型家族、七个基准、双向通信设置下，XBRIDGE在每个模型对的全部七个任务上均优于文本通信，且延迟降低11倍；同构设置下在7个任务中6个超过KV共享基线。

Conclusion: 通过将离散实体锚点与潜在上下文增强相结合，XBRIDGE有效缓解跨架构连续表征传输中的实体接地崩溃，实现高效、低延迟且仅需少量参数的异构多智能体通信。

Abstract: Heterogeneous multi-agent LLM systems, where agents are powered by different model families, can outperform homogeneous configurations by reducing redundant reasoning patterns. Yet existing communication protocols either operate through text, discarding the sender's internal representations, or require architectural homogeneity for latent-level transfer. We identify the entity grounding problem in cross-architecture communication: cross-attention bridges that transfer continuous representations across different LLM families suffer from rare-token compression collapse, where entity identity is lost in the continuous bottleneck (bridge-only F1 ~30%). We propose XBRIDGE, a decode-free communication protocol that addresses this through two mechanisms. Lexical Anchor Mapping (LAM) maps the sender's original context tokens to the receiver's vocabulary, providing discrete entity anchors. A Latent Enrichment Bridge (LEB) lets the receiver query the sender's hidden states for contextual enrichment. The entity anchors ground the bridge's contextual signals to specific entities through the receiver's own self-attention. Across three model families (Llama, Qwen, and Mistral), seven benchmarks, and both communication directions, XBRIDGE outperforms text-based communication on all seven tasks for each model pair while achieving 11x lower latency, and in a same-architecture setting it also exceeds a KV-sharing baseline on six of seven tasks. LEB requires only 264M trainable parameters (3.8% of the receiver), is trained on a small balanced sample set, and adds negligible inference overhead.

</details>


### [287] [LeanContext: Disentangling Mathematical Resources from Local Formal Context in Lean Whole-Proof Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08277)
*Hang Zhang,Qihao Ye,Litong Liu,Yunbei Zhang,Yugyung Lee,Yue Zhou,Bowen Liu,Emily First,Cheng Han,Qiao Zhuang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LeanContext基准（129,826个Lean整体证明生成问题），用于评估检索到的前提与项目上下文对神经定理证明的价值，并区分数学上下文(MC)与环境上下文(EC)，考察训练如何影响上下文优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经定理证明日益依赖检索前提和项目上下文来生成证明，但缺乏衡量"目标选定的声明"相对可比替代项的优势、以及该优势如何随训练变化的手段。

Method: 构建129,826个Lean整体证明生成问题，将选定的完整前置数学声明归为MC、其余选定本地源命令归为EC；提供四个对齐输入视图，支持共享目标与原始Lean验证环境下的交叉训练/推理评估；并对最终输入进行审计以识别被目标引用但遗漏的声明。

Result: 对扩散模型和自回归模型而言，当训练包含MC时，选定声明的优势更大；审计后优先纳入被遗漏的依赖项，使LLaDA和Llama在2000个目标上的Pass@32分别提升1.40%和1.70%。

Conclusion: 选取实验不使用目标参考证明、保持检查点/EC/推理预算不变，证明训练中的MC对上下文利用至关重要，且审计补齐依赖可进一步提升证明成功率。

Abstract: Neural theorem proving increasingly uses retrieved premises and project context to support proof generation. Evaluating these resources requires measuring the advantage of target-selected declarations over comparable alternatives and how this advantage depends on training. We introduce LeanContext, a benchmark of 129,826 Lean whole-proof generation problems, to investigate these questions. We group selected complete preceding mathematical declarations as Mathematical Context (MC) and the remaining selected local source commands as Environment Context (EC). Four aligned input views support crossed training and inference evaluations with shared targets and original Lean verification environments. For both diffusion- and autoregressive-based models, selected declarations outperform comparable alternatives by a larger margin when training includes MC. Final-input audits identify omitted declarations referenced by the target. Prioritizing these dependencies improves Pass@32 by 1.40% and 1.70% for LLaDA and Llama, respectively, on 2,000 targets. The selection experiment operates without access to target reference proofs and holds checkpoints, EC, and inference budgets constant. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/haaaardcvZ/LeanContext.

</details>


### [288] [A Generative Model of Contextual Integrity: Appropriate vs. Inappropriate Information Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08284)
*Omer Ebead,Claude Formanek,Joel Z. Leibo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建基于大语言模型的生成式"情境完整性"模型，通过模拟双人对话研究信息分享与拒绝行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 情境完整性（CI）认为信息流动是否恰当取决于情境规范，同一信息在不同情境下披露的适当性不同；作者希望建立可计算的生成模型来研究这一动态过程。

Method: 让两个由LLM扮演的行为者进行对话，一方持有隐私信息、另一方寻求获取，系统性地变化情境、持有者的决策逻辑、性格倾向以及底层语言模型，观察披露与拒绝如何随对话展开而变化。

Result: 行为者在确有需要时向合法接收者分享了信息，但也会向无权获知者披露信息，说明模型再现了情境适当与越界披露并存的现象。

Conclusion: 该模型提供了一个研究披露与拒绝如何在对话中、随情境与行为者差异而演化的方法框架。

Abstract: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that appropriate information flow depends on context-specific norms. The same disclosure may be appropriate in one context and inappropriate in another. We build a generative model of contextual integrity to study information sharing through simulated conversations. Two actors played by large language models exchange messages, with one holding private information and the other seeking it. We examine how sharing and refusal vary with the situation, the holder's decision logic, disposition, and the underlying language model. Actors shared information with the rightful recipients when it was needed, but also disclosed it to people who were not entitled to receive it. The model provides a way to study how disclosure and refusal develop through conversation as the situations and the actors vary.

</details>


### [289] [First-Token Attraction in Mamba Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08303)
*Trinh T. Nguyen,Minh-Khoi Nguyen-Nhat,Duy-Tung Pham,Hoang-Son Do,Tan Minh Nguyen,Thieu N. Vo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究深度 Mamba 模型中 token 的动态行为，特别是首个 token 的"吸引"作用，提出基于高维不变盒与精确退出时间论证的新分析框架，证明首个 token 的极限方向会吸引后续 token，导致 token 聚类与 attention-sink 现象，并在 Falcon-Mamba-7B 上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力机制的 token 交互由正标量系数控制，而 Mamba 动力学涉及无正定/符号保证的矩阵值交互系数，使现有注意力模型分析技术无法直接套用，需新工具揭示其深度动力学规律。

Method: 提出基于高维不变盒（invariant box）与精确退出时间（exit-time）论证的分析框架，恢复有效形式的符号确定性；据此刻画 token 轨迹的可能极限点并给出显式指数收敛率；并将吸引机制推广到状态空间模型、因果注意力与经典时序模型。

Result: 证明首个 token 具有特权动态：其极限方向吸引后续 token，引发 token 聚类与 attention-sink；给出了显式指数收敛率；在 Falcon-Mamba-7B 上实验显示首 token 集中度随深度增加，并在后层占主导。

Conclusion: Mamba 深层动态存在由首个 token 主导的吸引机制，是跨模型族（SSM、因果注意力、时序模型）的普遍现象；所提不变盒/退出时间框架为无符号保证的矩阵动力学提供了可推广分析工具。

Abstract: We study token dynamics in deep Mamba models, with a particular focus on the attracting role of the first token. Unlike attention mechanisms, where token interactions are governed by positive scalar coefficients, Mamba dynamics involve full matrix-valued interaction coefficients with no positivity or definiteness guarantees. This structural difference makes Mamba dynamics substantially harder to analyze and prevents the direct application of existing techniques for attention-based models. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a new analytical framework based on a high-dimensional invariant box and a sharp exit-time argument, which together recover an effective form of sign-definiteness. Using this framework, we characterize the possible limit points of token trajectories and prove explicit exponential convergence rates. Our analysis reveals that the first token has privileged dynamics: its limiting direction attracts subsequent tokens, inducing token clustering and attention-sink phenomena in deep Mamba models. We further show that this attraction mechanism extends to broader sequence dynamics, including state-space models, causal attention, and classical time-series models. Experiments on Falcon-Mamba-7B validate our predictions, showing that concentration on the first token increases with depth and dominates in later layers.

</details>


### [290] [RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08308)
*Roko Parac,Christos Ziakas,Leo Ardon,Alessandra Russo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RM-VLM：用LLM从自然语言任务描述生成奖励机(RM)，用VLM作为标注函数把RM命题在图像观测上接地，并用VLM价值函数估计器提供稠密奖励，在非马尔可夫导航、机器人操作和3D物体收集中均优于现有VLM奖励方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励机(RM)能刻画依赖历史的非马尔可夫任务，但需要人工为每个环境设计标注函数(labelling function)，即命题接地的oracle，限制了其通用性。

Method: 由LLM根据自然语言任务描述自动生成RM；由VLM充当标注函数，在RM引导的策略学习中把RM命题接地到图像观测上；再用基于VLM的价值函数估计器评估智能体在每个RM转移上的进展，从而导出稠密奖励信号。

Result: 在三个域(非马尔可夫网格世界导航、机器人操作、3D物体收集)上，RM-VLM的任务成功率一致高于现有基于VLM的奖励方法。

Conclusion: 用LLM生成RM、VLM作接地可消除RM对人工标注函数的依赖，使基于自动机的非马尔可夫奖励设计在视觉环境中更实用，并提供稠密奖励以提升学习效果。

Abstract: Reward machines (RMs) have been proposed as a reward formulation in reinforcement learning (RL) to capture non-Markovian tasks where credit assignment depends on history. By representing reward functions as automata, RMs expose the task's temporal structure and allow such rewards to be handled within a Markovian framework. However, they assume a labelling function, a proposition-grounding oracle for observations, which must be manually engineered for each environment, limiting their wider applicability. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing RM-VLM, a novel approach in which a large language model (LLM) generates an RM from a natural-language task description, and a vision-language model (VLM) acts as the labelling function, grounding the RM's propositions over image-based observations during RM-guided policy learning. A VLM-based value function estimator is used to assess the agent's progress towards each RM transition and derive a dense reward signal. We evaluate RM-VLM on three domains covering non-Markovian grid-world navigation, robotic manipulation, and 3D object collection. Our experimental results show that RM-VLM consistently achieves higher task success rates than existing VLM-based reward methods across all tested domains.

</details>


### [291] [Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08315)
*Ali Sarabadani,Kheirolah Rahsepar Fard,Tahereh Jeirani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文基准测试五种LLM（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen、BioGPT）在五个知识图谱上的推理能力，发现通用模型在多跳与高阶推理上优于领域模型，KG接地可降低幻觉，且领域模型在无图接地时并无稳定优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已广泛用于生物医学与认知神经科学，但其在异构知识图谱上进行可靠推理的能力尚不明确，缺乏系统性评估依据。

Method: 构建多层级的查询数据集，在DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map与GDPKG五个KG上，对五个模型进行KG感知（图接地）与KG无关两种条件下的推理深度与事实准确性评测；标注一致性用Cohen's kappa（0.781，范围0.753-0.807）与Fleiss' kappa（0.77）验证。

Result: 通用模型（尤其GPT-5.1与Gemini 2.0 Pro）在多跳与高阶推理任务上总体优于领域专用模型，但性能随查询复杂度上升而下降；KG接地在所有模型上均降低幻觉率；与初始假设相反，无图接地的专业任务中领域模型并未持续表现更优。

Conclusion: 结果表明应将广泛语言能力与结构化领域知识结合；作者给出基于任务复杂度与算力约束的LLM-KG集成选型建议，并讨论面向个性化医疗、认知障碍诊断与可解释AI的神经符号混合架构。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss' kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.

</details>


### [292] [Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08318)
*Wenbo Huang,Jianxin Bi,Shunyu Yang,Ruiyang Si,Rui Ni,Qiang Wang,Shulong Jiang,Yintianrun Zhang,Feixiang Ruan,Kewei Zhang,Ye Huang,Shukai Gong,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究具身编码智能体在机器人仿真基准上"暴露评测标准(Criteria Exposure, CE)"所带来的过拟合问题，并通过受控实验证明CE提升的分数并不忠实反映指令完成度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来自我改进的具身智能体常被放在机器人仿真基准上比较，而不少工作会把基准的成功判据直接暴露给学习智能体(Criteria Exposure)。这些判据原本用于验证模仿学习策略，往往比对应的语言指令要求更多，因此验证分数可能无法忠实反映"指令任务是否完成"，尤其对于智能体自己编写的机器人控制程序。于是产生关键疑问：暴露判据后，编码智能体写出的代码是更好完成了指令任务，还是仅仅过拟合了验证判据？

Method: 作者开展受控实验，对比同一自我改进智能体在有/无CE两种设置下的表现；随后在不偏离原始指令的前提下对判据做轻微修改，测试性能是否保持；并考察CE下学到的技能在任务间的迁移能力。最后提出"忠实于指令的判据"(instruction-faithful criteria)并加以评估。

Result: 有CE时智能体很快就能生成在给定判据下成功率更高的代码，但一旦判据在不偏离原始指令的情况下被轻微修改，这一优势便消失；更重要的是，CE下发展出的技能在跨任务迁移上表现很差。相比之下，忠实于指令的判据更能反映智能体生成程序的真实表现。

Conclusion: CE会让基准分数虚高但缺乏忠实性与泛化性，不适宜作为自我改进具身编码智能体的评测方式；应采用忠实于语言指令的判据来评估智能体生成的程序。

Abstract: Self-improving embodied agents are increasingly being developed and compared on robot simulation benchmarks. Several recent works expose the benchmark's success criteria to the learning agent, a practice we call Criteria Exposure (CE). These criteria, originally written to verify policies trained by imitation learning, often demand more than the corresponding language instructions, so a score from such a verifier may not faithfully reflect whether the instructed task was completed, especially for robot-control programs written by an agent. As embodied coding agents report ever higher benchmark scores, a natural question arises: when a coding agent is exposed to the benchmark's criteria, does it generate code that better performs the instructed task, or code that simply overfits to the verification criteria? We conduct controlled experiments with a self-improving agent with and without CE, and find that with CE the agent quickly produces code with a higher success rate under the given criteria, but this advantage disappears when the criteria are changed slightly without departing from the original instructions. More importantly, the skills the agent develops under CE transfer poorly across tasks. We further propose instruction-faithful criteria and show that they better reflect the performance of agent-generated programs.

</details>


### [293] [Enhancing Local and Global Structure in Compressed AI Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08341)
*Henry Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出局部感知量化(LAQ)，用远程保真度G的理论上界构造铰链目标训练OPQ码本，在保持存储字节与搜索方式不变的情况下显著提升记忆压缩的全局保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体将文本存为嵌入向量并大规模压缩，现有压缩仅以保证最近邻(局部保真L)为验收标准，但记忆的合并、删除、比较等操作依赖"哪些条目彼此远离"(全局结构)。作者发现：重打分二进制码在96字节下L高达0.97，却使10.1%的段落被划到另一主题；而PCA 8-bit码L仅0.77，主题漂移率只有1.7%。说明局部指标会掩盖全局语义崩坏，需要同时评估远近两端。

Method: 采用前期工作的两个无标签保真度：L(10近邻)与G(30–50%记忆范围)。理论上证明在G频段内，1−ν_k不超过近远秩违例率平方根的2–2.18倍，且该违例率与压缩距离噪声高度相关(0.979)。据此提出LAQ：把上界转化为对OPQ索引码本的铰链目标，保留原有字节数、旋转与搜索流程。

Result: 仅靠重构损失在52次留出运行中0次提升G；远程铰链目标52次全部提升；LAQ在全部52次运行中提升G(p=8.5×10⁻⁴，跨13个记忆编码器组)，包含外部FinDER记忆；在12次Multi-Doc-2025运行中于七个同尺寸量化器中G最高；可扩展至百万段落并保持证据召回。

Conclusion: 局部保真度不足以保障记忆压缩的语义结构，需显式约束全局保真度。LAQ是首个由远程上界导出目标的量化器，在几乎零额外开销下稳定提升全局保真度，适用于大规模智能体记忆。

Abstract: AI agents store text as embedding vectors and compress them at scale. A compression is accepted when each item's nearest neighbors survive, but agents also consolidate, delete, and compare memories, tasks that depend on which items lie far apart. We evaluate both ends with two label-free fidelities from our prior work: the local fidelity $L$ at 10 neighbors and the global fidelity $G$ at 30 to 50 percent of the memory. At 96 bytes per passage, rescored binary codes reach an $L$ of 0.97 yet move 10.1 percent of passages to another theme; PCA with 8-bit codes, at an $L$ of 0.77, moves 1.7 percent. Rescoring leaves the stored codes, and thus $G$, unchanged. We prove that across the $G$ band, $1-ν_k$ is at most 2 to 2.18 times the square root of the near-far rank-violation rate, and that this rate follows the distance noise of the compression (correlation 0.979). Our locality-aware quantization (LAQ) turns the bound into a hinge objective on the codebooks of an OPQ index, keeping its bytes, rotation, and search. To our knowledge, LAQ is the first quantizer whose objective comes from a proven bound on the far end. Reconstruction alone raises $G$ in 0 of 52 held-out runs; the far hinge raises it in all 52. LAQ raises $G$ in all 52 ($p=8.5\times 10^{-4}$ over 13 memory-encoder groups), including the external FinDER memory, has the highest $G$ of seven equal-size quantizers in all 12 Multi-Doc-2025 runs, scales to a million passages, and keeps evidence recall.

</details>


### [294] [NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08369)
*Pengkai Wang,Wei-Wei Zhang,Yan Li,Min Tang,Zhitian Hou,Zeyu Liu,Guanghao Zhu,Yuanyi Wang,Yanggan Gu,Wenjun Wang,Minheng Ni,Congkai Xie,Zhijie Sang,Jianmin Wu,Ying Sun,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出NPCBench，一个面向鼻咽癌(NPC)的"临床学徒式"基准，覆盖从指南知识到病例规划、纵向随访、CarePath整合与开放式问诊的完整流程，包含4,777个分项/问诊题目和100名患者的CarePath队列（417个评分任务），并引入episode级联合正确性评估。30个模型测试显示存在"组合鸿沟"：单任务强不等于同一患者的诊断与照护答案同时正确，21个多模态模型严格CarePath成功率最高仅23%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学基准把临床能力拆成孤立的事实题、单图任务或静态病例，只能给单个答案打分，无法反映模型能否将亚专科知识与多模态证据整合、并在整个诊疗过程中追踪患者状态变化。因此需要一个更贴近专科医师培养流程、能评估跨步骤组合与时序一致性的评测框架。

Method: 构建NPCBench：分层次设计，从指南与基础知识→病例规划→纵向复核→CarePath整合→开放式问诊；含4,777个分项与问诊题目，以及100名患者的CarePath队列（417个评分诊断/照护任务）。采用episode级评估，检验同一护理路径内诊断与照护答案是否"联合正确"；并设置配对对照实验与医师校准来考察证据落地、纵向修正与问诊判分可靠性。共评测30个模型（其中21个多模态）。

Result: 30个模型上观察到"组合鸿沟"：分项任务表现强并不能保证同一患者的诊断与照护答案联合正确；21个多模态模型的严格CarePath成功率最高仅23%。配对对照与医师校准进一步用于审查证据依据、纵向修改和问诊评判质量。

Conclusion: NPCBench把医学AI评测从静态问答范式拓展到学徒式的临床工作流评估，为肿瘤诊疗中基于证据、时序连贯的推理提供了测试平台。

Abstract: Current medical benchmarks typically break down clinical competence into isolated factual questions, single-image tasks, or static case vignettes. These tests score individual answers, but reveal less about whether a model can integrate subspecialty knowledge with multimodal evidence and track a patient's condition throughout a course of care. To close this gap, we introduce NPCBench, a clinical apprenticeship benchmark for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). NPCBench mirrors specialist training, from guideline and foundational knowledge to case planning, longitudinal review, CarePath integration, and open-ended consultation. It contains 4,777 component and consultation items and a 100-patient CarePath cohort with 417 scored diagnostic and care tasks. The episode-level evaluation tests whether diagnostic and care answers are jointly correct within a care pathway. By linking stepwise tasks to patient-level care trajectories, NPCBench evaluates whether models ground decisions in visual evidence, interpret changes in patient state, and meet clinical requirements in consultation. Across 30 evaluated models, we observe a composition gap: strong performance on individual tasks does not ensure jointly correct diagnostic and care answers for the same patient. Among 21 multimodal models, strict CarePath success reaches at most 23%. Paired controls and physician calibration further examine evidence grounding, longitudinal revision, and consultation judging. Overall, NPCBench broadens the evaluation of medical artificial intelligence beyond static question-answering paradigms to an apprenticeship-oriented assessment of clinical workflows, thereby offering a testbed for evidence-based and temporally coherent reasoning in oncology care.

</details>


### [295] [Learning a patient world model for health system simulation in intensive care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08392)
*Yingtai Li,Ruoyan Wang,Yu Li,Shaohua Kevin Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出用神经网络从纵向EHR学习“患者世界模型”，以共享临床表征支持多情景ICU仿真，无需为每个政策问题重建状态与转移模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗策略实施前需预判临床与运营后果，依赖仿真；但传统仿真为单一问题定制紧凑状态转移，忽略历史依赖动态，换问题即需重新定义状态与转移，泛化性差。

Method: 在MIMIC-IV上训练神经网络患者世界模型，冻结后将其可时间查询的预测通过情景特定映射接入共享ICU日历、资源与队列；以ICU为例，一个模型同时产出入院需求、护理任务与出院建议，用于评估床位容量、护理调度、转出容量等情景。

Result: 在总占用率及对容量/调度政策的方向性响应上与Markov、半Markov对照模型相当，并能复现观测轨迹回放的策略收益；对由不同既往轨迹进入同一支持状态的患者，学到的表征捕获24小时恢复差异(-6.4预测 vs -6.7观测百分点)，紧凑状态模型则遗漏该对比，并传播为不同的护理需求、队列负担与床位使用。

Conclusion: 学习式患者动态世界模型有潜力替代问题特定状态模型，通过重构情景即可评估新护理政策，无需重建模型。

Abstract: Designing healthcare strategies requires anticipating their clinical and operational consequences before implementation, a task that often relies on health system simulation. Such a simulation necessitates modeling how patient states evolve and generate care demands. However, conventional approaches typically tailor compact state transitions to a single policy question and omit history-dependent dynamics, thus requiring the redefinition of states and transitions when there is a new question that entails different clinical information. We propose to learn a patient world model from longitudinal EHRs using a neural network to provide a shared clinical representation of patient trajectories that can serve simulation questions across scenarios. Taking ICU operations as an example, we train the model on MIMIC-IV, freeze it, and couple its time-queryable predictions to shared ICU calendars, resources, and queues via scenario-specific mappings, so that one model renders admission demand, care tasks, and discharge proposals across simulations evaluating ICU bed capacity, care dispatch, and post-ICU transfer capacity. Experiments show that our model matches Markov and semi-Markov comparators in aggregate occupancy and directional responses to capacity and dispatch policies. It also reproduces policy gains from replayed observed trajectories. For patients entering the same support state from different prior trajectories, the learned representation captures a 24-h recovery difference (-6.4 predicted versus -6.7 observed percentage points), a contrast missed by compact state models, which propagates into distinct simulated care demand, queue burden, and bed use. These results indicate that a learned world model of patient dynamics has the potential to replace question-specific state models, allowing new care policies to be evaluated by reconfiguring the scenario without model rebuilding.

</details>


### [296] [StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08403)
*Yang Ouyang,Jung-Eun Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 StepBack，一种步级错误定位重采样方法，在保持自一致性（SC）精度的同时最多减少 41.26% 的 token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性（SC）需要按预设预算采样大量完整推理轨迹，成本高昂；现有高效变体主要通过提前停止整条轨迹采样或跨问题分配采样数，粒度较粗，未针对错误发生的位置进行优化。

Method: 先生成少量草稿轨迹，用轻量信号定位可能的首个错误步位置，然后仅对该错误步及其后缀进行重采样，最后对答案做多数投票。

Result: 在 7 个数学推理与多跳问答基准上，平均精度与 SC 相当，token 使用量最多降低 41.26%；且可自然与 Adaptive Consistency 等自适应推断方法结合，进一步提升推断效率。

Conclusion: 步级错误定位重采样是提升测试时推理效率的有效途径，且与现有自适应推断方法互补，具备良好的可组合性。

Abstract: Self-consistency (SC) is a widely used decoding strategy for improving chain-of-thought reasoning, but it requires sampling many complete reasoning trajectories with a preset budget. Its efficient variants reduce the cost mainly by stopping full-trajectory sampling early or distributing the number of samples across questions. In this paper, we propose StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for efficient test-time reasoning. Given a small set of draft trajectories, StepBack localizes likely first error positions using lightweight signals and then resamples the detected error step and its suffix, followed by majority answer voting. Empirically, StepBack matches the accuracy of SC on average across seven mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%. In addition, by nature, StepBack can be combined with adaptive inference methods such as Adaptive Consistency, further improving their inference-time efficiency.

</details>


### [297] [The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08412)
*Yuanchuan Guo,Jiashun Jin,Zheng Tracy Ke,Bingcheng Sui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ProofTrace 框架，将论文表示为即时证明支撑图（GIPS）并提取可解释的数学组织特征，在8281篇论文构成的五个队列上区分AI生成证明与人类证明，且对AI改写鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI在数学中的使用日益增多，人们希望把"AI参与证明"与"AI辅助写作"区分开来检测。现有研究面临缺乏匹配的病例-对照对、披露可能不完整、以及缺乏可直接捕捉AI证明参与信号的现成特征这三大挑战。

Method: 构建五个队列共8281篇论文（历史arXiv论文、近期披露实质性AI使用的论文、OpenAI发布的手稿，以及用生成式AI自产的论文），包含针对同一研究问题的匹配配对，覆盖不同AI参与程度。随后提出ProofTrace，将每篇论文表示为即时证明支撑图（GIPS），并提取可解释的数学组织特征。

Result: 三点发现：(1) 特征的PCA投影呈现AI参与的定性梯度——AI改写论文接近人类论文，两个AI生成队列朝大致相同方向偏离，实质性披露AI使用的论文居中并随时间向AI生成队列漂移；(2) 识别出AI生成证明的重复特征，如更少引用外部结果、更依赖中间结论、图连通性改变，且在控制研究领域、篇幅或图规模后多数仍成立；(3) 检测实验中ProofTrace可区分人类论文与实质性披露AI使用的论文，性能在AI改写下保持稳定，而最先进文本检测器性能急剧下降。

Conclusion: 基于证明结构与数学组织特征的方法能有效且鲁棒地检测AI在证明中的参与，优于依赖表层文本的检测器，为AI参与证明的审计提供了新工具和实证基础。

Abstract: The growing use of AI in mathematics raises a question: can we detect AI involvement in proofs, separately from AI assistance with writing? Historical arXiv papers, recent papers disclosing substantive AI use, and manuscripts released by OpenAI provide a rich empirical basis for studying this question. However, several challenges remain: lack of matched case-control pairs; potential incompleteness of disclosure; and lack of ready-to-use features designed to capture signals of AI involvement in proofs.
  To address these challenges, we construct five cohorts comprising 8,281 papers by combining existing manuscripts with those we produced using generative AI. These cohorts span different levels of AI involvement and include matched pairs of papers addressing the same research problems. We then introduce ProofTrace, a framework that represents each paper as a graph of immediate proof support (GIPS) and extracts interpretable features of mathematical organization.
  Our study yields three discoveries. First, principal-component projections of our features reveal a qualitative gradient of AI involvement, where AI-reworded papers remain close to human papers, the two AI-generated cohorts depart in broadly shared directions, and papers disclosing substantive AI use occupy intermediate positions which shifts toward AI-generated cohorts over time. Second, we identify recurring signatures of AI-generated proofs, such as fewer externally cited results, greater reliance on intermediate conclusions, and altered graph connectivity; many of these signatures persist under controls for research field, manuscript length, or graph size. Finally, in a separate detection experiment, ProofTrace distinguishes human-written papers from those disclosing substantive AI use. Its performance remains stable under AI rewording, whereas the performance of state-of-the-art text-based detectors declines sharply.

</details>


### [298] [Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08417)
*E. Kelly Buchanan,Crystal Zhou,Scott W. Linderman,Christopher Ré*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"基准维护债务"概念，并给出持续校验工作流，用其审计并修复 Terminal-Bench 2.0（约30%任务有问题），发布 2.1 版本，同时指出资源预算（如时限）本身也是测量规格的一部分，需一并校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体的评测具有重大经济意义，但基准即使在发布时经过严格校验也会随时间"过时"：模型变强后可能给出被旧验证器误判的合法解，评测基础设施变更也会使任务与测试中的隐含假设失效，导致分数与实际能力之间差距不断累积。

Method: 提出持续校验工作流，融合社区反馈、任务工件、智能体轨迹、自动化 oracle 检查与人工把关的修复流程；对经大量人工与 LM 辅助评审、红队测试的 Terminal-Bench 2.0 进行审计，并额外开展资源分配（固定墙钟时间）对结论影响的实验。

Result: 审计发现约30%的任务存在问题，修复后发布 Terminal-Bench 2.1：准确率提升超过10个百分点，排行榜名次最多变动3位，但整体排名高度相关（Spearman rho=0.958）。资源方面，延长时限使 GPT 5.4 上 20pp 的 harness 差距消失，GPT 5.4 mini 的 30pp 差距缩小到 5pp。

Conclusion: 基准维护不只是修复任务工件的实现缺陷：资源预算属于测量规格的一部分，必须与任务一同校验；随着模型能力提升，评测假设与资源设置都需重新验证。

Abstract: Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intended to measure. We introduce a continuous-validation workflow for agentic benchmarks that combines community reports, task artifacts, agent traces, automated oracle checks, and human-gated repairs. We apply this workflow to Terminal-Bench 2.0, a benchmark that underwent extensive human and LM-assisted review and red-teaming before release. Our audit identifies issues in roughly 30% of the benchmark, and we release the resulting repairs as Terminal-Bench 2.1. These repairs change evaluation results: accuracy increased by over 10 percentage points and leaderboard positions move by up to three ranks, even as the overall ranking remains highly correlated (Spearman rho = 0.958).
  We evaluate how resource allocation shapes benchmark conclusions. We show that fixed wall-clock can materially change agent performance: For example, extending the time limit closes a 20pp harness gap on GPT 5.4 and shrinks a 30 pp gap on GPT 5.4 mini to 5 pp. Benchmark maintenance is therefore not only about repairing task artifacts: resource budgets are part of the measurement specification and must be validated alongside the tasks themselves.
  More broadly, benchmark maintenance debt is not just accumulated implementation bugs: our results show that as models improve, both evaluation assumptions and resource settings may need to be revalidated.

</details>


### [299] [The Power of Meta Access in the Software of the Future --- Demonstrated on LLM Chat UIs and Chat AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08428)
*Julian Kunkel,Ali Doosthosseini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"元访问"概念:让LLM以结构化、有权限的方式查看并操作界面本身,并给出五级能力阶梯与反射性问题(需独立控制平面),以Meta Chat原型实现验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天仍是多数LLM任务的默认入口,但模型只能看到当前对话、看不到其周围的工作空间;需要让助手获得对界面状态本身的结构化访问,使聊天从单一会话窗口升级为整个工作空间的控制层。

Method: 提出元访问(meta access)框架及五个层级:功能导览、元数据/设置/偏好访问、对摘要与消息的检索、经确认的变更、完全编排。原型Meta Chat:从摘要、设置与相关消息构建受限上下文,链接会话/话题/人格引用,支持经确认且可逆的修改,提供可浏览教程库,以用户发起的会话形式推荐人格。并指出通用agent harness可修改自身设置,故元访问具有反射性,需独立控制平面边界。

Result: 在Chat AI客户端的Meta Chat原型中落地上述能力;指出暴露结构化应用状态可将屏幕阅读器从控件描述扩展到语义化工作空间操作,同时带来grounding、隐私、提示注入与信任风险。

Conclusion: 元访问把聊天从"一扇窗口"变为整个工作空间的控制层,在不放弃用户控制的前提下扩展智能体能力;未来IDE、仪表盘、办公套件与操作系统应通过类似调试器的接口开放其既有元模型,提供结构化、有权限的状态与能力视图。

Abstract: Chat remains the default surface for many large language model (LLM) tasks, even as agentic tools such as OpenCode excel at coding and automation. Yet the model sees the current dialogue but not the workspace around it. We explore meta access---giving the assistant a structured, permissioned view of the interface itself and propose a ladder of levels: feature tutoring; metadata, settings, and preference access; retrieval over summaries and messages, confirmed mutation, and full orchestration. Meta access can turn a chat client from many screens into one entry point for finding, navigating, organising, and operating it, while raising risks around grounding, privacy, prompt injection, and trust. General-purpose agentic harnesses are runtimes; because they can change their own settings, meta access becomes reflexive and needs a separate control-plane boundary. We ground this in the Meta Chat prototype of the Chat AI client. It builds bounded context from, e.g., summaries, settings, and relevant messages; links references to conversations, topics, and personas; supports confirmed, reversible changes; offers a browsable tutorial library; and recommends personas as user-started conversations. By exposing application state in structured form, meta access can extend screen readers from widget descriptions to semantic workspace operations. Meta access thus turns chat from a window onto one conversation into a control layer for the whole workspace, extending chat toward agentic capability without surrendering user control. As assistants become embedded in IDEs, dashboards, office suites, and operating systems, AI-era interfaces should expose a structured, permissioned model of their state and capabilities, ideally by opening their existing metamodels through a debugger-like interface.

</details>


### [300] [ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08452)
*Yubo Wang,Rui Meng,Jaehyun Nam,Tomas Pfister,Jinsung Yoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出标准化可复现工件设计与ReproBridge智能体工作流，通过保留复现过程中恢复的流程与决策信息，使机器学习实验复现成功率从76.4%提升到92.6%，并降低19.7%的API开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML实验复现需从论文、代码与辅助材料中拼凑流程，信息分散导致编码智能体的复现成功依赖于其填补缺失细节的能力，而非仅靠已发布工件。作者据此探究：将恢复出的流程与决策显式保存下来，能否提升后续独立复现的效果。

Method: 定义标准化工件设计，包含精化代码库、环境配置、实验启动器和复现指南；提出ReproBridge智能体工作流来构建这些精化工件；构建ReproBridge-Bench，含36篇论文、387个实验的1029个任务，每任务有5个人工核验参考分数；智能体在全新会话中用原始代码或精化工件执行任务，由独立Auditor核查执行证据。

Result: 在四个模型上，精化工件将平均复现成功率从76.4%提升至92.6%，下游API开销平均降低19.7%；跨模型成功率差距由21.6个百分点收窄至3.9个百分点，四模型平均成功率均超90%；消融实验显示移除任一组件都会降低成功率，其中移除代码与环境组件损失最大。

Conclusion: 保存执行知识可帮助即使原始代码成功率较低的模型也以更低API成本更可靠地复现实验，说明流程与决策信息的显式保留对提升可复现性具有重要价值。

Abstract: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction guide, and introduce ReproBridge, an agent workflow for constructing these refined reproducible artifacts. ReproBridge-Bench provides 1,029 tasks from 387 experiments across 36 papers, anchored by five human-verified reference scores per task. Agents attempt tasks in fresh sessions with raw code or refined artifacts; a separate Auditor checks execution evidence. Across four evaluated models, refined artifacts raise mean reproduction success from 76.4% to 92.6% and reduce downstream API spending by 19.7% on average. The cross-model success-rate spread narrows from 21.6 to 3.9 percentage points, with all four models achieving mean success rates above 90%. Removing any component reduces success in the ablation study, with the largest losses from code and environment removal. These results suggest that preserving execution knowledge helps even models with lower raw-code success reproduce experiments more reliably and at lower API cost.

</details>


### [301] [Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08478)
*Taiming Lu,Sachin Konan,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"Scientist World"：将每篇论文转化为可执行环境，让AI科学家在真实问题上与人类作者同台竞技，首批发布1000个已验证环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI科学家已出现，但缺乏可供其成长和评价的"世界"。人类科学家拥有文献中积累的开放问题与共享思想，而AI科学家只能"读"文献却不能"运行"文献。

Method: 构建自动化流水线，从每篇论文中提取开放式研究问题，并将其提出的方法复现为基线；AI科学家进入环境后与人类作者已达成的结果进行对比评测。同时记录研究轨迹作为数据与训练资源。

Result: 发布首批1000个已验证环境；前沿AI科学家已有74%的情况下超越人类研究者；积累6400小时研究轨迹（含想法、实验、失败与成功）；用作训练场可使小模型在研究构思上提升158%，达到前沿模型水平。

Conclusion: 为AI科学家建立了从科学自身生长而来的可执行研究世界，兼具评测基准、行为记录与训练场三重功能。

Abstract: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists' own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.

</details>


### [302] [When Does Test-Time Search Help World Action Models? An Empirical Audit of Candidate Selection and Simulator Integrity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.41970)
*Jun Liu,Dajie Sun,Zhenglun Kong,Zhenjiang Fan,Peiyan Dong,Fan Yang,Wenbin Zhang,Geng Yuan,Xue Lin,Yanzhi Wang,Dong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文以"前提优先、预注册"的方法审计world-action模型测试时扩展(test-time scaling)的三条前提链:决策信号、实际效率、评测完整性;在Cosmos Policy与RoboCasa上发现学习价值选择器弱于随机、token剪枝端到端加速远低于预期,并修复一处静默渲染污染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时扩展(候选选择、自适应算力分配)带来的收益只有在候选含可利用信号、理论算力节省能转化为真实加速、评测可靠时才可信;现有工作多以成功率单一指标汇报,缺乏对这三条前提的系统审计。

Method: 采用premise-first(前提优先)与预注册方法,在Cosmos Policy和RoboCasa上分别检验三环节:(1)比较学习价值选择器、随机选择与事后oracle的选择效果,统计候选结果一致率;(2)token剪枝的FLOPs削减与端到端speedup实测(含/不含解码路径);(3)在power gate下检验自适应分配;并排查渲染污染,发布检测器、修复与脚本。

Result: 干净数据上学习价值选择器比随机差1.66 pp;事后oracle仅提升1.40 pp且episode级区间跨零;82%状态各候选结果完全相同,选择空间极小。Token剪枝使单次前向FLOPs最多降47%,但部署路径端到端至多1.15×加速(排除解码路径1.25×),未达1.5×目标;自适应分配实验在功效门限下结论不明确。另发现静默渲染污染,其发生率随算力密集规划路径显著上升,但不影响官方direct-policy结果。

Conclusion: 测试时扩展应按"决策信号—实际效率—评测完整性"的前提链审计,而非仅看成功率;结论限定于所测配置。

Abstract: World-action models increasingly apply test-time scaling, spending extra inference computation on candidate selection and adaptive allocation to improve control. Such gains are credible only when candidates carry exploitable signal, nominal compute savings become real speedup, and evaluation stays reliable. We audit all three on Cosmos Policy and RoboCasa with a premise-first, pre-registered methodology. On clean data, a learned value selector is 1.66 pp worse than random; a hindsight oracle gains only 1.40 pp, with an episode-level interval spanning zero; and 82% of states show identical candidate outcomes, leaving little selection headroom. Token pruning cuts per-forward FLOPs by up to 47% but yields at most a measured 1.15$\times$ end-to-end speedup on the deployed path (1.25$\times$ on a decode-excluded path), short of a 1.5$\times$ target, and our adaptive-allocation experiment is inconclusive under a power gate. We further identify and fix a silent rendering corruption whose rate rises sharply along compute-heavy planning paths while leaving the official direct-policy result unaffected, and release a detector, fix, and scripts. These findings show why test-time scaling should be audited as a chain of premises (decision signal, realized efficiency, evaluationintegrity) rather than by success rate alone. Conclusions are scoped to the tested configuration.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [303] [Invariance before structure: two modes of emergent compression in representation learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07952)
*Hardik Rajpal,Dan Goodman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出EARL框架，用Fisher敏感性区分学习表征中的两种涌现模式——状态空间压缩与参数空间压缩，并在循环水库网络中发现二者在不同学习阶段先后出现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物与人工神经网络中学习表征表现出显著的跨基底不变性，但驱动这种不变性的机制及其与任务特异结构之间的关系尚不清楚。

Method: 提出Emergent Adaptive Representation Learning (EARL)框架：将状态空间压缩（表征对自身未来预测力超越单元个体预测）与参数空间压缩（不同微观参数的网络收敛到相同表征）形式化为Fisher敏感性，并引入集合级信息论度量。

Result: 在带训练瓶颈的循环水库中，参数空间压缩在训练最初几个epoch即上升，且部分独立于任务；状态空间压缩约晚30个epoch才上升，且仅在网络开始学习任务时间结构时出现。

Conclusion: 对基底的不变性与任务特异的涌现结构是在学习的不同阶段分别获得的。

Abstract: Learned representations show striking invariance across biological and artificial neural networks, with different substrates and variations driven by drift, heterogeneity and initialisation. To understand this invariance, we propose Emergent Adaptive Representation Learning (EARL), a framework that distinguishes two modes of emergence in learned representations: state-space compression, where a learned representation gains predictive power over its own future beyond what the network's units can predict individually, and parameter-space compression, where networks with different micro-level parameters converge to the same representation. We formalise both as Fisher sensitivities and introduce ensemble-level information-theoretic measures for each. In a recurrent reservoir with a trained bottleneck, parameter-space compression rises within the first few epochs of training and partly independently of the task, whereas state-space compression rises about 30 epochs later and only when the network begins to learn the temporal structure of the task. These results suggest that invariance to the substrate and task-specific emergent structure are acquired in distinct phases of learning.

</details>


### [304] [SteelAgent: LLM-Orchestrated, Physics-Informed Steel Property Prediction with Audited Generalization and Calibrated Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06953)
*Aleksandr Volkov,Roman Sultimov,Mikhail Kuzin,Yury Maximov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文以SteelAgent/SteelBench为平台，考察不同留出单元（随机划分、钢种家族留出、实验室留出）如何改变拉伸强度评估结论，发现随机划分严重高估外推能力与不确定性校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 钢铁性能模型在随机测试划分上表现良好，但在陌生合金上外推能力差；现有评估通常只报告随机划分结果，缺乏对"留出单元选择"影响的系统分析。

Method: SteelAgent将冶金描述符与机器学习模型结合，并配以语言模型接口，实现性能预测、不确定性报告与逆向设计；在此框架下对比梯度提升等模型在随机划分、17种家族留出、四牌号实验室分析等不同评估设置下的表现。

Result: 梯度提升的合并折外R²从随机划分的0.859降至家族留出的0.113；名义90%预测区间实际覆盖率从91.0%降至37.6%（留出来源）。物理特征效应随评估而变：17家族留出中R²提升0.2534，四牌号实验室分析中降低0.358。

Conclusion: 评估结论高度依赖留出单元；应同时报告评估总体（evaluation population）及组级误差，而非单一性能估计或合规分数。

Abstract: Steel property models can perform well on random test splits even when they extrapolate poorly to unfamiliar alloys. SteelAgent couples metallurgical descriptors and machine-learning models with a language-model interface for property prediction, uncertainty reporting and inverse design. We examine how the choice of held-out unit changes the conclusions drawn from SteelBench tensile-strength evaluations. For gradient boosting, pooled out-of-fold $R^2$ fell from 0.859 on a random split to 0.113 when steel families were held out. Empirical coverage of nominal 90% prediction intervals ranged from 91.0% under random splitting to 37.6% on held-out sources. The effect of physics-derived features depended on the evaluation. They increased gradient-boosting $R^2$ by 0.2534 in a 17-family holdout analysis and decreased it by 0.358 in a separate four-grade laboratory analysis. We report group-level errors and a synthetic regression experiment illustrating how calibration can deteriorate on held-out groups. These results motivate reporting the evaluation population alongside a property estimate or compliance score.

</details>


### [305] [Octopus: One Brain, Many Branches for Latent-KV Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06956)
*Tianming Sha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Octopus 是一个单模型多智能体强化学习框架：所有分支共享一个骨干网络，通过 GPU 上的 KV 状态 DAG 和五个原语协调，解决了现有框架 KV 缓存重复、文本摘要重预填和跨分支依赖丢失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统通过并行子智能体（隔离上下文）探索，优于单智能体的单条增长轨迹；但现有框架存在三大缺陷：跨分支重复前缀 KV 缓存、用重预填文本摘要交换信息、以及 RL 中扁平化或丢弃跨分支依赖。

Method: 提出三个协同机制：(1) 零拷贝 Radix Forking，以 O(1) 游标视图在共享物理 KV 页上分叉分支；(2) Attention-Only KV Mounting，将兄弟线程终端 KV 块直接挂载到全注意力层、绕过线性循环状态（Gated DeltaNet/Mamba-2）；(3) Packed DAG-GRPO 训练器，将所有分支打包进一次块稀疏注意力，并用留一分支边际奖励分配反事实分支信用。协调原语为 fork、read_thread、wait_threads、rewind、commit。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上用 GRPO 端到端训练、稀疏 BM25 语料：BrowseComp-Plus 达 49.6%（比单智能体 GRPO 高 17.5 点，比文本摘要多智能体 RL 高 12.5 点）；OpenResearcher 达 51.2%。超越大至 250× 的稠密检索智能体，训练吞吐提升 3.3×，峰值 KV 内存降低 2.8×；KV 挂载将任务劫持降低 21×（57.9%→2.7%），零额外 KV 分配下保留 92.2% 全文本互信息。

Conclusion: 通过共享骨干 + KV 状态 DAG 协调，Octopus 在保持高效内存与训练吞吐的同时显著提升多智能体搜索推理的准确率，验证了免文本摘要、保留跨分支依赖的 KV 级协调范式的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems explore in parallel by spawning sub-agents with isolated context windows, whereas single-agent systems append every search and verification step into one growing trajectory. However, existing multi-agent frameworks duplicate prefix KV caches across branches, exchange findings by re-prefilling text summaries, and flatten or drop cross-branch dependencies during reinforcement learning (RL).
  We introduce Octopus, a single-model multi-agent RL framework in which all threads share one backbone and coordinate over a GPU-resident directed acyclic graph (DAG) of KV states through five primitives (fork, read_thread, wait_threads, rewind, commit). Octopus combines three co-designed mechanisms: (1) Zero-Copy Radix Forking, which spawns branches as $\mathcal{O}(1)$ cursor views over shared physical KV pages; (2) Attention-Only KV Mounting, which mounts a sibling thread's terminal KV blocks directly into full-attention layers while bypassing linear-recurrent states (Gated DeltaNet / Mamba-2), cutting off-task hijacking by $21\times$ ($57.9\% \to 2.7\%$) while retaining $92.2\%$ of full-text mutual information at zero extra KV allocation; and (3) a Packed DAG-GRPO Trainer, which packs all episode branches into one block-sparse attention pass and assigns counterfactual branch credit via leave-one-branch-out marginal rewards.
  Trained end-to-end with GRPO on Qwen3.5-4B over a sparse BM25 corpus, Octopus reaches $49.6\%$ accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus ($+17.5$ points over single-agent GRPO at 143K context and $+12.5$ points over text-summary multi-agent RL) and $51.2\%$ on OpenResearcher, outperforming dense-retrieval agents up to $250\times$ larger while increasing training throughput $3.3\times$ and cutting peak KV memory $2.8\times$.

</details>


### [306] [Uncertainty calibration in Bayesian M/EEG source imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06979)
*Ismail Huseynov,Mohammad Orabe,Srikantan Nagarajan,Stefan Haufe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于仿真的不确定性量化与校准框架，用于比较BMN+sLORETA与SBL+S-FLEX两种经验贝叶斯M/EEG源成像方法的后验可信区域校准性，并引入等渗回归事后重校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: M/EEG源成像需要准确定位和可靠的不确定性估计，但经验贝叶斯逆方法的后验可信区域很少经过实际校准性评估。

Method: 构建仿真框架，针对闭式条件高斯后验的两类方法（BMN+sLORETA、SBL+S-FLEX）比较；为BMN通过证据最大化推导源方差与噪声方差的联合更新；采用等渗回归基于经验覆盖率对可信区域水平做事后重校准；在固定/自由朝向、不同SNR、稀疏度及个体头模型下，使用oracle、基线估计与自适应学习噪声进行仿真。

Result: 重校准前，SBL+S-FLEX在Wasserstein定位误差、后验不确定性及覆盖率接近名义水平方面均优于BMN+sLORETA；等渗重校准对两者均有改善，对较保守的BMN+sLORETA增益更大；跨不匹配SNR、稀疏度与头模型的迁移依赖条件；噪声设定在各估计器内部趋势基本一致。真实听觉MEG数据中SBL+S-FLEX定位更聚焦、不确定性更紧。

Conclusion: 两种方法均存在残余失校准，需事后重校准；SBL+S-FLEX整体优于BMN+sLORETA，在真实听觉MEG中更具统计功效识别双侧听觉源，但校准迁移具有条件依赖性。

Abstract: M/EEG source imaging requires accurate localization and reliable uncertainty estimates, yet posterior credible regions are rarely assessed for empirical calibration. We present a simulation-based framework for uncertainty quantification and calibration of empirical Bayesian inverse methods with closed-form conditional Gaussian posterior summaries. We compare Bayesian minimum norm (BMN) with sLORETA depth weighting and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) with sparse basis field expansions (S-FLEX). S-FLEX allows retained coefficients to contribute nonzero marginal posterior variance at locations where voxel-wise SBL yields degenerate variances. For BMN, we derive joint source- and noise-variance updates through evidence maximization. We test whether adaptive noise learning yields near-calibrated uncertainties. Both methods retain residual miscalibration, motivating post-hoc isotonic recalibration of credible-region levels using empirical coverage. Simulations assess fixed- and free-orientation models across signal-to-noise ratios (SNR), source sparsity levels, and subject-specific head models, using oracle, baseline-estimated, and adaptively learned noise. Before recalibration, SBL+S-FLEX yields lower Wasserstein localization error, smaller posterior uncertainty, and coverage closer to nominal credibility than BMN+sLORETA. Isotonic recalibration improves both methods, with larger gains for conservative BMN+sLORETA posteriors; transfer across mismatched SNR, sparsity, and head models remains condition dependent. Noise specifications yield broadly consistent reconstruction and uncertainty trends within each estimator. In real auditory MEG data, SBL+S-FLEX provides more focal localization and tighter uncertainties than BMN+sLORETA, suggesting greater statistical power for identifying bilateral auditory sources.

</details>


### [307] [Big Models, Small Gains: Frozen Forecasters as Classifiers on MONSTER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06988)
*Rishit Jain,Rishit Kar,Chetashri Bhadane,Nilesh Patil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文通过受控基准实验发现，预训练预测基础模型的冻结表征虽优于随机权重版本（最多提升23个百分点），但无法可靠超越强非预训练分类基线（17个设置中15个更差、2个持平）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测基础模型越来越多被当作冻结特征提取器用于时间序列分类，但其预训练表征是否真的优于无需预训练的强分类器尚不清楚，尤其在标签稀缺时，表征是否带来架构之外的信息值得质疑。

Method: 在MONSTER基准的六个大型数据集上对Reverso与Chronos-Bolt进行受控基准测试，使用1%、10%、100%训练标签；将冻结表征与四种成熟时序分类方法及同模型的随机权重版本对比；并考察幅度信息恢复、微调与预测误差特征的作用。

Result: 预训练在六个数据集中五个上优于随机权重版本，最高提升23个百分点；但冻结表征未能在任何设置下可靠超越最强非预训练基线（17个设置中15个更差、2个持平）。恢复幅度信息可弥补部分差距，微调与预测误差特征无法弥合差距。

Conclusion: 评估预测基础模型用于分类时，必须引入强任务特定基线与随机权重对照；冻结预测表征的优势有限，不应默认其优于非预训练方法。

Abstract: Forecasting foundation models are increasingly used as frozen feature extractors for time series classification, but it remains unclear whether their pretrained representations offer an advantage over strong classifiers that do not require pretraining. This raises an important question: do these representations provide useful information beyond what the model architecture alone can capture, particularly when labelled data are scarce? We present a controlled benchmarking of two forecasting models, Reverso and Chronos-Bolt, on six large datasets from the MONSTER benchmark, using 1%, 10%, and 100% of the available training labels. We compare their frozen representations against four established time series classification methods and random-weight versions of the same forecasting models. Our results show that pretraining improves classification accuracy over random-weight counterparts on five of the six datasets, with gains of up to 23 percentage points. However, the frozen representations do not reliably outperform the strongest non-pretrained baseline in any setting: they perform worse in 15 of 17 settings and tie in the remaining two. Further experiments show that restoring amplitude information recovers part of the performance gap, while fine-tuning and forecast-error features do not close it. These findings highlight the importance of strong task specific baselines and random weight controls when evaluating forecasting foundation models for classification. Our code is available at https://github.com/Rachet2006/frozen-forecasters-monster.

</details>


### [308] [Robust Stream Classification using Time Neutralising Decision Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06991)
*Brandon Gower-Winter,Georg Krempl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Time Neutralising Trees (TNT)，一种可在允许存储历史实例的条件下应对概念漂移的决策树架构，通过"中和"过时样本并在其重新相关时重新纳入，在24条数据流上取得最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据流具有非平稳性（概念漂移），使已部署模型需不断重训；传统做法依赖漂移检测器加简单重置，而近期研究表明在允许存储实例时批学习算法常优于流学习算法，因此需要更充分利用存储样本的方法。

Method: TNT 是一个决策树架构：训练时根据当前数据流上下文过滤（"中和"）不再相关的旧样本，若这些实例日后重新变得相关则再将其纳入训练，从而在概念漂移下实现稳健的流分类。

Result: 在 USP DS 数据仓库的 24 条真实与半真实分类数据流上评估，TNT 在多种概念漂移类型下均表现最佳。

Conclusion: 在可存储历史实例的设定下，通过动态筛选与重用样本的决策树（TNT）能优于现有漂移检测与重置方法，实现广泛数据流上的最佳性能。

Abstract: Data Streams are characterised as a potentially infinite source of data subject to non-stationarity. This non-stationarity, also called Concept Drift, often results in deployed predictive models having to be perpetually retrained as the underlying data generating process of the stream changes over time. Drift Detectors are a class of methods used to identify these changes, triggering these retraining procedures. Historically, Stream Learning has operated under the assumption that instances are only seen once, and cannot be stored for later use. Contemporary work relaxes this assumption, yet drift detection and simple resetting procedures are still ubiquitous.
  Building on related work which has shown that traditional Batch Learning algorithms often outperform Stream Learning algorithms when instances can be stored, we introduce Time Neutralising Trees (TNT), a Decision Tree architecture that enables robust stream classification in settings with Concept Drift. During training, TNT will filter out ("neutralise") old training samples that are no longer relevant given the current context of the stream. If those instances become relevant again, TNT will then re-include them. We evaluate TNT, and related algorithms on 24 real and semi-real classification data streams from the USP DS repository. Results show strong evidence that TNT achieves best-in-class performance on a wide-range of data streams with varying concept drift types.

</details>


### [309] [LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07025)
*Teresa Delgado,Hugo Hazard,Martin Benfeghoul,Jun Wang,Zafeirios Fountas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LowRAM: 利用"值可由键预测"的互补轴进行值缓存摊销，并结合跨层低秩键压缩，实现接近无损的KV缓存压缩与更高解码吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归解码依赖KV缓存，其显存随上下文线性增长，限制批量大小与吞吐。现有训练后方法只利用token/层/特征维冗余或降低数值精度，未充分利用键与值之间的结构性差异。

Method: 发现同一注意力头内value可由对应key较好预测，提出value cache amortisation：测试时拟合轻量per-head预测器，只对重构最差的token存储残差（4×近无损）；预测器可通过元学习初始化降低prefill开销，或在允许一次性成本的场景（如multi-query inference）中从头拟合。再配合跨层低秩key压缩，构成非对称压缩流水线LowRAM；每步仅重构选定的KV子集以控制开销。

Result: 在三个模型家族上接近无损；4×压缩下峰值解码吞吐最高提升5×；可与量化、驱逐组合，长上下文下达到26.9×压缩并保留94.5%基线性能。

Conclusion: 将键与值视为结构上不同对象，可实现高效、激进且可组合的KV缓存压缩。

Abstract: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing only a selected subset of KV pairs at each decoding step, LowRAM can keep decoding overhead minimal and achieve up to $5\times$ higher peak decode throughput at $4\times$ compression. LowRAM further composes with quantisation and eviction, reaching $26.9\times$ compression at $94.5\%$ of baseline performance on long contexts. These results show that treating keys and values as structurally distinct enables efficient, aggressive, and composable KV cache compression.

</details>


### [310] [Stochastic Dynamics of Generative AI: From Autoregressive Models to Interacting LLM Networks and Neural SDEs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07065)
*Vikram Krishnamurthy,Yiming Zhang,Luke Snow*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文从随机动力系统视角统一刻画三类生成式AI模型：LLM作为高维非线性自回归模型、LLM交互网络的均场ODE、以及神经SDE的路径空间生成建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI（LLM、多模型交互、连续时间轨迹生成）缺乏统一的概率/动力系统理论框架，尤其对涌现性结构偏置和不规则观测轨迹缺乏系统解释。

Method: 1) 将LLM表述为带注意力依赖的高维非线性自回归模型，把条件极大似然预训练与顺序token生成联系起来；2) 用均场ODE刻画LLM交互网络的集体行为；3) 用神经SDE建模连续时间随机轨迹，并用基于粗糙路径分析的Wiener空间cubature方法替代Monte Carlo进行训练估计。

Result: 给出了LLM运行的概率解释；揭示了交互网络中的优先连接效应与类型相关的"玻璃天花板"等持续性结构偏置；论证了Wiener空间cubature可作为高效训练估计手段。

Conclusion: 三类设定分别对应概率预测、交互网络中的信息交换与涌现行为、以及路径空间生成建模，共同构成生成式AI的随机动力系统研究框架。

Abstract: This paper develops a stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on three classes of generative AI models. First, we formulate large language models (LLMs) as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models with attention-based dependencies. This formulation connects pretraining by conditional maximum likelihood to sequential token generation and provides a probabilistic interpretation of LLM operation. Second, we consider networks of interacting LLMs and characterize their collective behavior through mean-field ordinary differential equations. These dynamics provide a framework for understanding emergent preferential attachment and persistent structural biases, including type-dependent glass-ceiling effects. Third, we consider neural stochastic differential equations (SDEs) as continuous-time generative models for stochastic trajectories, including those observed at irregular time intervals. We discuss their training with particular emphasis on Wiener-space cubature methods based on rough-path analysis as an efficient alternative to Monte Carlo estimation. Together, the three settings address probabilistic prediction, information exchange and emergent behavior in interacting networks, and path-space generative modeling.

</details>


### [311] [Finite-Time Convergence and Regret Guarantees for Neural Reinforcement Learning in POMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07069)
*Jingjuan Huang,Zhiyao Zhang,Alvaro Velasquez,Nathaniel D. Bastian,Jia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为有限记忆POMDP建立了基于非线性神经价值函数逼近的有限时间次线性遗憾上界，首次弥合了既有超状态MDP理论分析与实际POMDP轨迹采样之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: POMDP因对历史的长期依赖而计算困难；虽然滤波稳定性假设下可用有限记忆窗口的超状态MDP逼近，但现有有限时间收敛分析要么局限于过度简化的线性函数逼近，要么依赖POMDP轨迹无法满足的i.i.d.采样假设，限制了理论结果的实用性。

Method: 三步：i) 建立新的有限状态MDP逐点逼近误差界；ii) 将TD学习应用于POMDP生成的超状态转移并以超状态MDP的Bellman不动点为目标，证明非线性神经价值函数逼近下的有限时间critic误差界；iii) 结合神经critic误差界与策略镜像下降框架，推导有限时间遗憾界。

Result: 得到有限时间critic误差界，并进一步得到相对最优POMDP价值的有限时间次线性遗憾；据作者所知，这是有限记忆POMDP中首个基于神经函数逼近的有限时间次线性遗憾结果。数值实验验证了理论结论。

Conclusion: 在无需i.i.d.采样、采用非线性神经价值函数逼近的条件下，有限记忆POMDP可获得有限时间次线性遗憾保证，为POMDP强化学习提供了更贴近实际的理论支撑，并经实验验证。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) in Partially Observable Markov Decision Processes (POMDPs) is computationally challenging due to the curse of long-range dependence on history. Fortunately, recent studies have shown that a range of POMDPs that satisfy the filter stability assumption can be well approximated by a superstate Markov Decision Process (MDP) based on a truncated history in a finite-memory window, with a value gap that decays with the window length. However, existing finite-time convergence analyses on such superstate MDP surrogates are either limited to over-simplified linear function approximation or rely on an i.i.d. sampling oracle that is violated by POMDP trajectories, both of which severely limit the applicability of these theoretical results in practice. This motivates us to bridge the gap by investigating RL in POMDPs with nonlinear neural value function approximation. Our main contributions are threefold: i) We first establish a new finite-state MDP point-wise approximation error bound, which lays the foundation for our RL algorithm design and analysis in POMDPs; ii) By applying Temporal-Difference (TD) learning to POMDP-generated superstate transitions and targeting the Bellman fixed point of the superstate MDP, we prove a finite-time critic error bound with nonlinear neural value function approximation; and iii) By combining the neural critic function approximation error bound with the policy mirror descent framework, we obtain a finite-time sublinear regret against the optimal POMDP value. To the best of our knowledge, such a finite-time sublinear regret based on neural function approximation is the first in the literature for finite-memory POMDPs. Our numerical experiments also verify our theoretical results.

</details>


### [312] [Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games: Fundamental Limits and Regret Bounds via Temporal Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07078)
*Yuval Dagan,Nadav Eisen,Liad Erez,Tomer Koren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Optimistic Hedge在有限一般和博弈中的遗憾界，揭示其能否实现与时间跨度T无关的多项式遗憾取决于玩家数量：两人博弈中存在学习率保证O(n log n)常数遗憾，而三人及以上博弈中任何学习率都无法避免指数级甚至线性增长的遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Optimistic Hedge（带一步外推的乘性权重更新）是博弈中最自然的遗憾最小化动态之一，但其遗憾刻画长期是公开难题。已有工作（Daskalakis等、Ha）分别给出polylog(T)和独立于T的界，但都非构造性或未显式给出对动作数n的依赖，因此"能否达到关于博弈规模多项式的常数遗憾"这一问题悬而未决。

Method: 上界方面，提出用于分析Optimistic Hedge的时间局部近似框架：从Daskalakis等的基于方差的RVU界出发，在时间局部窗口内用行为良好的函数逼近损失，使其总变差仅为累积方差的小部分。下界方面，通过构造反例：对任意不超过绝对常数的学习率及足够大的T，构造每个玩家n个动作的三人博弈，使某玩家遗憾达2^{Ω(n)}，并推广到m≥3玩家的2^{Ω(mn)}构造。
